verses.sa:
अबोध्यग्निः समिधा जनानां प्रति धेनुमिवायतीमुषासम् ।
यह्वा इव प्र वयामुज्जिहानाः प्र भानवः सिस्रते नाकमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
abodhyagnih samidha jananam prati dhenumivayatimushasam |
yahva iva pra vayamujjihanah pra bhanavah sisrate nakamachchha ||
verses.en:
Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow.
Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames are rising to the vault of heaven.

verses.sa:
अबोधि होता यजथाय देवानूर्ध्वो अग्निः सुमनाः प्रातरस्थात् ।
समिद्धस्य रुशददर्शि पाजो महान्देवस्तमसो निरमोचि ॥
verses.rom:
abodhi hota yajathaya devanurdhvo agnih sumanah pratarasthat |
samiddhasya rushadadarshi pajo mahandevastamaso niramochi ||
verses.en:
For worship of the Gods the Priest was wakened: at morning gracious Agni hath arisen.
Kindled, his radiant might is made apparent, and the great Deity set free from darkness.

verses.sa:
यदीं गणस्य रशनामजीगः शुचिरङ्क्ते शुचिभिर्गोभिरग्निः ।
आद्दक्षिणा युज्यते वाजयन्त्युत्तानामूर्ध्वो अधयज्जुहूभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadim ganasya rashanamajigah shuchirankte shuchibhirgobhiragnih |
addakshina yujyate vajayantyuttanamurdhvo adhayajjuhubhih ||
verses.en:
When he hath stirred the line of his attendants, with the pure milk pure Agni is anointed.
The strength-bestowing gift is then made ready, which spread in front, with tongues, erect, he drinketh.

verses.sa:
अग्निमच्छा देवयतां मनांसि चक्षूंषीव सूर्ये सं चरन्ति ।
यदीं सुवाते उषसा विरूपे श्वेतो वाजी जायते अग्रे अह्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnimachchha devayatam manamsi chakshumshiva surye sam charanti |
yadim suvate ushasa virupe shveto vaji jayate agre ahnam ||
verses.en:
The spirits of the pious turn together to Agni, as the eyes of all to Sûrya.
He, when both Dawns of different hues have borne him, springs up at daybreak as a strong white charger.

verses.sa:
जनिष्ट हि जेन्यो अग्रे अह्नां हितो हितेष्वरुषो वनेषु ।
दमेदमे सप्त रत्ना दधानोऽग्निर्होता नि षसादा यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
janishta hi jenyo agre ahnam hito hiteshvarusho vaneshu |
damedame sapta ratna dadhano'gnirhota ni shasada yajiyan ||
verses.en:
The noble One was born at days' beginning, laid red in colour mid the well-laid fuel.
Yielding in every house his seven rich treasures, Agni is seated, Priest most skilled in worship.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता न्यसीदद्यजीयानुपस्थे मातुः सुरभा उ लोके ।
युवा कविः पुरुनिष्ठ ऋतावा धर्ता कृष्टीनामुत मध्य इद्धः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhota nyasidadyajiyanupasthe matuh surabha u loke |
yuva kavih purunishtha ritava dharta krishtinamuta madhya iddhah ||
verses.en:
Agni hath sat him down, a Priest most skilful, on a sweet-smelling place, his Mother's bosom.
Young, faithful, sage, preeminent o’er many, kindled among the folk whom he sustaineth.

verses.sa:
प्र णु त्यं विप्रमध्वरेषु साधुमग्निं होतारमीळते नमोभिः ।
आ यस्ततान रोदसी ऋतेन नित्यं मृजन्ति वाजिनं घृतेन ॥
verses.rom:
pra nu tyam vipramadhvareshu sadhumagnim hotaramilate namobhih |
a yastatana rodasi ritena nityam mrijanti vajinam ghritena ||
verses.en:
This Singer excellent at sacrifices, Agni the Priest, they glorify with homage.
Him who spread out both worlds by Law Eternal they balm with oil, strong Steed who never faileth.

verses.sa:
मार्जाल्यो मृज्यते स्वे दमूनाः कविप्रशस्तो अतिथिः शिवो नः ।
सहस्रशृङ्गो वृषभस्तदोजा विश्वाँ अग्ने सहसा प्रास्यन्यान् ॥
verses.rom:
marjalyo mrijyate sve damunah kaviprashasto atithih shivo nah |
sahasrashringo vrishabhastadoja vishvan agne sahasa prasyanyan ||
verses.en:
He, worshipful House-Friend, in his home is worshipped, our own auspicious guest, lauded by sages.
That strength the Bull with thousand horns possesses.
In might, O Agni, thou excellest others.

verses.sa:
प्र सद्यो अग्ने अत्येष्यन्यानाविर्यस्मै चारुतमो बभूथ ।
ईळेन्यो वपुष्यो विभावा प्रियो विशामतिथिर्मानुषीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra sadyo agne atyeshyanyanaviryasmai charutamo babhutha |
ilenyo vapushyo vibhava priyo vishamatithirmanushinam ||
verses.en:
Thou quickly passest by all others, Agni, for him to whom thou hast appeared most lovely,
Wondrously fair, adorable, effulgent, the guest of men, the darling of the people.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं भरन्ति क्षितयो यविष्ठ बलिमग्ने अन्तित ओत दूरात् ।
आ भन्दिष्ठस्य सुमतिं चिकिद्धि बृहत्ते अग्ने महि शर्म भद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam bharanti kshitayo yavishtha balimagne antita ota durat |
a bhandishthasya sumatim chikiddhi brihatte agne mahi sharma bhadram ||
verses.en:
To thee, Most Youthful God! to thee, O Agni, from near and far the people bring their tribute.
Mark well the prayer of him who best extols thee. Great, high, auspicious, Agni, is thy shelter.

verses.sa:
आद्य रथं भानुमो भानुमन्तमग्ने तिष्ठ यजतेभिः समन्तम् ।
विद्वान्पथीनामुर्वन्तरिक्षमेह देवान्हविरद्याय वक्षि ॥
verses.rom:
adya ratham bhanumo bhanumantamagne tishtha yajatebhih samantam |
vidvanpathinamurvantarikshameha devanhaviradyaya vakshi ||
verses.en:
Ascend to-day thy splendid car, O Agni, in splendour, with the Holy Ones around it.
Knowing the paths by mid-air's spacious region bring hither Gods to feast on our oblation.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम कवये मेध्याय वचो वन्दारु वृषभाय वृष्णे ।
गविष्ठिरो नमसा स्तोममग्नौ दिवीव रुक्ममुरुव्यञ्चमश्रेत् ॥
verses.rom:
avochama kavaye medhyaya vacho vandaru vrishabhaya vrishne |
gavishthiro namasa stomamagnau diviva rukmamuruvyanchamashret ||
verses.en:
To him adorable, sage, strong and mighty we have sung forth our song of praise and homage.
Gavishṭhira hath raised with prayer to Agni this laud far-reaching, like gold light to heaven.

verses.sa:
कुमारं माता युवतिः समुब्धं गुहा बिभर्ति न ददाति पित्रे ।
अनीकमस्य न मिनज्जनासः पुरः पश्यन्ति निहितमरतौ ॥
verses.rom:
kumaram mata yuvatih samubdham guha bibharti na dadati pitre |
anikamasya na minajjanasah purah pashyanti nihitamaratau ||
verses.en:
THE youthful Mother keeps the Boy in secret pressed to her close, nor yields him to the Father.
But, when he lies upon the arm, the people see his unfading countenance before them.

verses.sa:
कमेतं त्वं युवते कुमारं पेषी बिभर्षि महिषी जजान ।
पूर्वीर्हि गर्भः शरदो ववर्धापश्यं जातं यदसूत माता ॥
verses.rom:
kametam tvam yuvate kumaram peshi bibharshi mahishi jajana |
purvirhi garbhah sharado vavardhapashyam jatam yadasuta mata ||
verses.en:
What child is this thou carriest as handmaid, O Youthful One? The Consort-Queen hath bome him.
The Babe unborn increased through many autumns. I saw him born what time his Mother bare him.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यदन्तं शुचिवर्णमारात्क्षेत्रादपश्यमायुधा मिमानम् ।
ददानो अस्मा अमृतं विपृक्वत्किं मामनिन्द्राः कृणवन्ननुक्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyadantam shuchivarnamaratkshetradapashyamayudha mimanam |
dadano asma amritam viprikvatkim mamanindrah krinavannanukthah ||
verses.en:
I saw him from afar gold-toothed, bright-coloured, hurling his weapons from his habitation,
What time I gave him Amrta free from mixture. How can the Indraless, the hymnless harm me?

verses.sa:
क्षेत्रादपश्यं सनुतश्चरन्तं सुमद्यूथं न पुरु शोभमानम् ।
न ता अगृभ्रन्नजनिष्ट हि षः पलिक्नीरिद्युवतयो भवन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
kshetradapashyam sanutashcharantam sumadyutham na puru shobhamanam |
na ta agribhrannajanishta hi shah palikniridyuvatayo bhavanti ||
verses.en:
I saw him moving from the place he dwells in, even as with a herd, brilliantly shining.
These seized him not: he had been born already. They who were grey with age again grow youthful.

verses.sa:
के मे मर्यकं वि यवन्त गोभिर्न येषां गोपा अरणश्चिदास ।
य ईं जगृभुरव ते सृजन्त्वाजाति पश्व उप नश्चिकित्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ke me maryakam vi yavanta gobhirna yesham gopa aranashchidasa |
ya im jagribhurava te srijantvajati pashva upa nashchikitvan ||
verses.en:
Who separate my young bull from the cattle, they whose protector was in truth no stranger?
Let those whose hands have seized upon them free them. May he, observant, drive the herd to us-ward.

verses.sa:
वसां राजानं वसतिं जनानामरातयो नि दधुर्मर्त्येषु ।
ब्रह्माण्यत्रेरव तं सृजन्तु निन्दितारो निन्द्यासो भवन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
vasam rajanam vasatim jananamaratayo ni dadhurmartyeshu |
brahmanyatrerava tam srijantu ninditaro nindyaso bhavantu ||
verses.en:
Mid mortal men godless have secreted the King of all who live, home of the people.
So may the prayers of Atri give him freedom. Reproached in turn be those who now reproach him.

verses.sa:
शुनश्चिच्छेपं निदितं सहस्राद्यूपादमुञ्चो अशमिष्ट हि षः ।
एवास्मदग्ने वि मुमुग्धि पाशान्होतश्चिकित्व इह तू निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
shunashchichchhepam niditam sahasradyupadamuncho ashamishta hi shah |
evasmadagne vi mumugdhi pashanhotashchikitva iha tu nishadya ||
verses.en:
Thou from the stake didst loose e'en Sunahsepa bound for a thousand; for he prayed with fervour.
So, Agni, loose from us the bonds that bind us, when thou art seated here, O Priest who knowest.

verses.sa:
हृणीयमानो अप हि मदैयेः प्र मे देवानां व्रतपा उवाच ।
इन्द्रो विद्वाँ अनु हि त्वा चचक्ष तेनाहमग्ने अनुशिष्ट आगाम् ॥
verses.rom:
hriniyamano apa hi madaiyeh pra me devanam vratapa uvacha |
indro vidvan anu hi tva chachaksha tenahamagne anushishta agam ||
verses.en:
Thou hast sped from me, Agni, in thine anger: this the protector of Gods' Laws hath told me.
Indra who knoweth bent his eye upon thee: by him instructed am I come, O Agni.

verses.sa:
वि ज्योतिषा बृहता भात्यग्निराविर्विश्वानि कृणुते महित्वा ।
प्रादेवीर्मायाः सहते दुरेवाः शिशीते शृङ्गे रक्षसे विनिक्षे ॥
verses.rom:
vi jyotisha brihata bhatyagniravirvishvani krinute mahitva |
pradevirmayah sahate durevah shishite shringe rakshase vinikshe ||
verses.en:
Agni shines far and wide with lofty splendour, and by his greatness makes all things apparent.
He conquers godless and malign enchantments, and sharpens both his horns to gore the Raksas.

verses.sa:
उत स्वानासो दिवि षन्त्वग्नेस्तिग्मायुधा रक्षसे हन्तवा उ ।
मदे चिदस्य प्र रुजन्ति भामा न वरन्ते परिबाधो अदेवीः ॥
verses.rom:
uta svanaso divi shantvagnestigmayudha rakshase hantava u |
made chidasya pra rujanti bhama na varante paribadho adevih ||
verses.en:
Loud in the heaven above be Agni's roarings with keen-edged weapons to destroy the demons.
Forth burst his splendours in the Soma's rapture. The godless bands press round but cannot stayhim.

verses.sa:
एतं ते स्तोमं तुविजात विप्रो रथं न धीरः स्वपा अतक्षम् ।
यदीदग्ने प्रति त्वं देव हर्याः स्वर्वतीरप एना जयेम ॥
verses.rom:
etam te stomam tuvijata vipro ratham na dhirah svapa ataksham |
yadidagne prati tvam deva haryah svarvatirapa ena jayema ||
verses.en:
As a skilled craftsman makes a car, a singer I, Mighty One! this hymn for thee have fashioned.
If thou, O Agni, God, accept it gladly, may we obtain thereby the heavenly Waters.

verses.sa:
तुविग्रीवो वृषभो वावृधानोऽशत्र्वर्यः समजाति वेदः ।
इतीममग्निममृता अवोचन्बर्हिष्मते मनवे शर्म यंसद्धविष्मते मनवे शर्म यंसत् ॥
verses.rom:
tuvigrivo vrishabho vavridhano'shatrvaryah samajati vedah |
itimamagnimamrita avochanbarhishmate manave sharma yamsaddhavishmate manave sharma yamsat ||
verses.en:
May he, the strong-necked Steer, waxing in vigour, gather the foeman's wealth with none to check him.
Thus to this Agni have the Immortals spoken. To man who spreads the grass may he grant shelter, grant shelter to the man who brings oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने वरुणो जायसे यत्त्वं मित्रो भवसि यत्समिद्धः ।
त्वे विश्वे सहसस्पुत्र देवास्त्वमिन्द्रो दाशुषे मर्त्याय ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne varuno jayase yattvam mitro bhavasi yatsamiddhah |
tve vishve sahasasputra devastvamindro dashushe martyaya ||
verses.en:
THOU at thy birth art Varuna, O Agni; when thou art kindled thou becomest Mitra.
In thee, O Son of Strength, all Gods are centred. Indra art thou to man who brings oblation.

verses.sa:
त्वमर्यमा भवसि यत्कनीनां नाम स्वधावन्गुह्यं बिभर्षि ।
अञ्जन्ति मित्रं सुधितं न गोभिर्यद्दम्पती समनसा कृणोषि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamaryama bhavasi yatkaninam nama svadhavanguhyam bibharshi |
anjanti mitram sudhitam na gobhiryaddampati samanasa krinoshi ||
verses.en:
Aryaman art thou as regardeth maidens mysterious, is thy name, O Self-sustainer.
As a kind friend with streams of milk they balm thee what time thou makest wife and lord one-minded.

verses.sa:
तव श्रिये मरुतो मर्जयन्त रुद्र यत्ते जनिम चारु चित्रम् ।
पदं यद्विष्णोरुपमं निधायि तेन पासि गुह्यं नाम गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tava shriye maruto marjayanta rudra yatte janima charu chitram |
padam yadvishnorupamam nidhayi tena pasi guhyam nama gonam ||
verses.en:
The Maruts deck their beauty for thy glory, yea, Rudra! for thy birth fair, brightly-coloured.
That which was fixed as Visnu's loftiest station-therewith the secret of the Cows thou guardest.

verses.sa:
तव श्रिया सुदृशो देव देवाः पुरू दधाना अमृतं सपन्त ।
होतारमग्निं मनुषो नि षेदुर्दशस्यन्त उशिजः शंसमायोः ॥
verses.rom:
tava shriya sudrisho deva devah puru dadhana amritam sapanta |
hotaramagnim manusho ni shedurdashasyanta ushijah shamsamayoh ||
verses.en:
Gods through thy glory, God who art so lovely! granting abundant gifts gained life immortal.
As their own Priest have men established Agni; and serve him fain for praise from him who liveth.

verses.sa:
न त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयान्न काव्यैः परो अस्ति स्वधावः ।
विशश्च यस्या अतिथिर्भवासि स यज्ञेन वनवद्देव मर्तान् ॥
verses.rom:
na tvaddhota purvo agne yajiyanna kavyaih paro asti svadhavah |
vishashcha yasya atithirbhavasi sa yajnena vanavaddeva martan ||
verses.en:
There is no priest more skilled than thou in worship; none Self-sustainer pass thee in wisdom.
Ile man within whose house as guest thou dwellest, O God, by sacrifice shall conquer mortals.

verses.sa:
वयमग्ने वनुयाम त्वोता वसूयवो हविषा बुध्यमानाः ।
वयं समर्ये विदथेष्वह्नां वयं राया सहसस्पुत्र मर्तान् ॥
verses.rom:
vayamagne vanuyama tvota vasuyavo havisha budhyamanah |
vayam samarye vidatheshvahnam vayam raya sahasasputra martan ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, O Agni may we conquer through our oblation, fain for wealth, awakened:
May we in battle, in the days' assemblies, O Son of Strength, by riches conquer mortals.

verses.sa:
यो न आगो अभ्येनो भरात्यधीदघमघशंसे दधात ।
जही चिकित्वो अभिशस्तिमेतामग्ने यो नो मर्चयति द्वयेन ॥
verses.rom:
yo na ago abhyeno bharatyadhidaghamaghashamse dadhata |
jahi chikitvo abhishastimetamagne yo no marchayati dvayena ||
verses.en:
He shall bring evil on the evil-plotter whoever turns against us sin and outrage.
Destroy this calumny of him, O Agni, whoever injures us with double-dealing.

verses.sa:
त्वामस्या व्युषि देव पूर्वे दूतं कृण्वाना अयजन्त हव्यैः ।
संस्थे यदग्न ईयसे रयीणां देवो मर्तैर्वसुभिरिध्यमानः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasya vyushi deva purve dutam krinvana ayajanta havyaih |
samsthe yadagna iyase rayinam devo martairvasubhiridhyamanah ||
verses.en:
At this dawn's flushing, God! our ancient fathers served thee with offerings, making thee their envoy,
When, Agni, to the store of wealth thou goest, a God enkindled with good things by mortals.

verses.sa:
अव स्पृधि पितरं योधि विद्वान्पुत्रो यस्ते सहसः सून ऊहे ।
कदा चिकित्वो अभि चक्षसे नोऽग्ने कदाँ ऋतचिद्यातयासे ॥
verses.rom:
ava spridhi pitaram yodhi vidvanputro yaste sahasah suna uhe |
kada chikitvo abhi chakshase no'gne kadan ritachidyatayase ||
verses.en:
Save, thou who knowest, draw thy father near thee, who counts as thine own son, O Child of Power.
O sapient Agni, when wilt thou regard us? When, skilled in holy Law, wilt thou direct us?

verses.sa:
भूरि नाम वन्दमानो दधाति पिता वसो यदि तज्जोषयासे ।
कुविद्देवस्य सहसा चकानः सुम्नमग्निर्वनते वावृधानः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuri nama vandamano dadhati pita vaso yadi tajjoshayase |
kuviddevasya sahasa chakanah sumnamagnirvanate vavridhanah ||
verses.en:
Adoring thee he gives thee many a title, when thou, Good Lord! acceptest this as Father.
And doth not Agni, glad in strength of Godhead, gain splendid bliss when he hath waxen mighty?

verses.sa:
त्वमङ्ग जरितारं यविष्ठ विश्वान्यग्ने दुरिताति पर्षि ।
स्तेना अदृश्रन्रिपवो जनासोऽज्ञातकेता वृजिना अभूवन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamanga jaritaram yavishtha vishvanyagne duritati parshi |
stena adrishranripavo janaso'jnataketa vrijina abhuvan ||
verses.en:
Most Youthful Agni, verily thou bearest thy praiser safely over all his troubles.
Thieves have been seen by us and open foemen: unknown have been the plottings of the wicked.

verses.sa:
इमे यामासस्त्वद्रिगभूवन्वसवे वा तदिदागो अवाचि ।
नाहायमग्निरभिशस्तये नो न रीषते वावृधानः परा दात् ॥
verses.rom:
ime yamasastvadrigabhuvanvasave va tadidago avachi |
nahayamagnirabhishastaye no na rishate vavridhanah para dat ||
verses.en:
To thee these eulogies have been directed: or to the Vasu hath this sin been spoken.
But this our Agni, flaming high, shall never yield us to calumny, to him who wrongs us.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने वसुपतिं वसूनामभि प्र मन्दे अध्वरेषु राजन् ।
त्वया वाजं वाजयन्तो जयेमाभि ष्याम पृत्सुतीर्मर्त्यानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vasupatim vasunamabhi pra mande adhvareshu rajan |
tvaya vajam vajayanto jayemabhi shyama pritsutirmartyanam ||
verses.en:
O AGNI, King and Lord of wealth and treasures, in thee is my delight at sacrifices.
Through thee may we obtain the strength we long for, and overcome the fierce attacks of mortals.

verses.sa:
हव्यवाळग्निरजरः पिता नो विभुर्विभावा सुदृशीको अस्मे ।
सुगार्हपत्याः समिषो दिदीह्यस्मद्र्यक्सं मिमीहि श्रवांसि ॥
verses.rom:
havyavalagnirajarah pita no vibhurvibhava sudrishiko asme |
sugarhapatyah samisho didihyasmadryaksam mimihi shravamsi ||
verses.en:
Agni, Eternal Father, offering- bearer, fair to behold, far-reaching, far-refulgent,
From well-kept household fire beam food to feed us, and measure out to us abundant glory.

verses.sa:
विशां कविं विश्पतिं मानुषीणां शुचिं पावकं घृतपृष्ठमग्निम् ।
नि होतारं विश्वविदं दधिध्वे स देवेषु वनते वार्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
visham kavim vishpatim manushinam shuchim pavakam ghritaprishthamagnim |
ni hotaram vishvavidam dadhidhve sa deveshu vanate varyani ||
verses.en:
The Sage of men, the Lord of human races, pure, purifying Agni, balmed with butter,
Him the Omniscient as your Priest ye stablish: he wins among the Gods things worth the choosing.

verses.sa:
जुषस्वाग्न इळया सजोषा यतमानो रश्मिभिः सूर्यस्य ।
जुषस्व नः समिधं जातवेद आ च देवान्हविरद्याय वक्षि ॥
verses.rom:
jushasvagna ilaya sajosha yatamano rashmibhih suryasya |
jushasva nah samidham jataveda a cha devanhaviradyaya vakshi ||
verses.en:
Agni, enjoy, of one accord with Ila, striving in rivalry with beams of Sarya,
Enjoy, O Jatavedas, this our fuel, and bring the Gods to us to taste oblations.

verses.sa:
जुष्टो दमूना अतिथिर्दुरोण इमं नो यज्ञमुप याहि विद्वान् ।
विश्वा अग्ने अभियुजो विहत्या शत्रूयतामा भरा भोजनानि ॥
verses.rom:
jushto damuna atithirdurona imam no yajnamupa yahi vidvan |
vishva agne abhiyujo vihatya shatruyatama bhara bhojanani ||
verses.en:
As dear House-Friend, guest welcome in the dwelling, to this our sacrifice come thou who knowest.
And, Agni, having scattered all assailants, bring to us the possessions of our foemen.

verses.sa:
वधेन दस्युं प्र हि चातयस्व वयः कृण्वानस्तन्वे स्वायै ।
पिपर्षि यत्सहसस्पुत्र देवान्त्सो अग्ने पाहि नृतम वाजे अस्मान् ॥
verses.rom:
vadhena dasyum pra hi chatayasva vayah krinvanastanve svayai |
piparshi yatsahasasputra devantso agne pahi nritama vaje asman ||
verses.en:
Drive thou away the Dasyu with thy weapon. As, gaining vital power for thine own body,
O Son of Strength, the Gods thou satisfiest, so in fight save us, most heroic Agni.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अग्न उक्थैर्विधेम वयं हव्यैः पावक भद्रशोचे ।
अस्मे रयिं विश्ववारं समिन्वास्मे विश्वानि द्रविणानि धेहि ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te agna ukthairvidhema vayam havyaih pavaka bhadrashoche |
asme rayim vishvavaram saminvasme vishvani dravinani dhehi ||
verses.en:
May we, O Agni, with our lauds adore thee, and with our gifts, fair-beaming Purifier!
Send to us wealth containing all things precious: bestow upon us every sort of riches.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमग्ने अध्वरं जुषस्व सहसः सूनो त्रिषधस्थ हव्यम् ।
वयं देवेषु सुकृतः स्याम शर्मणा नस्त्रिवरूथेन पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamagne adhvaram jushasva sahasah suno trishadhastha havyam |
vayam deveshu sukritah syama sharmana nastrivaruthena pahi ||
verses.en:
Son of Strength, Agni, dweller in three regions, accept our sacrifice and our oblation.
Among the Gods may we be counted pious: protect us with a triply-guarding shelter.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि नो दुर्गहा जातवेदः सिन्धुं न नावा दुरिताति पर्षि ।
अग्ने अत्रिवन्नमसा गृणानोऽस्माकं बोध्यविता तनूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani no durgaha jatavedah sindhum na nava duritati parshi |
agne atrivannamasa grinano'smakam bodhyavita tanunam ||
verses.en:
Over all woes and dangers, Jatavedas, bear us as in a boat across a river.
Praised with our homage even as Atri praised thee, O Agni, be the guardian of our bodies.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वा हृदा कीरिणा मन्यमानोऽमर्त्यं मर्त्यो जोहवीमि ।
जातवेदो यशो अस्मासु धेहि प्रजाभिरग्ने अमृतत्वमश्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
yastva hrida kirina manyamano'martyam martyo johavimi |
jatavedo yasho asmasu dhehi prajabhiragne amritatvamashyam ||
verses.en:
As I, remembering thee with grateful spirit, a mortal, call with might on thee Immortal,
Vouchsafe us high renown, O Jatavedas, and may I be immortal by my children.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं सुकृते जातवेद उ लोकमग्ने कृणवः स्योनम् ।
अश्विनं स पुत्रिणं वीरवन्तं गोमन्तं रयिं नशते स्वस्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvam sukrite jataveda u lokamagne krinavah syonam |
ashvinam sa putrinam viravantam gomantam rayim nashate svasti ||
verses.en:
The pious man, O Jatavedas Agni, to whom thou grantest ample room and pleasure,
Gaineth abundant wealth with sons and horses, with heroes and with kine for his well-being.

verses.sa:
सुसमिद्धाय शोचिषे घृतं तीव्रं जुहोतन ।
अग्नये जातवेदसे ॥
verses.rom:
susamiddhaya shochishe ghritam tivram juhotana |
agnaye jatavedase ||
verses.en:
To Agni, Jatavedas, to the flame, the well-enkindled God,
Offer thick sacrificial oil.

verses.sa:
नराशंसः सुषूदतीमं यज्ञमदाभ्यः ।
कविर्हि मधुहस्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
narashamsah sushudatimam yajnamadabhyah |
kavirhi madhuhastyah ||
verses.en:
He, Narasamsa, ne'er beguiled, inspiriteth this sacrifice:
For sage is he, with sweets in hand.

verses.sa:
ईळितो अग्न आ वहेन्द्रं चित्रमिह प्रियम् ।
सुखै रथेभिरूतये ॥
verses.rom:
ilito agna a vahendram chitramiha priyam |
sukhai rathebhirutaye ||
verses.en:
Adored, O Agni, hither bring Indra the Wonderful, the Friend,
On lightly-rolling car to aid.

verses.sa:
ऊर्णम्रदा वि प्रथस्वाभ्यर्का अनूषत ।
भवा नः शुभ्र सातये ॥
verses.rom:
urnamrada vi prathasvabhyarka anushata |
bhava nah shubhra sataye ||
verses.en:
Spread thyself out, thou soft as wool The holy hymns have sung to thee.
Bring gain to us, O beautiful!

verses.sa:
देवीर्द्वारो वि श्रयध्वं सुप्रायणा न ऊतये ।
प्रप्र यज्ञं पृणीतन ॥
verses.rom:
devirdvaro vi shrayadhvam suprayana na utaye |
prapra yajnam prinitana ||
verses.en:
Open yourselves, ye Doors Divine, easy of access for our aid:
Fill, more and more, the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
सुप्रतीके वयोवृधा यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।
दोषामुषासमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
supratike vayovridha yahvi ritasya matara |
doshamushasamimahe ||
verses.en:
Fair strengtheners of vital power, young Mothers of eternal Law,
Morning and Night we supplicate.

verses.sa:
वातस्य पत्मन्नीळिता दैव्या होतारा मनुषः ।
इमं नो यज्ञमा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vatasya patmannilita daivya hotara manushah |
imam no yajnama gatam ||
verses.en:
On the wind's flight come, glorified, ye two celestial Priests of man
Come ye to this our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इळा सरस्वती मही तिस्रो देवीर्मयोभुवः ।
बर्हिः सीदन्त्वस्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
ila sarasvati mahi tisro devirmayobhuvah |
barhih sidantvasridhah ||
verses.en:
Ila, Sarasvati, Mahi, three Goddesses who bring us weal,
Be seated harmless on the grass.

verses.sa:
शिवस्त्वष्टरिहा गहि विभुः पोष उत त्मना ।
यज्ञेयज्ञे न उदव ॥
verses.rom:
shivastvashtariha gahi vibhuh posha uta tmana |
yajneyajne na udava ||
verses.en:
Rich in all plenty, Tvastar, come auspicious of thine own accord
Help us in every sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यत्र वेत्थ वनस्पते देवानां गुह्या नामानि ।
तत्र हव्यानि गामय ॥
verses.rom:
yatra vettha vanaspate devanam guhya namani |
tatra havyani gamaya ||
verses.en:
Vanaspati, wherever thou knowest the Gods' mysterious names,
Send our oblations thitherward.

verses.sa:
स्वाहाग्नये वरुणाय स्वाहेन्द्राय मरुद्भ्यः ।
स्वाहा देवेभ्यो हविः ॥
verses.rom:
svahagnaye varunaya svahendraya marudbhyah |
svaha devebhyo havih ||
verses.en:
To Agni and to Varuna, Indra, the Maruts, and the Gods,
With Svaha be oblation brought.

verses.sa:
अग्निं तं मन्ये यो वसुरस्तं यं यन्ति धेनवः ।
अस्तमर्वन्त आशवोऽस्तं नित्यासो वाजिन इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
agnim tam manye yo vasurastam yam yanti dhenavah |
astamarvanta ashavo'stam nityaso vajina isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
I VALUE Agni that good Lord, the home to which the kine return:
Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
सो अग्निर्यो वसुर्गृणे सं यमायन्ति धेनवः ।
समर्वन्तो रघुद्रुवः सं सुजातासः सूरय इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
so agniryo vasurgrine sam yamayanti dhenavah |
samarvanto raghudruvah sam sujatasah suraya isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
'Tis Agni whom we laud as good, to whom the milch-kine come in herds,
To whom the chargers swift of foot, to whom our well-born princes come. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्हि वाजिनं विशे ददाति विश्वचर्षणिः ।
अग्नी राये स्वाभुवं स प्रीतो याति वार्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhi vajinam vishe dadati vishvacharshanih |
agni raye svabhuvam sa prito yati varyamisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
Agni the God of all mankind, gives, verily, a steed to man.
Agni gives precious gear for wealth, treasure he gives when he is pleased. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
आ ते अग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम् ।
यद्ध स्या ते पनीयसी समिद्दीदयति द्यवीषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a te agna idhimahi dyumantam devajaram |
yaddha sya te paniyasi samiddidayati dyavisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
God, Agni, we will kindle thee, rich in thy splendour, fading not,
So that this glorious fuel may send forth by day its light for thee. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
आ ते अग्न ऋचा हविः शुक्रस्य शोचिषस्पते ।
सुश्चन्द्र दस्म विश्पते हव्यवाट् तुभ्यं हूयत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a te agna richa havih shukrasya shochishaspate |
sushchandra dasma vishpate havyavat tubhyam huyata isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
To thee the splendid, Lord of flame, bright, wondrous, Prince of men, is brought.
Oblation with the holy verse, O Agni, bearer of our gifts.
Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
प्रो त्ये अग्नयोऽग्निषु विश्वं पुष्यन्ति वार्यम् ।
ते हिन्विरे त इन्विरे त इषण्यन्त्यानुषगिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
pro tye agnayo'gnishu vishvam pushyanti varyam |
te hinvire ta invire ta ishanyantyanushagisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
These Agnis in the seats of the fire nourish each thing most excellent.
They give delight, they spread abroad, they move themselves continually. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो महि व्राधन्त वाजिनः ।
ये पत्वभिः शफानां व्रजा भुरन्त गोनामिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye agne archayo mahi vradhanta vajinah |
ye patvabhih shaphanam vraja bhuranta gonamisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
Agni, these brilliant flames of thine wax like strong chargers mightily,
Who with the treadings of their hoofs go swiftly to the stalls of kine. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
नवा नो अग्न आ भर स्तोतृभ्यः सुक्षितीरिषः ।
ते स्याम य आनृचुस्त्वादूतासो दमेदम इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
nava no agna a bhara stotribhyah sukshitirishah |
te syama ya anrichustvadutaso damedama isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
To us who laud thee, Agni, bring fresh food and safe and happy homes.
May we who have sung hymns to thee have thee for envoy in each house. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
उभे सुश्चन्द्र सर्पिषो दर्वी श्रीणीष आसनि ।
उतो न उत्पुपूर्या उक्थेषु शवसस्पत इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
ubhe sushchandra sarpisho darvi shrinisha asani |
uto na utpupurya uktheshu shavasaspata isham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
Thou, brilliant God, within thy mouth warmest both ladies of the oil.
So fill us also, in our hymns, abundantly, O Lord of Strength, Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
एवाँ अग्निमजुर्यमुर्गीर्भिर्यज्ञेभिरानुषक् ।
दधदस्मे सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यमिषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
evan agnimajuryamurgirbhiryajnebhiranushak |
dadhadasme suviryamuta tyadashvashvyamisham stotribhya a bhara ||
verses.en:
Thus Agni have we duly served with sacrifices and with hymns.
So may he give us what we crave, store of brave sons and fleet-foot steeds. Bring food to those who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
सखायः सं वः सम्यञ्चमिषं स्तोमं चाग्नये ।
वर्षिष्ठाय क्षितीनामूर्जो नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayah sam vah samyanchamisham stomam chagnaye |
varshishthaya kshitinamurjo naptre sahasvate ||
verses.en:
OFFER to Agni, O my friends, your seemly food, your seemly praise;
To him supremest o'er the folk, the Son of Strength, the mighty Lord:

verses.sa:
कुत्रा चिद्यस्य समृतौ रण्वा नरो नृषदने ।
अर्हन्तश्चिद्यमिन्धते संजनयन्ति जन्तवः ॥
verses.rom:
kutra chidyasya samritau ranva naro nrishadane |
arhantashchidyamindhate samjanayanti jantavah ||
verses.en:
Him in whose presence, when they meet in full assembly, men rejoice;
Even him whom worthy ones inflame, and living creatures bring to life.

verses.sa:
सं यदिषो वनामहे सं हव्या मानुषाणाम् ।
उत द्युम्नस्य शवस ऋतस्य रश्मिमा ददे ॥
verses.rom:
sam yadisho vanamahe sam havya manushanam |
uta dyumnasya shavasa ritasya rashmima dade ||
verses.en:
When we present to him the food and sacrificial gifts of men,
He by the might of splendour grasps the holy Ordinance's rein.

verses.sa:
स स्मा कृणोति केतुमा नक्तं चिद्दूर आ सते ।
पावको यद्वनस्पतीन्प्र स्मा मिनात्यजरः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sma krinoti ketuma naktam chiddura a sate |
pavako yadvanaspatinpra sma minatyajarah ||
verses.en:
He gives a signal in the night even to him who is afar,
When he, the Bright, unchanged by old, consumes the sovrans of the wood.

verses.sa:
अव स्म यस्य वेषणे स्वेदं पथिषु जुह्वति ।
अभीमह स्वजेन्यं भूमा पृष्ठेव रुरुहुः ॥
verses.rom:
ava sma yasya veshane svedam pathishu juhvati |
abhimaha svajenyam bhuma prishtheva ruruhuh ||
verses.en:
He in whose service on the ways they offer up their drops of sweat,
On him is their high kin have they mounted, as ridges on the earth.

verses.sa:
यं मर्त्यः पुरुस्पृहं विदद्विश्वस्य धायसे ।
प्र स्वादनं पितूनामस्ततातिं चिदायवे ॥
verses.rom:
yam martyah puruspriham vidadvishvasya dhayase |
pra svadanam pitunamastatatim chidayave ||
verses.en:
Whom, sought of many, mortal man hath found to be the Stay of all;
He who gives flavour to our food, the home of every man that lives.

verses.sa:
स हि ष्मा धन्वाक्षितं दाता न दात्या पशुः ।
हिरिश्मश्रुः शुचिदन्नृभुरनिभृष्टतविषिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shma dhanvakshitam data na datya pashuh |
hirishmashruh shuchidannribhuranibhrishtatavishih ||
verses.en:
Even as a herd that crops the grass he shears the field and wilderness,
With flashing teeth and beard of gold, deft with his unabated might.

verses.sa:
शुचिः ष्म यस्मा अत्रिवत्प्र स्वधितीव रीयते ।
सुषूरसूत माता क्राणा यदानशे भगम् ॥
verses.rom:
shuchih shma yasma atrivatpra svadhitiva riyate |
sushurasuta mata krana yadanashe bhagam ||
verses.en:
For him, to whom, bright as an axe he, as to Atri, hath flashed forth,
Hath the well-bearing Mother borne, producing when her time is come.

verses.sa:
आ यस्ते सर्पिरासुतेऽग्ने शमस्ति धायसे ।
ऐषु द्युम्नमुत श्रव आ चित्तं मर्त्येषु धाः ॥
verses.rom:
a yaste sarpirasute'gne shamasti dhayase |
aishu dyumnamuta shrava a chittam martyeshu dhah ||
verses.en:
Agni to whom the oil is shed by him thou lovest to support,
Bestow upon these mortals fame and splendour and intelligence.

verses.sa:
इति चिन्मन्युमध्रिजस्त्वादातमा पशुं ददे ।
आदग्ने अपृणतोऽत्रिः सासह्याद्दस्यूनिषः सासह्यान्नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
iti chinmanyumadhrijastvadatama pashum dade |
adagne aprinato'trih sasahyaddasyunishah sasahyannrin ||
verses.en:
Such zeal hath he, resistless one: he gained the cattle given by thee.
Agni, may Atri overcome the Dasyus who bestow no gifts, subdue the men who give no food.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्न ऋतायवः समीधिरे प्रत्नं प्रत्नास ऊतये सहस्कृत ।
पुरुश्चन्द्रं यजतं विश्वधायसं दमूनसं गृहपतिं वरेण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagna ritayavah samidhire pratnam pratnasa utaye sahaskrita |
purushchandram yajatam vishvadhayasam damunasam grihapatim varenyam ||
verses.en:
O AGNI urged to strength, the men of old who loved the Law enkindled thee, the Ancient, for their aid,
Thee very bright, and holy, nourisher of all, most excellent, the Friend and Master of the home.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने अतिथिं पूर्व्यं विशः शोचिष्केशं गृहपतिं नि षेदिरे ।
बृहत्केतुं पुरुरूपं धनस्पृतं सुशर्माणं स्ववसं जरद्विषम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne atithim purvyam vishah shochishkesham grihapatim ni shedire |
brihatketum pururupam dhanaspritam susharmanam svavasam jaradvisham ||
verses.en:
Thee, Agni, men have stablished as their guest of old, as Master of the household, thee, with hair of flame;
High-bannered, multiform, distributor of wealth, kind helper, good protector, drier of the floods.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने मानुषीरीळते विशो होत्राविदं विविचिं रत्नधातमम् ।
गुहा सन्तं सुभग विश्वदर्शतं तुविष्वणसं सुयजं घृतश्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne manushirilate visho hotravidam vivichim ratnadhatamam |
guha santam subhaga vishvadarshatam tuvishvanasam suyajam ghritashriyam ||
verses.en:
The tribes of men praise thee, Agni, who knowest well burnt offerings, the Discerner, lavishest of wealth,
Dwelling in secret, Blest One! visible to all, loud-roaring, skilled in worship, glorified with oil.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने धर्णसिं विश्वधा वयं गीर्भिर्गृणन्तो नमसोप सेदिम ।
स नो जुषस्व समिधानो अङ्गिरो देवो मर्तस्य यशसा सुदीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne dharnasim vishvadha vayam girbhirgrinanto namasopa sedima |
sa no jushasva samidhano angiro devo martasya yashasa suditibhih ||
verses.en:
Ever to thee, O Agni, as exceeding strong have we drawn nigh with songs and reverence singing hymns.
So be thou pleased with us, Angiras! as a God enkindled by the noble with man's goodly light.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने पुरुरूपो विशेविशे वयो दधासि प्रत्नथा पुरुष्टुत ।
पुरूण्यन्ना सहसा वि राजसि त्विषिः सा ते तित्विषाणस्य नाधृषे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne pururupo vishevishe vayo dadhasi pratnatha purushtuta |
purunyanna sahasa vi rajasi tvishih sa te titvishanasya nadhrishe ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni! multiform, God who art lauded much! givest in every house subsistence as of old.
Thou rulest by thy might o'er food of many a sort: that light of thine when blazing may not be opposed.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने समिधानं यविष्ठ्य देवा दूतं चक्रिरे हव्यवाहनम् ।
उरुज्रयसं घृतयोनिमाहुतं त्वेषं चक्षुर्दधिरे चोदयन्मति ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne samidhanam yavishthya deva dutam chakrire havyavahanam |
urujrayasam ghritayonimahutam tvesham chakshurdadhire chodayanmati ||
verses.en:
The Gods, Most Youthful Agni, have made thee, inflamed, the bearer of oblations and the messenger.
Thee, widely-reaching, homed in sacred oil, invoked, effulgent, have they made the Eye that stirs the thought.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने प्रदिव आहुतं घृतैः सुम्नायवः सुषमिधा समीधिरे ।
स वावृधान ओषधीभिरुक्षितोऽभि ज्रयांसि पार्थिवा वि तिष्ठसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne pradiva ahutam ghritaih sumnayavah sushamidha samidhire |
sa vavridhana oshadhibhirukshito'bhi jrayamsi parthiva vi tishthase ||
verses.en:
Men seeking joy have lit thee worshipped from of old, O Agni, with good fuel and with sacred oil.
So thou, bedewed and waxing mighty by the plants, spreadest thyself abroad over the realms of earth.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने हविष्मन्तो देवं मर्तास ईळते ।
मन्ये त्वा जातवेदसं स हव्या वक्ष्यानुषक् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne havishmanto devam martasa ilate |
manye tva jatavedasam sa havya vakshyanushak ||
verses.en:
BEARING; oblations mortal men, O Agni, worship thee the God.
I deem thee Jatavedas: bear our offerings, thou, unceasingly.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता दास्वतः क्षयस्य वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
सं यज्ञासश्चरन्ति यं सं वाजासः श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhota dasvatah kshayasya vriktabarhishah |
sam yajnasashcharanti yam sam vajasah shravasyavah ||
verses.en:
In the man's home who offers gifts, where grass is trimmed, Agni is Priest,
To whom all sacrifices come and strengthenings that win renown.

verses.sa:
उत स्म यं शिशुं यथा नवं जनिष्टारणी ।
धर्तारं मानुषीणां विशामग्निं स्वध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma yam shishum yatha navam janishtarani |
dhartaram manushinam vishamagnim svadhvaram ||
verses.en:
Whom, as an infant newly-born, the kindling-sticks have brought to life,
Sustainer of the tribes of men, skilled in well-ordered sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उत स्म दुर्गृभीयसे पुत्रो न ह्वार्याणाम् ।
पुरू यो दग्धासि वनाग्ने पशुर्न यवसे ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma durgribhiyase putro na hvaryanam |
puru yo dagdhasi vanagne pashurna yavase ||
verses.en:
Yea, very hard art thou to grasp, like offspring of the wriggling snakes,
When thou consumest many woods like an ox, Agni, in the mead.

verses.sa:
अध स्म यस्यार्चयः सम्यक्संयन्ति धूमिनः ।
यदीमह त्रितो दिव्युप ध्मातेव धमति शिशीते ध्मातरी यथा ॥
verses.rom:
adha sma yasyarchayah samyaksamyanti dhuminah |
yadimaha trito divyupa dhmateva dhamati shishite dhmatari yatha ||
verses.en:
Whose flames, when thou art sending forth the smoke, completely reach the mark,
When Trta in the height of heaven, like as a smelter fanneth thee, e'en as a smelter sharpeneth thee.

verses.sa:
तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्मित्रस्य च प्रशस्तिभिः ।
द्वेषोयुतो न दुरिता तुर्याम मर्त्यानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tavahamagna utibhirmitrasya cha prashastibhih |
dveshoyuto na durita turyama martyanam ||
verses.en:
O Agni, by thy succour and by Mitra's friendly furtherance,
May we, averting hate, subdue the wickedness of mortal men.

verses.sa:
तं नो अग्ने अभी नरो रयिं सहस्व आ भर ।
स क्षेपयत्स पोषयद्भुवद्वाजस्य सातय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
tam no agne abhi naro rayim sahasva a bhara |
sa kshepayatsa poshayadbhuvadvajasya sataya utaidhi pritsu no vridhe ||
verses.en:
O Agni, to our heroes bring such riches, thou victorious God.
May he protect and nourish us, and help in gaining strength: be thou near us in fight for our success.

verses.sa:
अग्न ओजिष्ठमा भर द्युम्नमस्मभ्यमध्रिगो ।
प्र नो राया परीणसा रत्सि वाजाय पन्थाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agna ojishthama bhara dyumnamasmabhyamadhrigo |
pra no raya parinasa ratsi vajaya pantham ||
verses.en:
BRING us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way.
With overflowing store of wealth mark out for us a path to strength.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अद्भुत क्रत्वा दक्षस्य मंहना ।
त्वे असुर्यमारुहत्क्राणा मित्रो न यज्ञियः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne adbhuta kratva dakshasya mamhana |
tve asuryamaruhatkrana mitro na yajniyah ||
verses.en:
Ours art thou, wondrous Agni, by wisdom and bounteousness of power.
The might of Asuras rests on thee, like Mitra worshipful in act.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्न एषां गयं पुष्टिं च वर्धय ।
ये स्तोमेभिः प्र सूरयो नरो मघान्यानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agna esham gayam pushtim cha vardhaya |
ye stomebhih pra surayo naro maghanyanashuh ||
verses.en:
Agni, increase our means of life, increase the house and home of these,
The men, the princes who have won great riches through our hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
ये अग्ने चन्द्र ते गिरः शुम्भन्त्यश्वराधसः ।
शुष्मेभिः शुष्मिणो नरो दिवश्चिद्येषां बृहत्सुकीर्तिर्बोधति त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
ye agne chandra te girah shumbhantyashvaradhasah |
shushmebhih shushmino naro divashchidyesham brihatsukirtirbodhati tmana ||
verses.en:
Bright Agni, they who deck their songs for thee have horses as their meed.
The men are mighty in their might, they whose high laud, as that of heaven, awakes thee of its own accord.

verses.sa:
तव त्ये अग्ने अर्चयो भ्राजन्तो यन्ति धृष्णुया ।
परिज्मानो न विद्युतः स्वानो रथो न वाजयुः ॥
verses.rom:
tava tye agne archayo bhrajanto yanti dhrishnuya |
parijmano na vidyutah svano ratho na vajayuh ||
verses.en:
O Agni, those resplendent flames of thine go valorously forth,
Like lightnings flashing round us, like a rattling car that seeks the spoil.

verses.sa:
नू नो अग्न ऊतये सबाधसश्च रातये ।
अस्माकासश्च सूरयो विश्वा आशास्तरीषणि ॥
verses.rom:
nu no agna utaye sabadhasashcha rataye |
asmakasashcha surayo vishva ashastarishani ||
verses.en:
Now, Agni, come to succour us; let priests draw nigh to offer gifts;
And let the patrons of our rites subdue all regions of the earth.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने अङ्गिर स्तुत स्तवान आ भर ।
होतर्विभ्वासहं रयिं स्तोतृभ्य स्तवसे च न उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne angira stuta stavana a bhara |
hotarvibhvasaham rayim stotribhya stavase cha na utaidhi pritsu no vridhe ||
verses.en:
Bring to us, Agni, Angiras, lauded of old and lauded now,
Invoker! wealth to quell the strong, that singers may extol thee. Be near us in fight for our success.

verses.sa:
जनस्य गोपा अजनिष्ट जागृविरग्निः सुदक्षः सुविताय नव्यसे ।
घृतप्रतीको बृहता दिविस्पृशा द्युमद्वि भाति भरतेभ्यः शुचिः ॥
verses.rom:
janasya gopa ajanishta jagriviragnih sudakshah suvitaya navyase |
ghritapratiko brihata divisprisha dyumadvi bhati bharatebhyah shuchih ||
verses.en:
THE watchful Guardian of the people hath been born, Agni, the very strong, for fresh prosperity.
With oil upon his face, with high heaven touching flame, he shineth splendidly, pure, for the Bharatas.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरोहितमग्निं नरस्त्रिषधस्थे समीधिरे ।
इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं स बर्हिषि सीदन्नि होता यजथाय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya ketum prathamam purohitamagnim narastrishadhasthe samidhire |
indrena devaih saratham sa barhishi sidanni hota yajathaya sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Ensign of sacrifice, the earliest Household-Priest, the. men have kindled Agni in his threefold seat,
With Indra and the Gods together on the grass let the wise Priest sit to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
असम्मृष्टो जायसे मात्रोः शुचिर्मन्द्रः कविरुदतिष्ठो विवस्वतः ।
घृतेन त्वावर्धयन्नग्न आहुत धूमस्ते केतुरभवद्दिवि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
asammrishto jayase matroh shuchirmandrah kavirudatishtho vivasvatah |
ghritena tvavardhayannagna ahuta dhumaste keturabhavaddivi shritah ||
verses.en:
Pure , unadorned, from thy two Mothers art thou born: thou camest from Vivasvan as a charming Sage.
With oil they strengthened thee, O Agni, worshipped God: thy banner was the smoke that mounted to the sky.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नो यज्ञमुप वेतु साधुयाग्निं नरो वि भरन्ते गृहेगृहे ।
अग्निर्दूतो अभवद्धव्यवाहनोऽग्निं वृणाना वृणते कविक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirno yajnamupa vetu sadhuyagnim naro vi bharante grihegrihe |
agnirduto abhavaddhavyavahano'gnim vrinana vrinate kavikratum ||
verses.en:
May Agni graciously come to our sacrifice. The men bear Agni here and there in every house.
He hath become an envoy, bearer of our gifts: electing Agni, men choose one exceeding wise.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदमग्ने मधुमत्तमं वचस्तुभ्यं मनीषा इयमस्तु शं हृदे ।
त्वां गिरः सिन्धुमिवावनीर्महीरा पृणन्ति शवसा वर्धयन्ति च ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyedamagne madhumattamam vachastubhyam manisha iyamastu sham hride |
tvam girah sindhumivavanirmahira prinanti shavasa vardhayanti cha ||
verses.en:
For thee, O Agni, is this sweetest prayer of mine: dear to thy spirit be this product of my thought.
As great streams fill the river so our song of praise fill thee, and make thee yet more mighty in thy strength.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने अङ्गिरसो गुहा हितमन्वविन्दञ्छिश्रियाणं वनेवने ।
स जायसे मथ्यमानः सहो महत्त्वामाहुः सहसस्पुत्रमङ्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne angiraso guha hitamanvavindanchhishriyanam vanevane |
sa jayase mathyamanah saho mahattvamahuh sahasasputramangirah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, the Angirases discovered thee what time thou layest hidden, fleeing back from wood to wood.
Thou by attrition art produced as conquering might, and men, O Angiras, call thee the Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
प्राग्नये बृहते यज्ञियाय ऋतस्य वृष्णे असुराय मन्म ।
घृतं न यज्ञ आस्ये सुपूतं गिरं भरे वृषभाय प्रतीचीम् ॥
verses.rom:
pragnaye brihate yajniyaya ritasya vrishne asuraya manma |
ghritam na yajna asye suputam giram bhare vrishabhaya pratichim ||
verses.en:
To Agni, lofty Asura, meet for worship, Steer of eternal Law, my prayer I offer;
I bring my song directed to the Mighty like pure oil for his mouth at sacrifices.

verses.sa:
ऋतं चिकित्व ऋतमिच्चिकिद्ध्यृतस्य धारा अनु तृन्धि पूर्वीः ।
नाहं यातुं सहसा न द्वयेन ऋतं सपाम्यरुषस्य वृष्णः ॥
verses.rom:
ritam chikitva ritamichchikiddhyritasya dhara anu trindhi purvih |
naham yatum sahasa na dvayena ritam sapamyarushasya vrishnah ||
verses.en:
Mark the Law, thou who knowest, yea, observe it: send forth the full streams of eternal Order.
I use no sorcery with might or falsehood the sacred Law of the Red Steer I follow.

verses.sa:
कया नो अग्न ऋतयन्नृतेन भुवो नवेदा उचथस्य नव्यः ।
वेदा मे देव ऋतुपा ऋतूनां नाहं पतिं सनितुरस्य रायः ॥
verses.rom:
kaya no agna ritayannritena bhuvo naveda uchathasya navyah |
veda me deva ritupa ritunam naham patim saniturasya rayah ||
verses.en:
How hast thou, follower of the Law eternal, become the knower of a new song, Agni?
The God, the Guardian of the seasons, knows me: the Lord of him who won this wealth I know not.

verses.sa:
के ते अग्ने रिपवे बन्धनासः के पायवः सनिषन्त द्युमन्तः ।
के धासिमग्ने अनृतस्य पान्ति क आसतो वचसः सन्ति गोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
ke te agne ripave bandhanasah ke payavah sanishanta dyumantah |
ke dhasimagne anritasya panti ka asato vachasah santi gopah ||
verses.en:
Who, Agni, in alliance with thy foeman, what splendid helpers won for them their riches?
Agni, who guard the dwelling-place of falsehood? Who are protectors of the speech of liars?

verses.sa:
सखायस्ते विषुणा अग्न एते शिवासः सन्तो अशिवा अभूवन् ।
अधूर्षत स्वयमेते वचोभिरृजूयते वृजिनानि ब्रुवन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayaste vishuna agna ete shivasah santo ashiva abhuvan |
adhurshata svayamete vachobhirrijuyate vrijinani bruvantah ||
verses.en:
Agni, those friends of thine have turned them from thee: gracious of old, they have become ungracious.
They have deceived themselves by their own speeches, uttering wicked words against the righteous.

verses.sa:
यस्ते अग्ने नमसा यज्ञमीट्ट ऋतं स पात्यरुषस्य वृष्णः ।
तस्य क्षयः पृथुरा साधुरेतु प्रसर्स्राणस्य नहुषस्य शेषः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste agne namasa yajnamitta ritam sa patyarushasya vrishnah |
tasya kshayah prithura sadhuretu prasarsranasya nahushasya sheshah ||
verses.en:
He who pays sacrifice to thee with homage, O Agni, keeps the Red Steer's Law eternal;
Wide is his dwelling. May the noble offspring of Nahusa who wandered forth come hither.

verses.sa:
अर्चन्तस्त्वा हवामहेऽर्चन्तः समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने अर्चन्त ऊतये ॥
verses.rom:
archantastva havamahe'rchantah samidhimahi |
agne archanta utaye ||
verses.en:
WITH songs of praise we call on thee, we kindle thee with songs of praise,
Agni, -with songs of praise, for help.

verses.sa:
अग्ने स्तोमं मनामहे सिध्रमद्य दिविस्पृशः ।
देवस्य द्रविणस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne stomam manamahe sidhramadya divisprishah |
devasya dravinasyavah ||
verses.en:
Eager for wealth, we meditate Agni's effectual praise to-day,
Praise of the God who touches heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जुषत नो गिरो होता यो मानुषेष्वा ।
स यक्षद्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjushata no giro hota yo manusheshva |
sa yakshaddaivyam janam ||
verses.en:
May Agni, Priest among mankind, take pleasure in our songs of praise,
And worship the Celestial Folk.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने सप्रथा असि जुष्टो होता वरेण्यः ।
त्वया यज्ञं वि तन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne sapratha asi jushto hota varenyah |
tvaya yajnam vi tanvate ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art spread widely forth, Priest dear and excellent; through thee
Men make the sacrifice complete.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने वाजसातमं विप्रा वर्धन्ति सुष्टुतम् ।
स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vajasatamam vipra vardhanti sushtutam |
sa no rasva suviryam ||
verses.en:
Singers exalt thee, Agni, well lauded, best giver of our strength:
So grant thou us heroic might.

verses.sa:
अग्ने नेमिरराँ इव देवाँस्त्वं परिभूरसि ।
आ राधश्चित्रमृञ्जसे ॥
verses.rom:
agne nemiraran iva devanstvam paribhurasi |
a radhashchitramrinjase ||
verses.en:
Thou Agni, as the felly rings the spokes, encompassest the Gods.
yearn for bounty manifold.

verses.sa:
अग्निं स्तोमेन बोधय समिधानो अमर्त्यम् ।
हव्या देवेषु नो दधत् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim stomena bodhaya samidhano amartyam |
havya deveshu no dadhat ||
verses.en:
ENKINDLING the Immortal, wake Agni with song of praise:
may he bear our oblations to the Gods.

verses.sa:
तमध्वरेष्वीळते देवं मर्ता अमर्त्यम् ।
यजिष्ठं मानुषे जने ॥
verses.rom:
tamadhvareshvilate devam marta amartyam |
yajishtham manushe jane ||
verses.en:
At high solemnities mortal men glorify him the Immortal, best
At sacrifice among mankind.

verses.sa:
तं हि शश्वन्त ईळते स्रुचा देवं घृतश्चुता ।
अग्निं हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.rom:
tam hi shashvanta ilate srucha devam ghritashchuta |
agnim havyaya volhave ||
verses.en:
That he may bear their gifts to heaven, all glorify him Agni, God,
With ladle that distilleth oil.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जातो अरोचत घ्नन्दस्यूञ्ज्योतिषा तमः ।
अविन्दद्गा अपः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjato arochata ghnandasyunjyotisha tamah |
avindadga apah svah ||
verses.en:
Agni shone bright when born, with light killing the Dasyus and the dark:
He found the Kine, the Floods, the Sun.

verses.sa:
अग्निमीळेन्यं कविं घृतपृष्ठं सपर्यत ।
वेतु मे शृणवद्धवम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnimilenyam kavim ghritaprishtham saparyata |
vetu me shrinavaddhavam ||
verses.en:
Serve Agni, God adorable, the Sage whose back is balmed with oil:
Let him approach, and hear my call.

verses.sa:
अग्निं घृतेन वावृधु स्तोमेभिर्विश्वचर्षणिम् ।
स्वाधीभिर्वचस्युभिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim ghritena vavridhu stomebhirvishvacharshanim |
svadhibhirvachasyubhih ||
verses.en:
They have exalted Agni, God of all mankind, with oil and hymns
Of praise, devout and eloquent.

verses.sa:
प्र वेधसे कवये वेद्याय गिरं भरे यशसे पूर्व्याय ।
घृतप्रसत्तो असुरः सुशेवो रायो धर्ता धरुणो वस्वो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vedhase kavaye vedyaya giram bhare yashase purvyaya |
ghritaprasatto asurah sushevo rayo dharta dharuno vasvo agnih ||
verses.en:
To him, the far-renowned, the wise Ordainer, ancient and glorious, a song I offer.
Enthroned in oil, the Asura, bliss-giver, is Agni, firm support of noble, riches.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन ऋतं धरुणं धारयन्त यज्ञस्य शाके परमे व्योमन् ।
दिवो धर्मन्धरुणे सेदुषो नॄञ्जातैरजाताँ अभि ये ननक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
ritena ritam dharunam dharayanta yajnasya shake parame vyoman |
divo dharmandharune sedusho nrinjatairajatan abhi ye nanakshuh ||
verses.en:
By holy Law they kept supporting Order, by help of sacrifice, in loftiest heaven,-
They who attained with born men to the unborn, men seated on that stay, heaven's firm sustainer.

verses.sa:
अङ्होयुवस्तन्वस्तन्वते वि वयो महद्दुष्टरं पूर्व्याय ।
स संवतो नवजातस्तुतुर्यात्सिङ्हं न क्रुद्धमभितः परि ष्ठुः ॥
verses.rom:
anhoyuvastanvastanvate vi vayo mahaddushtaram purvyaya |
sa samvato navajatastuturyatsinham na kruddhamabhitah pari shthuh ||
verses.en:
Averting woe, they labour hard to bring him, the ancient, plenteous food as power resistless.
May he, born newly, conquer his assailants: round him they stand as round an angry lion.

verses.sa:
मातेव यद्भरसे पप्रथानो जनंजनं धायसे चक्षसे च ।
वयोवयो जरसे यद्दधानः परि त्मना विषुरूपो जिगासि ॥
verses.rom:
mateva yadbharase paprathano janamjanam dhayase chakshase cha |
vayovayo jarase yaddadhanah pari tmana vishurupo jigasi ||
verses.en:
When, like a mother, spreading forth to nourish, to cherish and regard each man that liveth,-
Consuming all the strength that thou hast gotten, thou wanderest round, thyself, in varied fashion.

verses.sa:
वाजो नु ते शवसस्पात्वन्तमुरुं दोघं धरुणं देव रायः ।
पदं न तायुर्गुहा दधानो महो राये चितयन्नत्रिमस्पः ॥
verses.rom:
vajo nu te shavasaspatvantamurum dogham dharunam deva rayah |
padam na tayurguha dadhano maho raye chitayannatrimaspah ||
verses.en:
May strength preserve the compass of thy vigour, God! that broad stream of thine that beareth riches.
Thou, like a thief who keeps his refuge secret, hast holpen Atri to great wealth, by teaching.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वयो हि भानवेऽर्चा देवायाग्नये ।
यं मित्रं न प्रशस्तिभिर्मर्तासो दधिरे पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
brihadvayo hi bhanave'rcha devayagnaye |
yam mitram na prashastibhirmartaso dadhire purah ||
verses.en:
GREAT power is in the beam of light, sing praise to, Agni, to the God
Whom men have set in foremost place like Mitra with their eulogies.

verses.sa:
स हि द्युभिर्जनानां होता दक्षस्य बाह्वोः ।
वि हव्यमग्निरानुषग्भगो न वारमृण्वति ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi dyubhirjananam hota dakshasya bahvoh |
vi havyamagniranushagbhago na varamrinvati ||
verses.en:
He by the splendour of his arms is Priest of every able man.
Agni conveys oblation straight, and deals, as Bhaga deals, his boons.

verses.sa:
अस्य स्तोमे मघोनः सख्ये वृद्धशोचिषः ।
विश्वा यस्मिन्तुविष्वणि समर्ये शुष्ममादधुः ॥
verses.rom:
asya stome maghonah sakhye vriddhashochishah |
vishva yasmintuvishvani samarye shushmamadadhuh ||
verses.en:
All rests upon the laud and love of him the rich, high-flaming God,
On whom, loud-roaring, men have laid great strength as on a faithful friend.

verses.sa:
अधा ह्यग्न एषां सुवीर्यस्य मंहना ।
तमिद्यह्वं न रोदसी परि श्रवो बभूवतुः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hyagna esham suviryasya mamhana |
tamidyahvam na rodasi pari shravo babhuvatuh ||
verses.en:
So, Agni, be the Friend of these with liberal gift of hero strength.
Yea, Heaven and Earth have not surpassed this Youthful One in glorious fame.

verses.sa:
नू न एहि वार्यमग्ने गृणान आ भर ।
ये वयं ये च सूरयः स्वस्ति धामहे सचोतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
nu na ehi varyamagne grinana a bhara |
ye vayam ye cha surayah svasti dhamahe sachotaidhi pritsu no vridhe ||
verses.en:
O Agni, quickly come to us, and, glorified, bring precious wealth.
So we and these our princes will assemble for the good of all. Be near in fight to prosper us.

verses.sa:
आ यज्ञैर्देव मर्त्य इत्था तव्यांसमूतये ।
अग्निं कृते स्वध्वरे पूरुरीळीतावसे ॥
verses.rom:
a yajnairdeva martya ittha tavyamsamutaye |
agnim krite svadhvare pururilitavase ||
verses.en:
GOD, may a mortal call the Strong hither, with solemn rites, to aid,
A man call Agni to protect when sacrifice is well prepared.

verses.sa:
अस्य हि स्वयशस्तर आसा विधर्मन्मन्यसे ।
तं नाकं चित्रशोचिषं मन्द्रं परो मनीषया ॥
verses.rom:
asya hi svayashastara asa vidharmanmanyase |
tam nakam chitrashochisham mandram paro manishaya ||
verses.en:
Near him thou seemest mightier still in native glory, set to hold
Apart yon flame-hued vault of heaven, lovely beyond the thought of man.

verses.sa:
अस्य वासा उ अर्चिषा य आयुक्त तुजा गिरा ।
दिवो न यस्य रेतसा बृहच्छोचन्त्यर्चयः ॥
verses.rom:
asya vasa u archisha ya ayukta tuja gira |
divo na yasya retasa brihachchhochantyarchayah ||
verses.en:
Yea, this is by the light of him whom powerful song hath bound to act,
Whose beams of splendour flash on high as though they sprang from heavenly seed.

verses.sa:
अस्य क्रत्वा विचेतसो दस्मस्य वसु रथ आ ।
अधा विश्वासु हव्योऽग्निर्विक्षु प्र शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
asya kratva vichetaso dasmasya vasu ratha a |
adha vishvasu havyo'gnirvikshu pra shasyate ||
verses.en:
Wealth loads the Wonder-Worker's car through his, the very wise One's power.
Then, meet to be invoked among all tribes, is Agni glorified.

verses.sa:
नू न इद्धि वार्यमासा सचन्त सूरयः ।
ऊर्जो नपादभिष्टये पाहि शग्धि स्वस्तय उतैधि पृत्सु नो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
nu na iddhi varyamasa sachanta surayah |
urjo napadabhishtaye pahi shagdhi svastaya utaidhi pritsu no vridhe ||
verses.en:
Now, too, the princes shall obtain excellent riches by our lips.
Protect us for our welfare: lend thy succour, O thou Son of Strength. Be near in fight to prosper us.

verses.sa:
प्रातरग्निः पुरुप्रियो विश स्तवेतातिथिः ।
विश्वानि यो अमर्त्यो हव्या मर्तेषु रण्यति ॥
verses.rom:
prataragnih purupriyo visha stavetatithih |
vishvani yo amartyo havya marteshu ranyati ||
verses.en:
AT dawn let: Agni, much-beloved guest of the house, be glorified;
Immortal who delights in all oblations brought by mortal men.

verses.sa:
द्विताय मृक्तवाहसे स्वस्य दक्षस्य मंहना ।
इन्दुं स धत्त आनुषक्स्तोता चित्ते अमर्त्य ॥
verses.rom:
dvitaya mriktavahase svasya dakshasya mamhana |
indum sa dhatta anushakstota chitte amartya ||
verses.en:
For Dvita who receives through wealth of native strength maimed offerings,
Thy praiser even gains at once the Soma-drops, Immortal Gods!

verses.sa:
तं वो दीर्घायुशोचिषं गिरा हुवे मघोनाम् ।
अरिष्टो येषां रथो व्यश्वदावन्नीयते ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dirghayushochisham gira huve maghonam |
arishto yesham ratho vyashvadavanniyate ||
verses.en:
Nobles, with song I call that car of yours that shines with lengthened life,
For, God who givest steeds! that car hither and thither goes unharmed.

verses.sa:
चित्रा वा येषु दीधितिरासन्नुक्था पान्ति ये ।
स्तीर्णं बर्हिः स्वर्णरे श्रवांसि दधिरे परि ॥
verses.rom:
chitra va yeshu didhitirasannuktha panti ye |
stirnam barhih svarnare shravamsi dadhire pari ||
verses.en:
They who have varied ways of thought, who guard, the lauds within their lips,
And strew the grass before the light, have decked themselves with high renown.

verses.sa:
ये मे पञ्चाशतं ददुरश्वानां सधस्तुति ।
द्युमदग्ने महि श्रवो बृहत्कृधि मघोनां नृवदमृत नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye me panchashatam dadurashvanam sadhastuti |
dyumadagne mahi shravo brihatkridhi maghonam nrivadamrita nrinam ||
verses.en:
Immortal Agni, give the chiefs, heroes who institute the rite,
Heroes' illustrious, lofty fame, who at the synod met for praise presented me with fifty steeds.

verses.sa:
अभ्यवस्थाः प्र जायन्ते प्र वव्रेर्वव्रिश्चिकेत ।
उपस्थे मातुर्वि चष्टे ॥
verses.rom:
abhyavasthah pra jayante pra vavrervavrishchiketa |
upasthe maturvi chashte ||
verses.en:
ONE state begets another state: husk is made visible from husk:
Within his Mother's side he speaks.

verses.sa:
जुहुरे वि चितयन्तोऽनिमिषं नृम्णं पान्ति ।
आ दृळ्हां पुरं विविशुः ॥
verses.rom:
juhure vi chitayanto'nimisham nrimnam panti |
a drilham puram vivishuh ||
verses.en:
Discerning, have they offered gifts: they guard the strength that never wastes.
To a strong fort have they pressed in.

verses.sa:
आ श्वैत्रेयस्य जन्तवो द्युमद्वर्धन्त कृष्टयः ।
निष्कग्रीवो बृहदुक्थ एना मध्वा न वाजयुः ॥
verses.rom:
a shvaitreyasya jantavo dyumadvardhanta krishtayah |
nishkagrivo brihaduktha ena madhva na vajayuh ||
verses.en:
Svaitreya's people, all his men, have gloriously increased in might.
A gold chain Brhaduktha wears, as, through this Soma, seeking spoil.

verses.sa:
प्रियं दुग्धं न काम्यमजामि जाम्योः सचा ।
घर्मो न वाजजठरोऽदब्धः शश्वतो दभः ॥
verses.rom:
priyam dugdham na kamyamajami jamyoh sacha |
gharmo na vajajatharo'dabdhah shashvato dabhah ||
verses.en:
I bring, as 'twere, the longed-for milk, the dear milk of the Sister-Pair.
Like to a caldron filled with food is he, unconquered, conquering all.

verses.sa:
क्रीळन्नो रश्म आ भुवः सं भस्मना वायुना वेविदानः ।
ता अस्य सन्धृषजो न तिग्माः सुसंशिता वक्ष्यो वक्षणेस्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
krilanno rashma a bhuvah sam bhasmana vayuna vevidanah |
ta asya sandhrishajo na tigmah susamshita vakshyo vakshanesthah ||
verses.en:
Beam of light, come to us in sportive fashion, finding thyself close to the wind that fans thee.
These flames of his are wasting flames, like arrows keen-pointed, sharpened, on his breast.

verses.sa:
यमग्ने वाजसातम त्वं चिन्मन्यसे रयिम् ।
तं नो गीर्भिः श्रवाय्यं देवत्रा पनया युजम् ॥
verses.rom:
yamagne vajasatama tvam chinmanyase rayim |
tam no girbhih shravayyam devatra panaya yujam ||
verses.en:
AGNI, best winner of the spoil, cause us to praise before the Gods
As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which thou verily deemest wealth.

verses.sa:
ये अग्ने नेरयन्ति ते वृद्धा उग्रस्य शवसः ।
अप द्वेषो अप ह्वरोऽन्यव्रतस्य सश्चिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ye agne nerayanti te vriddha ugrasya shavasah |
apa dvesho apa hvaro'nyavratasya sashchire ||
verses.en:
Agni, the great who ward not off the anger of thy power and might
Stir up the wrath and hatred due to one who holds an alien creed.

verses.sa:
होतारं त्वा वृणीमहेऽग्ने दक्षस्य साधनम् ।
यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं गिरा प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
hotaram tva vrinimahe'gne dakshasya sadhanam |
yajneshu purvyam gira prayasvanto havamahe ||
verses.en:
Thee, Agni, would we choose as Priest, the perfecter of strength and skill;
We who bring sacred food invoke with song thee Chief at holy rites.

verses.sa:
इत्था यथा त ऊतये सहसावन्दिवेदिवे ।
राय ऋताय सुक्रतो गोभिः ष्याम सधमादो वीरैः स्याम सधमादः ॥
verses.rom:
ittha yatha ta utaye sahasavandivedive |
raya ritaya sukrato gobhih shyama sadhamado viraih syama sadhamadah ||
verses.en:
Here as is needful for thine aid we toil, O Conqueror, day by day,
For wealth, for Law. May we rejoice, Most Wise One! at the feast, with kine, rejoice, with heroes, at the feast.

verses.sa:
मनुष्वत्त्वा नि धीमहि मनुष्वत्समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने मनुष्वदङ्गिरो देवान्देवयते यज ॥
verses.rom:
manushvattva ni dhimahi manushvatsamidhimahi |
agne manushvadangiro devandevayate yaja ||
verses.en:
WE stablish thee as Manus used, as Manus used we kindle thee.
Like Manus, for the pious man , Angiras, Agni, worship Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि मानुषे जनेऽग्ने सुप्रीत इध्यसे ।
स्रुचस्त्वा यन्त्यानुषक्सुजात सर्पिरासुते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi manushe jane'gne suprita idhyase |
sruchastva yantyanushaksujata sarpirasute ||
verses.en:
For well, O Agni, art thou pleased when thou art kindled mid mankind.
Straight go the ladles unto thee, thou highborn God whose food is oil.

verses.sa:
त्वां विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत ।
सपर्यन्तस्त्वा कवे यज्ञेषु देवमीळते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishve sajoshaso devaso dutamakrata |
saparyantastva kave yajneshu devamilate ||
verses.en:
Thee have all Gods of one accord established as their messenger.
Serving at sacrifices men adore thee as a God, O Sage.

verses.sa:
देवं वो देवयज्ययाग्निमीळीत मर्त्यः ।
समिद्धः शुक्र दीदिह्यृतस्य योनिमासदः ससस्य योनिमासदः ॥
verses.rom:
devam vo devayajyayagnimilita martyah |
samiddhah shukra didihyritasya yonimasadah sasasya yonimasadah ||
verses.en:
Let mortal man adore your God, Agni, with worship due to Gods.
Shine forth enkindled, Radiant One. Sit in the chamber of the Law, sit in the chamber of the food.

verses.sa:
प्र विश्वसामन्नत्रिवदर्चा पावकशोचिषे ।
यो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
verses.rom:
pra vishvasamannatrivadarcha pavakashochishe |
yo adhvareshvidyo hota mandratamo vishi ||
verses.en:
LIKE Atri, Visvasaman! sing to him of purifying light,
Who must be praised in holy rites, the Priest most welcome in the house.

verses.sa:
न्यग्निं जातवेदसं दधाता देवमृत्विजम् ।
प्र यज्ञ एत्वानुषगद्या देवव्यचस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
nyagnim jatavedasam dadhata devamritvijam |
pra yajna etvanushagadya devavyachastamah ||
verses.en:
Set Jatavedas in his place, Agni the God and Minister.
Let sacrifice proceed to-day duly, comprising all the Gods.

verses.sa:
चिकित्विन्मनसं त्वा देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।
वरेण्यस्य तेऽवस इयानासो अमन्महि ॥
verses.rom:
chikitvinmanasam tva devam martasa utaye |
varenyasya te'vasa iyanaso amanmahi ||
verses.en:
All mortals come to thee for aid, the God of most observant mind.
Of thine excelling favour we bethink us as we long for it.

verses.sa:
अग्ने चिकिद्ध्यस्य न इदं वचः सहस्य ।
तं त्वा सुशिप्र दम्पते स्तोमैर्वर्धन्त्यत्रयो गीर्भिः शुम्भन्त्यत्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
agne chikiddhyasya na idam vachah sahasya |
tam tva sushipra dampate stomairvardhantyatrayo girbhih shumbhantyatrayah ||
verses.en:
Mark with attention this our speech, O Agni, thou victorious One.
Thee, Strong-jawed! as the homestead's Lord, the Atris with their lauds exalt, the Atris beautify with songs.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सहन्तमा भर द्युम्नस्य प्रासहा रयिम् ।
विश्वा यश्चर्षणीरभ्यासा वाजेषु सासहत् ॥
verses.rom:
agne sahantama bhara dyumnasya prasaha rayim |
vishva yashcharshanirabhyasa vajeshu sasahat ||
verses.en:
By thy fair splendour's mighty power, O Agni, bring victorious wealth,
Wealth that o'ercometh all mankind, and, near us, conquereth in fight.

verses.sa:
तमग्ने पृतनाषहं रयिं सहस्व आ भर ।
त्वं हि सत्यो अद्भुतो दाता वाजस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
tamagne pritanashaham rayim sahasva a bhara |
tvam hi satyo adbhuto data vajasya gomatah ||
verses.en:
Victorious Agni, bring to us the wealth that vanquisheth in war;
For thou art wonderful and true, giver of strength in herds of kine.

verses.sa:
विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
होतारं सद्मसु प्रियं व्यन्ति वार्या पुरु ॥
verses.rom:
vishve hi tva sajoshaso janaso vriktabarhishah |
hotaram sadmasu priyam vyanti varya puru ||
verses.en:
For all the folk with one accord, whose sacred grass is trimmed and strewn,
Invite thee to their worship-halls, as a dear Priest, for choicest wealth.

verses.sa:
स हि ष्मा विश्वचर्षणिरभिमाति सहो दधे ।
अग्न एषु क्षयेष्वा रेवन्नः शुक्र दीदिहि द्युमत्पावक दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi shma vishvacharshanirabhimati saho dadhe |
agna eshu kshayeshva revannah shukra didihi dyumatpavaka didihi ||
verses.en:
For he, the God of all men, hath gotten him might that quelleth foes.
O Agni, in these homes shine forth, bright God! for our prosperity, shine, Purifier! splendidly.

verses.sa: अग्ने त्वं नो अन्तम उत त्राता शिवो भवा वरूथ्यः ॥
verses.rom: agne tvam no antama uta trata shivo bhava varuthyah ||
verses.en: O AGNI, be our nearest Friend, be thou a kind deliverer and a gracious Friend.

verses.sa: वसुरग्निर्वसुश्रवा अच्छा नक्षि द्युमत्तमं रयिं दाः ॥
verses.rom: vasuragnirvasushrava achchha nakshi dyumattamam rayim dah ||
verses.en: Excellent Agni, come thou nigh to us, and give us wealth most splendidly renowned.

verses.sa: स नो बोधि श्रुधी हवमुरुष्या णो अघायतः समस्मात् ॥
verses.rom: sa no bodhi shrudhi havamurushya no aghayatah samasmat ||
verses.en: So hear us, listen to this call of ours, and keep us far from every sinful man.

verses.sa: तं त्वा शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सुम्नाय नूनमीमहे सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom: tam tva shochishtha didivah sumnaya nunamimahe sakhibhyah ||
verses.en: To thee then, O Most Bright, O Radiant God, we come with prayer for happiness for our friends.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वो अग्निमवसे देवं गासि स नो वसुः ।
रासत्पुत्र ऋषूणामृतावा पर्षति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha vo agnimavase devam gasi sa no vasuh |
rasatputra rishunamritava parshati dvishah ||
verses.en:
I WILL sing near, for grace, your God Agni, for he is good to us.
Son of the Brands, may he give gifts, and, righteous, save us from the foe.

verses.sa:
स हि सत्यो यं पूर्वे चिद्देवासश्चिद्यमीधिरे ।
होतारं मन्द्रजिह्वमित्सुदीतिभिर्विभावसुम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi satyo yam purve chiddevasashchidyamidhire |
hotaram mandrajihvamitsuditibhirvibhavasum ||
verses.en:
For be is true, whom men of old enkindled, and the Gods themselves,
The Priest with the delicious tongue, rich with the light of glorious beams.

verses.sa:
स नो धीती वरिष्ठया श्रेष्ठया च सुमत्या ।
अग्ने रायो दिदीहि नः सुवृक्तिभिर्वरेण्य ॥
verses.rom:
sa no dhiti varishthaya shreshthaya cha sumatya |
agne rayo didihi nah suvriktibhirvarenya ||
verses.en:
With wisdom that surpasseth all, with gracious will most excellent,
O Agni, worthy of our choice, shine wealth on us through hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवेषु राजत्यग्निर्मर्तेष्वाविशन् ।
अग्निर्नो हव्यवाहनोऽग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdeveshu rajatyagnirmarteshvavishan |
agnirno havyavahano'gnim dhibhih saparyata ||
verses.en:
Agni is King, for he extends to mortals and to Gods alike.
Agni is bearer of our gifts. Worship ye Agni with your thoughts.

verses.sa:
अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमं तुविब्रह्माणमुत्तमम् ।
अतूर्तं श्रावयत्पतिं पुत्रं ददाति दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
agnistuvishravastamam tuvibrahmanamuttamam |
aturtam shravayatpatim putram dadati dashushe ||
verses.en:
Agni gives to the worshipper a son, the best, of mightiest fame,
Of deep devotion, ne'er subdued, bringer of glory to his sire.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्ददाति सत्पतिं सासाह यो युधा नृभिः ।
अग्निरत्यं रघुष्यदं जेतारमपराजितम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdadati satpatim sasaha yo yudha nribhih |
agniratyam raghushyadam jetaramaparajitam ||
verses.en:
Agni bestows the hero-lord who conquers with the men in fight.
Agni bestows the fleet-foot steed, the victor never overcome.

verses.sa:
यद्वाहिष्ठं तदग्नये बृहदर्च विभावसो ।
महिषीव त्वद्रयिस्त्वद्वाजा उदीरते ॥
verses.rom:
yadvahishtham tadagnaye brihadarcha vibhavaso |
mahishiva tvadrayistvadvaja udirate ||
verses.en:
The mightiest song is Agni's: shine on high, thou who art rich in light.
Like the Chief Consort of a King, riches and strength proceed -from thee.

verses.sa:
तव द्युमन्तो अर्चयो ग्रावेवोच्यते बृहत् ।
उतो ते तन्यतुर्यथा स्वानो अर्त त्मना दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tava dyumanto archayo gravevochyate brihat |
uto te tanyaturyatha svano arta tmana divah ||
verses.en:
Resplendent are thy rays of light: loud is thy voice like pressing-stones.
Yea, of itself thy thunder goes forth like the roaring of the heaven.

verses.sa:
एवाँ अग्निं वसूयवः सहसानं ववन्दिम ।
स नो विश्वा अति द्विषः पर्षन्नावेव सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
evan agnim vasuyavah sahasanam vavandima |
sa no vishva ati dvishah parshannaveva sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Thus, seeking riches, have we paid homage to Agni Conqueror.
May he, most wise, as with a ship, carry us over all our foes.

verses.sa:
अग्ने पावक रोचिषा मन्द्रया देव जिह्वया ।
आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
agne pavaka rochisha mandraya deva jihvaya |
a devanvakshi yakshi cha ||
verses.en:
O AGNI, Holy and Divine, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue
Bring hither and adore the Gods.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा घृतस्नवीमहे चित्रभानो स्वर्दृशम् ।
देवाँ आ वीतये वह ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva ghritasnavimahe chitrabhano svardrisham |
devan a vitaye vaha ||
verses.en:
We pray thee, thou who droppest oil, bright-rayed! who lookest on the Sun,
Bring the Gods hither to the feast.

verses.sa:
वीतिहोत्रं त्वा कवे द्युमन्तं समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने बृहन्तमध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
vitihotram tva kave dyumantam samidhimahi |
agne brihantamadhvare ||
verses.en:
We have enkindled thee, O Sage, bright caller of the Gods to feast.
O Agni, great in Sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विश्वेभिरा गहि देवेभिर्हव्यदातये ।
होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
agne vishvebhira gahi devebhirhavyadataye |
hotaram tva vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
O Agni, come with all the Gods, come to our sacrificial gift:
We choose thee as Invoking Priest.

verses.sa:
यजमानाय सुन्वत आग्ने सुवीर्यं वह ।
देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
yajamanaya sunvata agne suviryam vaha |
devaira satsi barhishi ||
verses.en:
Bring, Agni, to the worshipper who pours the juice, heroic strength:
Sit with the Gods upon the grass.

verses.sa:
समिधानः सहस्रजिदग्ने धर्माणि पुष्यसि ।
देवानां दूत उक्थ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
samidhanah sahasrajidagne dharmani pushyasi |
devanam duta ukthyah ||
verses.en:
Victor of thousands, Agni, thou, enkindled, cherishest the laws,
Laud-worthy, envoy of the Gods.

verses.sa:
न्यग्निं जातवेदसं होत्रवाहं यविष्ठ्यम् ।
दधाता देवमृत्विजम् ॥
verses.rom:
nyagnim jatavedasam hotravaham yavishthyam |
dadhata devamritvijam ||
verses.en:
Set Agni Jatavedas down, the bearer of our sacred gifts,
Most Youthful, God and Minister.

verses.sa:
प्र यज्ञ एत्वानुषगद्या देवव्यचस्तमः ।
स्तृणीत बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
pra yajna etvanushagadya devavyachastamah |
strinita barhirasade ||
verses.en:
Duly proceed our sacrifice, comprising all the Gods, to-day:
Strew holy grass to be their seat.

verses.sa:
एदं मरुतो अश्विना मित्रः सीदन्तु वरुणः ।
देवासः सर्वया विशा ॥
verses.rom:
edam maruto ashvina mitrah sidantu varunah |
devasah sarvaya visha ||
verses.en:
So may the Maruts sit thereon, the Asvins, Mitra, Varuna:
The Gods with all their company.

verses.sa:
अनस्वन्ता सत्पतिर्मामहे मे गावा चेतिष्ठो असुरो मघोनः ।
त्रैवृष्णो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैर्वैश्वानर त्र्यरुणश्चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
anasvanta satpatirmamahe me gava chetishtho asuro maghonah |
traivrishno agne dashabhih sahasrairvaishvanara tryarunashchiketa ||
verses.en:
THE Godlike hero, famousest of nobles, hath granted me two oxen with a wagon.
Trvrsan's son Tryaruna hath distinguished himself, Vaisvanara Agni! with ten thousands.

verses.sa:
यो मे शता च विंशतिं च गोनां हरी च युक्ता सुधुरा ददाति ।
वैश्वानर सुष्टुतो वावृधानोऽग्ने यच्छ त्र्यरुणाय शर्म ॥
verses.rom:
yo me shata cha vimshatim cha gonam hari cha yukta sudhura dadati |
vaishvanara sushtuto vavridhano'gne yachchha tryarunaya sharma ||
verses.en:
Protect Tryaruna, as thou art waxing strong and art highly praised, Vaisvanara Agni!
Who granteth me a hundred kine and twenty, and two bay horses, good at draught, and harnessed.

verses.sa:
एवा ते अग्ने सुमतिं चकानो नविष्ठाय नवमं त्रसदस्युः ।
यो मे गिरस्तुविजातस्य पूर्वीर्युक्तेनाभि त्र्यरुणो गृणाति ॥
verses.rom:
eva te agne sumatim chakano navishthaya navamam trasadasyuh |
yo me girastuvijatasya purviryuktenabhi tryaruno grinati ||
verses.en:
So Trasadasyu served thee, God Most Youthful, craving thy favour for the ninth time, Agni;
Tryaruya who with attentive spirit accepteth many a song from me the mighty.

verses.sa:
यो म इति प्रवोचत्यश्वमेधाय सूरये ।
दददृचा सनिं यते ददन्मेधामृतायते ॥
verses.rom:
yo ma iti pravochatyashvamedhaya suraye |
dadadricha sanim yate dadanmedhamritayate ||
verses.en:
He who declares his wish to me, to Asvamedha, to the Prince,
Pays him who with his verse seeks gain, gives power to him who keeps the Law.

verses.sa:
यस्य मा परुषाः शतमुद्धर्षयन्त्युक्षणः ।
अश्वमेधस्य दानाः सोमा इव त्र्याशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya ma parushah shatamuddharshayantyukshanah |
ashvamedhasya danah soma iva tryashirah ||
verses.en:
From whom a hundred oxen, all of speckled hue, delight my heart,
The gifts of Asvamedha, like thrice-mingled draughts of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी शतदाव्न्यश्वमेधे सुवीर्यम् ।
क्षत्रं धारयतं बृहद्दिवि सूर्यमिवाजरम् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni shatadavnyashvamedhe suviryam |
kshatram dharayatam brihaddivi suryamivajaram ||
verses.en:
To Asvamedha who bestows a hundred gifts grant hero power,
O Indra-Agni! lofty rule like the unwasting Sun in heaven.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्निर्दिवि शोचिरश्रेत्प्रत्यङ्ङुषसमुर्विया वि भाति ।
एति प्राची विश्ववारा नमोभिर्देवाँ ईळाना हविषा घृताची ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho agnirdivi shochirashretpratyannushasamurviya vi bhati |
eti prachi vishvavara namobhirdevan ilana havisha ghritachi ||
verses.en:
AGNI inflamed hath sent to heaven his lustre: he shines forth widely turning unto Morning.
Eastward the ladle goes that brings all blessing, praising the Godswith homage and oblation.

verses.sa:
समिध्यमानो अमृतस्य राजसि हविष्कृण्वन्तं सचसे स्वस्तये ।
विश्वं स धत्ते द्रविणं यमिन्वस्यातिथ्यमग्ने नि च धत्त इत्पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
samidhyamano amritasya rajasi havishkrinvantam sachase svastaye |
vishvam sa dhatte dravinam yaminvasyatithyamagne ni cha dhatta itpurah ||
verses.en:
Enkindled, thou art King of the immortal world: him who brings offerings thou attendest for his weal.
He whom thou urgest on makes all possessions his: he sets before thee, Agni, gifts that guests may claim.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शर्ध महते सौभगाय तव द्युम्नान्युत्तमानि सन्तु ।
सं जास्पत्यं सुयममा कृणुष्व शत्रूयतामभि तिष्ठा महांसि ॥
verses.rom:
agne shardha mahate saubhagaya tava dyumnanyuttamani santu |
sam jaspatyam suyamama krinushva shatruyatamabhi tishtha mahamsi ||
verses.en:
Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni, most excellent be thine effulgent splendours.
Make easy to maintain our household lordship, and overcome the might of those who hate us.

verses.sa:
समिद्धस्य प्रमहसोऽग्ने वन्दे तव श्रियम् ।
वृषभो द्युम्नवाँ असि समध्वरेष्विध्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
samiddhasya pramahaso'gne vande tava shriyam |
vrishabho dyumnavan asi samadhvareshvidhyase ||
verses.en:
Thy glory, Agni, I adore, kindled, exalted in thy strength.
A Steer of brilliant splendour, thou art lighted well at sacred rites.

verses.sa:
समिद्धो अग्न आहुत देवान्यक्षि स्वध्वर ।
त्वं हि हव्यवाळसि ॥
verses.rom:
samiddho agna ahuta devanyakshi svadhvara |
tvam hi havyavalasi ||
verses.en:
Agni, invoked and kindled, serve the Gods, thou skilled in sacrifice:
For thou art bearer of our gifts.

verses.sa:
आ जुहोता दुवस्यताग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
वृणीध्वं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
verses.rom:
a juhota duvasyatagnim prayatyadhvare |
vrinidhvam havyavahanam ||
verses.en:
Invoke and worship Agni while the sacrificial rite proceeds:
For offering-bearer choose ye him.

verses.sa:
त्र्यर्यमा मनुषो देवताता त्री रोचना दिव्या धारयन्त ।
अर्चन्ति त्वा मरुतः पूतदक्षास्त्वमेषामृषिरिन्द्रासि धीरः ॥
verses.rom:
tryaryama manusho devatata tri rochana divya dharayanta |
archanti tva marutah putadakshastvameshamrishirindrasi dhirah ||
verses.en:
MAN'S worship of the Gods hath three great lustres, and three celestial lights have they established
The Maruts gifted with pure strength adore thee, for thou, O Indra, art their sapient Rsi.

verses.sa:
अनु यदीं मरुतो मन्दसानमार्चन्निन्द्रं पपिवांसं सुतस्य ।
आदत्त वज्रमभि यदहिं हन्नपो यह्वीरसृजत्सर्तवा उ ॥
verses.rom:
anu yadim maruto mandasanamarchannindram papivamsam sutasya |
adatta vajramabhi yadahim hannapo yahvirasrijatsartava u ||
verses.en:
What time the Maruts sang their song to Indra, joyous when he had drunk of Soma juices,
He grasped his thunderbolt to slay the Dragon, and loosed, that they might flow, the youthful Waters.

verses.sa:
उत ब्रह्माणो मरुतो मे अस्येन्द्रः सोमस्य सुषुतस्य पेयाः ।
तद्धि हव्यं मनुषे गा अविन्ददहन्नहिं पपिवाँ इन्द्रो अस्य ॥
verses.rom:
uta brahmano maruto me asyendrah somasya sushutasya peyah |
taddhi havyam manushe ga avindadahannahim papivan indro asya ||
verses.en:
And, O ye Brahmans, Maruts, so may Indra drink draughts of this my carefully pressed Sorna;
For this oblation found for man the cattle, and Indra, having quaffed it, slew the Dragon.

verses.sa:
आद्रोदसी वितरं वि ष्कभायत्संविव्यानश्चिद्भियसे मृगं कः ।
जिगर्तिमिन्द्रो अपजर्गुराणः प्रति श्वसन्तमव दानवं हन् ॥
verses.rom:
adrodasi vitaram vi shkabhayatsamvivyanashchidbhiyase mrigam kah |
jigartimindro apajarguranah prati shvasantamava danavam han ||
verses.en:
Then heaven and earth he sundered and supported: wrapped even in these he struck the Beast with terror.
So Indra forced the Engulfer to disgorgement, and slew the Danava. panting against him.

verses.sa:
अध क्रत्वा मघवन्तुभ्यं देवा अनु विश्वे अददुः सोमपेयम् ।
यत्सूर्यस्य हरितः पतन्तीः पुरः सतीरुपरा एतशे कः ॥
verses.rom:
adha kratva maghavantubhyam deva anu vishve adaduh somapeyam |
yatsuryasya haritah patantih purah satirupara etashe kah ||
verses.en:
Thus all the Gods, O Maghavan, delivered to thee of their free will the draught of Soma;
When thou for Etasa didst cause to tarry the flying mares of Surya racing forward.

verses.sa:
नव यदस्य नवतिं च भोगान्साकं वज्रेण मघवा विवृश्चत् ।
अर्चन्तीन्द्रं मरुतः सधस्थे त्रैष्टुभेन वचसा बाधत द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
nava yadasya navatim cha bhogansakam vajrena maghava vivrishchat |
archantindram marutah sadhasthe traishtubhena vachasa badhata dyam ||
verses.en:
When Maghavan with the thunderbolt demolished his nine-and-ninety castles all together,
The Maruts, where they met, glorified Indra: ye with the Trstup hymn obstructed heaven.

verses.sa:
सखा सख्ये अपचत्तूयमग्निरस्य क्रत्वा महिषा त्री शतानि ।
त्री साकमिन्द्रो मनुषः सरांसि सुतं पिबद्वृत्रहत्याय सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakha sakhye apachattuyamagnirasya kratva mahisha tri shatani |
tri sakamindro manushah saramsi sutam pibadvritrahatyaya somam ||
verses.en:
As friend to aid a friend, Agni dressed quickly three hundred buffaloes, even as he willed it.
And Indra, from man's gift, for Vrtra's slaughter, drank of at once three lakes of pressed-out Soma.

verses.sa:
त्री यच्छता महिषाणामघो मास्त्री सरांसि मघवा सोम्यापाः ।
कारं न विश्वे अह्वन्त देवा भरमिन्द्राय यदहिं जघान ॥
verses.rom:
tri yachchhata mahishanamagho mastri saramsi maghava somyapah |
karam na vishve ahvanta deva bharamindraya yadahim jaghana ||
verses.en:
When thou three hundred buffaloes' flesh hadst eaten, and drunk, as Maghavan, three lakes of Soma,
All the Gods raised as 'twere a shout of triumph to Indra praise because he slew the Dragon.

verses.sa:
उशना यत्सहस्यैरयातं गृहमिन्द्र जूजुवानेभिरश्वैः ।
वन्वानो अत्र सरथं ययाथ कुत्सेन देवैरवनोर्ह शुष्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
ushana yatsahasyairayatam grihamindra jujuvanebhirashvaih |
vanvano atra saratham yayatha kutsena devairavanorha shushnam ||
verses.en:
What time ye came with strong steeds swiftly speeding, O Usana and Indra, to the dwelling,
Thou camest thither -conquering together with Kutsa and the Gods: thou slewest Susna.

verses.sa:
प्रान्यच्चक्रमवृहः सूर्यस्य कुत्सायान्यद्वरिवो यातवेऽकः ।
अनासो दस्यूँरमृणो वधेन नि दुर्योण आवृणङ्मृध्रवाचः ॥
verses.rom:
pranyachchakramavrihah suryasya kutsayanyadvarivo yatave'kah |
