Down on the Soma swooped the rapid Falcon. Bright was the young Sage moving mid his cattle.

verses.sa:
आ सूर्यो अरुहच्छुक्रमर्णोऽयुक्त यद्धरितो वीतपृष्ठाः ।
उद्ना न नावमनयन्त धीरा आशृण्वतीरापो अर्वागतिष्ठन् ॥
verses.rom:
a suryo aruhachchhukramarno'yukta yaddharito vitaprishthah |
udna na navamanayanta dhira ashrinvatirapo arvagatishthan ||
verses.en:
Surya hath mounted to the shining ocean when he hath yoked his fair-backed Tawny Horses.
The wise have drawn him like a ship through water: the floods obedient have descended hither.

verses.sa:
धियं वो अप्सु दधिषे स्वर्षां ययातरन्दश मासो नवग्वाः ।
अया धिया स्याम देवगोपा अया धिया तुतुर्यामात्यंहः ॥
verses.rom:
dhiyam vo apsu dadhishe svarsham yayatarandasha maso navagvah |
aya dhiya syama devagopa aya dhiya tuturyamatyamhah ||
verses.en:
I lay upon the Floods your hymn, light winning, wherewith Navagvas their ten months completed.
Through this our hymn may we have Gods to guard us: through this our hymn pass safe beyond affliction.

verses.sa:
हयो न विद्वाँ अयुजि स्वयं धुरि तां वहामि प्रतरणीमवस्युवम् ।
नास्या वश्मि विमुचं नावृतं पुनर्विद्वान्पथः पुरएत ऋजु नेषति ॥
verses.rom:
hayo na vidvan ayuji svayam dhuri tam vahami prataranimavasyuvam |
nasya vashmi vimucham navritam punarvidvanpathah puraeta riju neshati ||
verses.en:
WELL knowing I have bound me, horselike, to the pole: I carry that which bears as on and gives us help.
I seek for no release, no turning back therefrom. May he who knows the way, the Leader, guide me straight.

verses.sa:
अग्न इन्द्र वरुण मित्र देवाः शर्धः प्र यन्त मारुतोत विष्णो ।
उभा नासत्या रुद्रो अध ग्नाः पूषा भगः सरस्वती जुषन्त ॥
verses.rom:
agna indra varuna mitra devah shardhah pra yanta marutota vishno |
ubha nasatya rudro adha gnah pusha bhagah sarasvati jushanta ||
verses.en:
O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Visnu.
May both Nasatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pusan, Sarasvati, Bhaga, accept us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी मित्रावरुणादितिं स्वः पृथिवीं द्यां मरुतः पर्वताँ अपः ।
हुवे विष्णुं पूषणं ब्रह्मणस्पतिं भगं नु शंसं सवितारमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
indragni mitravarunaditim svah prithivim dyam marutah parvatan apah |
huve vishnum pushanam brahmanaspatim bhagam nu shamsam savitaramutaye ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven,
Visnu I call, Pusan, and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.

verses.sa:
उत नो विष्णुरुत वातो अस्रिधो द्रविणोदा उत सोमो मयस्करत् ।
उत ऋभव उत राये नो अश्विनोत त्वष्टोत विभ्वानु मंसते ॥
verses.rom:
uta no vishnuruta vato asridho dravinoda uta somo mayaskarat |
uta ribhava uta raye no ashvinota tvashtota vibhvanu mamsate ||
verses.en:
May Visnu also and Vata who injures none, and Soma granter of possessions give us joy;
And may the Rbhus and the Asvins, Tvastar and Vibhvan remember us so that we may have wealth.

verses.sa:
उत त्यन्नो मारुतं शर्ध आ गमद्दिविक्षयं यजतं बर्हिरासदे ।
बृहस्पतिः शर्म पूषोत नो यमद्वरूथ्यं वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
verses.rom:
uta tyanno marutam shardha a gamaddivikshayam yajatam barhirasade |
brihaspatih sharma pushota no yamadvaruthyam varuno mitro aryama ||
verses.en:
So may the band of Maruts dwelling in the sky, the holy, come to us to sit on sacred grass;
Brhaspati and Pusan grant us sure defense, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman guard and shelter us.

verses.sa:
उत त्ये नः पर्वतासः सुशस्तयः सुदीतयो नद्यस्त्रामणे भुवन् ।
भगो विभक्ता शवसावसा गमदुरुव्यचा अदितिः श्रोतु मे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tye nah parvatasah sushastayah suditayo nadyastramane bhuvan |
bhago vibhakta shavasavasa gamaduruvyacha aditih shrotu me havam ||
verses.en:
And may the Mountains famed in noble eulogies, and the fair-gleaming Rivers keep us safe from harm.
May Bhaga the Dispenser come with power and grace, and far-pervading Aditi listen to my call.

verses.sa:
देवानां पत्नीरुशतीरवन्तु नः प्रावन्तु नस्तुजये वाजसातये ।
याः पार्थिवासो या अपामपि व्रते ता नो देवीः सुहवाः शर्म यच्छत ॥
verses.rom:
devanam patnirushatiravantu nah pravantu nastujaye vajasataye |
yah parthivaso ya apamapi vrate ta no devih suhavah sharma yachchhata ||
verses.en:
May the Gods' Spouses aid us of their own freewill, aid us to offspring and the winning of the spoil.
Grant us protection, O ye gracious Goddesses, ye who are on the earth or in the waters' realm.

verses.sa:
उत ग्ना व्यन्तु देवपत्नीरिन्द्राण्यग्नाय्यश्विनी राट् ।
आ रोदसी वरुणानी शृणोतु व्यन्तु देवीर्य ऋतुर्जनीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta gna vyantu devapatnirindranyagnayyashvini rat |
a rodasi varunani shrinotu vyantu devirya riturjaninam ||
verses.en:
May the Dames, wives of Gods, enjoy our presents, Rat, Asvini, Agnayi, and Indrani.
May Rodasi and Varunani hear us, and Goddesses come at the Matrons' season.

verses.sa:
प्रयुञ्जती दिव एति ब्रुवाणा मही माता दुहितुर्बोधयन्ती ।
आविवासन्ती युवतिर्मनीषा पितृभ्य आ सदने जोहुवाना ॥
verses.rom:
prayunjati diva eti bruvana mahi mata duhiturbodhayanti |
avivasanti yuvatirmanisha pitribhya a sadane johuvana ||
verses.en:
URGING to toil and making proclamation, seeking Heaven's Daughter comes the Mighty Mother:
She comes, the youthful Hymn, unto the Fathers, inviting to her home and loudly calling.

verses.sa:
अजिरासस्तदप ईयमाना आतस्थिवांसो अमृतस्य नाभिम् ।
अनन्तास उरवो विश्वतः सीं परि द्यावापृथिवी यन्ति पन्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
ajirasastadapa iyamana atasthivamso amritasya nabhim |
anantasa uravo vishvatah sim pari dyavaprithivi yanti panthah ||
verses.en:
Swift in their motion, hasting to their duty, reaching the central point of life immortal,
On every side about the earth and heaven go forth the spacious paths without a limit.

verses.sa:
उक्षा समुद्रो अरुषः सुपर्णः पूर्वस्य योनिं पितुरा विवेश ।
मध्ये दिवो निहितः पृश्निरश्मा वि चक्रमे रजसस्पात्यन्तौ ॥
verses.rom:
uksha samudro arushah suparnah purvasya yonim pitura vivesha |
madhye divo nihitah prishnirashma vi chakrame rajasaspatyantau ||
verses.en:
Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the dwelling-place of the Primeval Father.
A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone forth and guards mid-air's two limits.

verses.sa:
चत्वार ईं बिभ्रति क्षेमयन्तो दश गर्भं चरसे धापयन्ते ।
त्रिधातवः परमा अस्य गावो दिवश्चरन्ति परि सद्यो अन्तान् ॥
verses.rom:
chatvara im bibhrati kshemayanto dasha garbham charase dhapayante |
tridhatavah parama asya gavo divashcharanti pari sadyo antan ||
verses.en:
Four bear him up and give him rest and quiet, and ten invigorate the Babe for travel.
His kine most excellent, of threefold nature, pass swiftly round the boundaries of heaven.

verses.sa:
इदं वपुर्निवचनं जनासश्चरन्ति यन्नद्यस्तस्थुरापः ।
द्वे यदीं बिभृतो मातुरन्ये इहेह जाते यम्या सबन्धू ॥
verses.rom:
idam vapurnivachanam janasashcharanti yannadyastasthurapah |
dve yadim bibhrito maturanye iheha jate yamya sabandhu ||
verses.en:
Wondrous, O people, is the mystic knowledge that while the waters stand the streams are flowing:
That, separate from his Mother, Two support him, closely-united, twins, here made apparent.

verses.sa:
वि तन्वते धियो अस्मा अपांसि वस्त्रा पुत्राय मातरो वयन्ति ।
उपप्रक्षे वृषणो मोदमाना दिवस्पथा वध्वो यन्त्यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
vi tanvate dhiyo asma apamsi vastra putraya mataro vayanti |
upaprakshe vrishano modamana divaspatha vadhvo yantyachchha ||
verses.en:
For him they lengthen prayers and acts of worship: the Mothers weave garments for him their offspring.
Rejoicing, for the Steer's impregning contact, his Spouses move on paths or heaven to meet him.

verses.sa:
तदस्तु मित्रावरुणा तदग्ने शं योरस्मभ्यमिदमस्तु शस्तम् ।
अशीमहि गाधमुत प्रतिष्ठां नमो दिवे बृहते सादनाय ॥
verses.rom:
tadastu mitravaruna tadagne sham yorasmabhyamidamastu shastam |
ashimahi gadhamuta pratishtham namo dive brihate sadanaya ||
verses.en:
Be this our praise, O Varuna and Mitra may this be health and force to us, O Agni.
May we obtain firm ground and room for resting: Glory to Heaven, the lofty habitation!

verses.sa:
कदु प्रियाय धाम्ने मनामहे स्वक्षत्राय स्वयशसे महे वयम् ।
आमेन्यस्य रजसो यदभ्र आँ अपो वृणाना वितनोति मायिनी ॥
verses.rom:
kadu priyaya dhamne manamahe svakshatraya svayashase mahe vayam |
amenyasya rajaso yadabhra an apo vrinana vitanoti mayini ||
verses.en:
WHAT may we meditate for the beloved Power, mighty in native strength and glorious in itself,
Which as a magic energy seeking waters spreads even to the immeasurable middle region's cloud?

verses.sa:
ता अत्नत वयुनं वीरवक्षणं समान्या वृतया विश्वमा रजः ।
अपो अपाचीरपरा अपेजते प्र पूर्वाभिस्तिरते देवयुर्जनः ॥
verses.rom:
ta atnata vayunam viravakshanam samanya vritaya vishvama rajah |
apo apachirapara apejate pra purvabhistirate devayurjanah ||
verses.en:
O'er all the region with their uniform advance these have spread out the lore that giveth heroes strength.
Back, with their course reversed, the others pass away: the pious lengthens life with those that are before.

verses.sa:
आ ग्रावभिरहन्येभिरक्तुभिर्वरिष्ठं वज्रमा जिघर्ति मायिनि ।
शतं वा यस्य प्रचरन्स्वे दमे संवर्तयन्तो वि च वर्तयन्नहा ॥
verses.rom:
a gravabhirahanyebhiraktubhirvarishtham vajrama jigharti mayini |
shatam va yasya pracharansve dame samvartayanto vi cha vartayannaha ||
verses.en:
With pressing-stones and with the bright beams of the day he hurls his broadest bolt against the Guileful One.
Even he whose hundred wander in his own abode, driving the days afar and bringing them again.

verses.sa:
तामस्य रीतिं परशोरिव प्रत्यनीकमख्यं भुजे अस्य वर्पसः ।
सचा यदि पितुमन्तमिव क्षयं रत्नं दधाति भरहूतये विशे ॥
verses.rom:
tamasya ritim parashoriva pratyanikamakhyam bhuje asya varpasah |
sacha yadi pitumantamiva kshayam ratnam dadhati bharahutaye vishe ||
verses.en:
I, to enjoy the beauty of his form, behold that rapid rush of his as 'twere an axe's edge,
What time he gives the man who calls on him in fight wealth like a dwelling-house filled full with store of food.

verses.sa:
स जिह्वया चतुरनीक ऋञ्जते चारु वसानो वरुणो यतन्नरिम् ।
न तस्य विद्म पुरुषत्वता वयं यतो भगः सविता दाति वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa jihvaya chaturanika rinjate charu vasano varuno yatannarim |
na tasya vidma purushatvata vayam yato bhagah savita dati varyam ||
verses.en:
Four-faced and nobly clad, Varuna, urging on the pious to his task, stirs himself with the tongue.
Naught by our human nature do we know of him, him from whom Bhaga Savitar bestows the boon.

verses.sa:
देवं वो अद्य सवितारमेषे भगं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः ।
आ वां नरा पुरुभुजा ववृत्यां दिवेदिवे चिदश्विना सखीयन् ॥
verses.rom:
devam vo adya savitarameshe bhagam cha ratnam vibhajantamayoh |
a vam nara purubhuja vavrityam divedive chidashvina sakhiyan ||
verses.en:
THIS day I bring God Savitar to meet you, and Bhaga who allots the wealth of mortals.
You, Asvins, Heroes rich in treasures, daily seeking your friendship fain would I turn hither.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रयाणमसुरस्य विद्वान्सूक्तैर्देवं सवितारं दुवस्य ।
उप ब्रुवीत नमसा विजानञ्ज्येष्ठं च रत्नं विभजन्तमायोः ॥
verses.rom:
prati prayanamasurasya vidvansuktairdevam savitaram duvasya |
upa bruvita namasa vijananjyeshtham cha ratnam vibhajantamayoh ||
verses.en:
Knowing full well the Asura's time of coming, worship God Savitar with hymns and praises.
Let him who rightly knoweth speak with homage to him who dealeth out man's noblest treasure.

verses.sa:
अदत्रया दयते वार्याणि पूषा भगो अदितिर्वस्त उस्रः ।
इन्द्रो विष्णुर्वरुणो मित्रो अग्निरहानि भद्रा जनयन्त दस्माः ॥
verses.rom:
adatraya dayate varyani pusha bhago aditirvasta usrah |
indro vishnurvaruno mitro agnirahani bhadra janayanta dasmah ||
verses.en:
Not for reward doth Pusan send his blessings, Bhaga, or Aditi: his garb is splendour.
May Indra, Visniu, Varuna, Mitra, Agni produce auspicious days, the Wonder-Workers.

verses.sa:
तन्नो अनर्वा सविता वरूथं तत्सिन्धव इषयन्तो अनु ग्मन् ।
उप यद्वोचे अध्वरस्य होता रायः स्याम पतयो वाजरत्नाः ॥
verses.rom:
tanno anarva savita varutham tatsindhava ishayanto anu gman |
upa yadvoche adhvarasya hota rayah syama patayo vajaratnah ||
verses.en:
Sending the shelter which we ask, the foeless Savitar and the Rivers shall approach us.
When I, the sacrifice's priest, invite them, may we he lords of wealth and rich possessions.

verses.sa:
प्र ये वसुभ्य ईवदा नमो दुर्ये मित्रे वरुणे सूक्तवाचः ।
अवैत्वभ्वं कृणुता वरीयो दिवस्पृथिव्योरवसा मदेम ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye vasubhya ivada namo durye mitre varune suktavachah |
avaitvabhvam krinuta variyo divasprithivyoravasa madema ||
verses.en:
They who devote such worship to the Vasus, singing their hymns to Varuna and Mitra,
Vouchsafe them ample room, far off be danger. Through grace of Heaven and Earth may we be happy.

verses.sa:
विश्वो देवस्य नेतुर्मर्तो वुरीत सख्यम् ।
विश्वो राय इषुध्यति द्युम्नं वृणीत पुष्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
vishvo devasya neturmarto vurita sakhyam |
vishvo raya ishudhyati dyumnam vrinita pushyase ||
verses.en:
LET every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God.
Each one solicits him for wealth and seeks renown to prosper him.

verses.sa:
ते ते देव नेतर्ये चेमाँ अनुशसे ।
ते राया ते ह्यापृचे सचेमहि सचथ्यैः ॥
verses.rom:
te te deva netarye cheman anushase |
te raya te hyapriche sachemahi sachathyaih ||
verses.en:
These, leading God, are thine, and these here ready to speak after us.
As such may we attain to wealth and wait with services on thee.

verses.sa:
अतो न आ नॄनतिथीनतः पत्नीर्दशस्यत ।
आरे विश्वं पथेष्ठां द्विषो युयोतु यूयुविः ॥
verses.rom:
ato na a nrinatithinatah patnirdashasyata |
are vishvam patheshtham dvisho yuyotu yuyuvih ||
verses.en:
So further honour as our guests the Hero Gods and then the Dames.
May he remove and keep afar our foes and all who block our path.

verses.sa:
यत्र वह्निरभिहितो दुद्रवद्द्रोण्यः पशुः ।
नृमणा वीरपस्त्योऽर्णा धीरेव सनिता ॥
verses.rom:
yatra vahnirabhihito dudravaddronyah pashuh |
nrimana virapastyo'rna dhireva sanita ||
verses.en:
Where fire is set, and swiftly runs the victim dwelling in the trough,
He wins, with heroes in his home, friendly to man, like constant streams.

verses.sa:
एष ते देव नेता रथस्पतिः शं रयिः ।
शं राये शं स्वस्तय इषस्तुतो मनामहे देवस्तुतो मनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
esha te deva neta rathaspatih sham rayih |
sham raye sham svastaya ishastuto manamahe devastuto manamahe ||
verses.en:
May these thy riches, Leader God! that rule the car, be blest to us,
Yea, blest to us for wealth and weal. This will we ponder praising strength, this ponder as we praise the God.

verses.sa:
अग्ने सुतस्य पीतये विश्वैरूमेभिरा गहि ।
देवेभिर्हव्यदातये ॥
verses.rom:
agne sutasya pitaye vishvairumebhira gahi |
devebhirhavyadataye ||
verses.en:
WITH all assistants, Agni, come hither to drink the Soma-juice;
With Gods unto our sacred gifts.

verses.sa:
ऋतधीतय आ गत सत्यधर्माणो अध्वरम् ।
अग्नेः पिबत जिह्वया ॥
verses.rom:
ritadhitaya a gata satyadharmano adhvaram |
agneh pibata jihvaya ||
verses.en:
Come to the sacrifice, O ye whose ways are right, whose laws are true,
And drink the draught with Agni's tongue.

verses.sa:
विप्रेभिर्विप्र सन्त्य प्रातर्यावभिरा गहि ।
देवेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
viprebhirvipra santya prataryavabhira gahi |
devebhih somapitaye ||
verses.en:
O Singer, with the singers, O Gracious, with those who move at dawn,
Come to the Soma-draught with Gods.

verses.sa:
अयं सोमश्चमू सुतोऽमत्रे परि षिच्यते ।
प्रिय इन्द्राय वायवे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam somashchamu suto'matre pari shichyate |
priya indraya vayave ||
verses.en:
To Indra and to Vayu dear, this Soma, by the mortar pressed,
Is now poured forth to fill the jar.

verses.sa:
वायवा याहि वीतये जुषाणो हव्यदातये ।
पिबा सुतस्यान्धसो अभि प्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
vayava yahi vitaye jushano havyadataye |
piba sutasyandhaso abhi prayah ||
verses.en:
Vayu, come hither to the feast, well pleased unto our sacred gifts:
Drink of the Soma juice effused come to the food.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्च वायवेषां सुतानां पीतिमर्हथः ।
ताञ्जुषेथामरेपसावभि प्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
indrashcha vayavesham sutanam pitimarhathah |
tanjushethamarepasavabhi prayah ||
verses.en:
Ye, Indra, Vayu, well deserve to drink the juices pressed by us.
Gladly accept them, spotless Pair come to the food.

verses.sa:
सुता इन्द्राय वायवे सोमासो दध्याशिरः ।
निम्नं न यन्ति सिन्धवोऽभि प्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
suta indraya vayave somaso dadhyashirah |
nimnam na yanti sindhavo'bhi prayah ||
verses.en:
For Indra and for Vayu pressed are Soma juices blent with curd,
As rivers to the lowland flow: come to the food.

verses.sa:
सजूर्विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरश्विभ्यामुषसा सजूः ।
आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
verses.rom:
sajurvishvebhirdevebhirashvibhyamushasa sajuh |
a yahyagne atrivatsute rana ||
verses.en:
Associate with all the Gods, come, with the Asvins and with Dawn,
Agni, as erst with Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa:
सजूर्मित्रावरुणाभ्यां सजूः सोमेन विष्णुना ।
आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
verses.rom:
sajurmitravarunabhyam sajuh somena vishnuna |
a yahyagne atrivatsute rana ||
verses.en:
Associate with Varuna, with Mitra, Soma, Visnu, come,
Agni, as erstwith Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa:
सजूरादित्यैर्वसुभिः सजूरिन्द्रेण वायुना ।
आ याह्यग्ने अत्रिवत्सुते रण ॥
verses.rom:
sajuradityairvasubhih sajurindrena vayuna |
a yahyagne atrivatsute rana ||
verses.en: Associate with Vasus, with Adityas, Indra, Viyu, come, Agni as erst with Atri, so enjoy the juice.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति नो मिमीतामश्विना भगः स्वस्ति देव्यदितिरनर्वणः ।
स्वस्ति पूषा असुरो दधातु नः स्वस्ति द्यावापृथिवी सुचेतुना ॥
verses.rom:
svasti no mimitamashvina bhagah svasti devyaditiranarvanah |
svasti pusha asuro dadhatu nah svasti dyavaprithivi suchetuna ||
verses.en:
May Bhaga and the Asvins grant us health and wealth, and Goddess Adid and he whom none resist.
The Asura Pusan grant us all prosperity, and Heaven and Earth most wise vouchsafe us happiness.

verses.sa:
स्वस्तये वायुमुप ब्रवामहै सोमं स्वस्ति भुवनस्य यस्पतिः ।
बृहस्पतिं सर्वगणं स्वस्तये स्वस्तय आदित्यासो भवन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
svastaye vayumupa bravamahai somam svasti bhuvanasya yaspatih |
brihaspatim sarvaganam svastaye svastaya adityaso bhavantu nah ||
verses.en:
Let us solicit Vayu for prosperity, and Soma who is Lord of all the world for weal;
For weal Brhaspati with all his company. May the Adityas bring us health and happiness.

verses.sa:
विश्वे देवा नो अद्या स्वस्तये वैश्वानरो वसुरग्निः स्वस्तये ।
देवा अवन्त्वृभवः स्वस्तये स्वस्ति नो रुद्रः पात्वंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve deva no adya svastaye vaishvanaro vasuragnih svastaye |
deva avantvribhavah svastaye svasti no rudrah patvamhasah ||
verses.en:
May all the Gods, may Agni the beneficent, God of all men, this day be with us for our weal.
Help us the Rbhus, the Divine Ones, for our good. May Rudra bless and keep us from calamity.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति मित्रावरुणा स्वस्ति पथ्ये रेवति ।
स्वस्ति न इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च स्वस्ति नो अदिते कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
svasti mitravaruna svasti pathye revati |
svasti na indrashchagnishcha svasti no adite kridhi ||
verses.en:
Prosper us, Mitra, Varuna. O wealthy Pathya, prosper us.
Indra and Agni, prosper us; prosper us thou, O Aditi.

verses.sa:
स्वस्ति पन्थामनु चरेम सूर्याचन्द्रमसाविव ।
पुनर्ददताघ्नता जानता सं गमेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
svasti panthamanu charema suryachandramasaviva |
punardadataghnata janata sam gamemahi ||
verses.en:
Like Sun and Moon may we pursue in full prosperity our path,
And meet with one who gives again, -who knows us well and slays us not.

verses.sa:
प्र श्यावाश्व धृष्णुयार्चा मरुद्भिरृक्वभिः ।
ये अद्रोघमनुष्वधं श्रवो मदन्ति यज्ञियाः ॥
verses.rom:
pra shyavashva dhrishnuyarcha marudbhirrikvabhih |
ye adroghamanushvadham shravo madanti yajniyah ||
verses.en:
SING boldly forth, Syavasva, with the Maruts who are loud in song,
Who, holy, as their wont is, joy in glory that is free from guile.

verses.sa:
ते हि स्थिरस्य शवसः सखायः सन्ति धृष्णुया ।
ते यामन्ना धृषद्विनस्त्मना पान्ति शश्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi sthirasya shavasah sakhayah santi dhrishnuya |
te yamanna dhrishadvinastmana panti shashvatah ||
verses.en:
For in their boldness they are friends of firm and sure heroic strength.
They in their course, bold-spirited, guard all men of their own accord.

verses.sa:
ते स्यन्द्रासो नोक्षणोऽति ष्कन्दन्ति शर्वरीः ।
मरुतामधा महो दिवि क्षमा च मन्महे ॥
verses.rom:
te syandraso nokshano'ti shkandanti sharvarih |
marutamadha maho divi kshama cha manmahe ||
verses.en:
Like steers in rapid motion they advance and overtake the nights;
And thus the Maruts' power in heaven and on the earth we celebrate.

verses.sa:
मरुत्सु वो दधीमहि स्तोमं यज्ञं च धृष्णुया ।
विश्वे ये मानुषा युगा पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः ॥
verses.rom:
marutsu vo dadhimahi stomam yajnam cha dhrishnuya |
vishve ye manusha yuga panti martyam rishah ||
verses.en:
With boldness to your Maruts let us offer laud and sacrifice:
Who all, through ages of mankind, guard mortal man from injury.

verses.sa:
अर्हन्तो ये सुदानवो नरो असामिशवसः ।
प्र यज्ञं यज्ञियेभ्यो दिवो अर्चा मरुद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
arhanto ye sudanavo naro asamishavasah |
pra yajnam yajniyebhyo divo archa marudbhyah ||
verses.en:
Praiseworthy, givers of good gifts, Heroes with full and perfect strength -
To Maruts, Holy Ones of heaven, will I extol the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ रुक्मैरा युधा नर ऋष्वा ऋष्टीरसृक्षत ।
अन्वेनाँ अह विद्युतो मरुतो जज्झतीरिव भानुरर्त त्मना दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
a rukmaira yudha nara rishva rishtirasrikshata |
anvenan aha vidyuto maruto jajjhatiriva bhanurarta tmana divah ||
verses.en:
The lofty Heroes cast their spears and weapons bright with gleaming gold.
After these Maruts followed close, like laughing lightning from the sky, a splendour of its own accord.

verses.sa:
ये वावृधन्त पार्थिवा य उरावन्तरिक्ष आ ।
वृजने वा नदीनां सधस्थे वा महो दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ye vavridhanta parthiva ya uravantariksha a |
vrijane va nadinam sadhasthe va maho divah ||
verses.en:
They who waxed mighty, of the earth, they who are in the wide mid-air,
Or in the rivers' compass, or in the abode of ample heaven.

verses.sa:
शर्धो मारुतमुच्छंस सत्यशवसमृभ्वसम् ।
उत स्म ते शुभे नरः प्र स्यन्द्रा युजत त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
shardho marutamuchchhamsa satyashavasamribhvasam |
uta sma te shubhe narah pra syandra yujata tmana ||
verses.en:
Praise thou the Maruts' company, the valorous and truly strong,
The Heroes, hasting, by themselves have yoked their deer for victory.

verses.sa:
उत स्म ते परुष्ण्यामूर्णा वसत शुन्ध्यवः ।
उत पव्या रथानामद्रिं भिन्दन्त्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
uta sma te parushnyamurna vasata shundhyavah |
uta pavya rathanamadrim bhindantyojasa ||
verses.en:
Fair-gleaming, on Parusni they have clothed themselves in robes of wool,
And with their chariot tires they cleave the rock asunder in their might.

verses.sa:
आपथयो विपथयोऽन्तस्पथा अनुपथाः ।
एतेभिर्मह्यं नामभिर्यज्ञं विष्टार ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
apathayo vipathayo'ntaspatha anupathah |
etebhirmahyam namabhiryajnam vishtara ohate ||
verses.en:
Whether as wanderers from the way or speeders on or to the path,
Under these names the spreading band tend well the sacrifice for me.

verses.sa:
अधा नरो न्योहतेऽधा नियुत ओहते ।
अधा पारावता इति चित्रा रूपाणि दर्श्या ॥
verses.rom:
adha naro nyohate'dha niyuta ohate |
adha paravata iti chitra rupani darshya ||
verses.en:
To this the Heroes well attend, well do their teams attend to this.
Visible are their varied forms. Behold, they are Paravatas.

verses.sa:
छन्दस्तुभः कुभन्यव उत्समा कीरिणो नृतुः ।
ते मे के चिन्न तायव ऊमा आसन्दृशि त्विषे ॥
verses.rom:
chhandastubhah kubhanyava utsama kirino nrituh |
te me ke chinna tayava uma asandrishi tvishe ||
verses.en:
Hymn-singing, seeking water, they, praising, have danced about the spring.
What are they unto me? No thieves, but helpers, splendid to behold.

verses.sa:
य ऋष्वा ऋष्टिविद्युतः कवयः सन्ति वेधसः ।
तमृषे मारुतं गणं नमस्या रमया गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
ya rishva rishtividyutah kavayah santi vedhasah |
tamrishe marutam ganam namasya ramaya gira ||
verses.en:
Sublime, with lightnings for their spears, Sages and Orderers are they.
Rsi, adore that Marut host, and make them happy with thy song.

verses.sa:
अच्छ ऋषे मारुतं गणं दाना मित्रं न योषणा ।
दिवो वा धृष्णव ओजसा स्तुता धीभिरिषण्यत ॥
verses.rom:
achchha rishe marutam ganam dana mitram na yoshana |
divo va dhrishnava ojasa stuta dhibhirishanyata ||
verses.en:
Rsi, invite the Marut band with offerings, as a maid her friend.
From heaven, too, Bold Ones, in your might haste hither glorified with songs.

verses.sa:
नू मन्वान एषां देवाँ अच्छा न वक्षणा ।
दाना सचेत सूरिभिर्यामश्रुतेभिरञ्जिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
nu manvana esham devan achchha na vakshana |
dana sacheta suribhiryamashrutebhiranjibhih ||
verses.en:
Thinking of these now let him come, as with the escort of the Gods,
And with the splendid Princes, famed for rapid courses, to the gifts.

verses.sa:
प्र ये मे बन्ध्वेषे गां वोचन्त सूरयः पृश्निं वोचन्त मातरम् ।
अधा पितरमिष्मिणं रुद्रं वोचन्त शिक्वसः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye me bandhveshe gam vochanta surayah prishnim vochanta mataram |
adha pitaramishminam rudram vochanta shikvasah ||
verses.en:
Princes, who, when I asked their kin, named Prsni as their Mother-cow,
And the impetuous Rudra they, the Mighty Ones, declared their Sire.

verses.sa:
सप्त मे सप्त शाकिन एकमेका शता ददुः ।
यमुनायामधि श्रुतमुद्राधो गव्यं मृजे नि राधो अश्व्यं मृजे ॥
verses.rom:
sapta me sapta shakina ekameka shata daduh |
yamunayamadhi shrutamudradho gavyam mrije ni radho ashvyam mrije ||
verses.en:
The mighty ones, the seven times seven, have singly given me hundred gifts.
I have obtained on Yamuna famed wealth in kine and wealth in steeds.

verses.sa:
को वेद जानमेषां को वा पुरा सुम्नेष्वास मरुताम् ।
यद्युयुज्रे किलास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ko veda janamesham ko va pura sumneshvasa marutam |
yadyuyujre kilasyah ||
verses.en:
Who knows the birth of these, or who lived in the Maruts' favour in the days of old
What time their spotted deer were yoked?

verses.sa:
ऐतान्रथेषु तस्थुषः कः शुश्राव कथा ययुः ।
कस्मै सस्रुः सुदासे अन्वापय इळाभिर्वृष्टयः सह ॥
verses.rom:
aitanratheshu tasthushah kah shushrava katha yayuh |
kasmai sasruh sudase anvapaya ilabhirvrishtayah saha ||
verses.en:
Who, when they stood upon their cars, hath heard them tell the way they went?
Who was the bounteous man to whom their kindred rains flowed down with food of sacrifice?

verses.sa:
ते म आहुर्य आययुरुप द्युभिर्विभिर्मदे ।
नरो मर्या अरेपस इमान्पश्यन्निति ष्टुहि ॥
verses.rom:
te ma ahurya ayayurupa dyubhirvibhirmade |
naro marya arepasa imanpashyanniti shtuhi ||
verses.en:
To me they told it, and they came with winged steeds radiant to the draught,
Youths, Heroes free from spot or stain: Behold us here and praise thou us;

verses.sa:
ये अञ्जिषु ये वाशीषु स्वभानवः स्रक्षु रुक्मेषु खादिषु ।
श्राया रथेषु धन्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
ye anjishu ye vashishu svabhanavah srakshu rukmeshu khadishu |
shraya ratheshu dhanvasu ||
verses.en:
Who shine self-luminous with ornaments and swords, with breastplates, armlets, and with wreaths,
Arrayed on chariots and with bows.

verses.sa:
युष्माकं स्मा रथाँ अनु मुदे दधे मरुतो जीरदानवः ।
वृष्टी द्यावो यतीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
yushmakam sma rathan anu mude dadhe maruto jiradanavah |
vrishti dyavo yatiriva ||
verses.en:
O swift to pour your bounties down, ye Maruts, with delight I look upon your cars,
Like splendours coming through the rain.

verses.sa:
आ यं नरः सुदानवो ददाशुषे दिवः कोशमचुच्यवुः ।
वि पर्जन्यं सृजन्ति रोदसी अनु धन्वना यन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
a yam narah sudanavo dadashushe divah koshamachuchyavuh |
vi parjanyam srijanti rodasi anu dhanvana yanti vrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Munificent Heroes, they have cast heaven's treasury down for the worshipper's behoof:
They set the storm-cloud free to stream through both the worlds, and rain floods flow o'er desert spots.

verses.sa:
ततृदानाः सिन्धवः क्षोदसा रजः प्र सस्रुर्धेनवो यथा ।
स्यन्ना अश्वा इवाध्वनो विमोचने वि यद्वर्तन्त एन्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tatridanah sindhavah kshodasa rajah pra sasrurdhenavo yatha |
syanna ashva ivadhvano vimochane vi yadvartanta enyah ||
verses.en:
The bursting streams m billowy flood have spread abroad, like milch-kine, o'er the firmament.
Like swift steeds hasting to their journey's resting-place, to every side run glittering brooks.

verses.sa:
आ यात मरुतो दिव आन्तरिक्षादमादुत ।
माव स्थात परावतः ॥
verses.rom:
a yata maruto diva antarikshadamaduta |
mava sthata paravatah ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Maruts, come from heaven, from mid-air, or from near at hand
Tarry not far away from us.

verses.sa:
मा वो रसानितभा कुभा क्रुमुर्मा वः सिन्धुर्नि रीरमत् ।
मा वः परि ष्ठात्सरयुः पुरीषिण्यस्मे इत्सुम्नमस्तु वः ॥
verses.rom:
ma vo rasanitabha kubha krumurma vah sindhurni riramat |
ma vah pari shthatsarayuh purishinyasme itsumnamastu vah ||
verses.en:
So let not Rasa, Krumu, or Anitabha, Kubha, or Sindhu hold you back.
Let not the watery Sarayti obstruct your way. With us be all the bliss ye give.

verses.sa:
तं वः शर्धं रथानां त्वेषं गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् ।
अनु प्र यन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vah shardham rathanam tvesham ganam marutam navyasinam |
anu pra yanti vrishtayah ||
verses.en:
That brilliant gathering of your cars, the company of Maruts, of the Youthful Ones,
The rain-showers, speeding on, attend.

verses.sa:
शर्धंशर्धं व एषां व्रातंव्रातं गणंगणं सुशस्तिभिः ।
अनु क्रामेम धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
shardhamshardham va esham vratamvratam ganamganam sushastibhih |
anu kramema dhitibhih ||
verses.en:
With eulogies and hymns may we follow your army, troop by troop, and band by band,
And company by company.

verses.sa:
कस्मा अद्य सुजाताय रातहव्याय प्र ययुः ।
एना यामेन मरुतः ॥
verses.rom:
kasma adya sujataya ratahavyaya pra yayuh |
ena yamena marutah ||
verses.en:
To what oblation-giver, sprung of noble ancestry, have sped
The Maruts on this course to-day?

verses.sa:
येन तोकाय तनयाय धान्यं बीजं वहध्वे अक्षितम् ।
अस्मभ्यं तद्धत्तन यद्व ईमहे राधो विश्वायु सौभगम् ॥
verses.rom:
yena tokaya tanayaya dhanyam bijam vahadhve akshitam |
asmabhyam taddhattana yadva imahe radho vishvayu saubhagam ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe to us the bounty, that which we implore, through which, for child and progeny,
Ye give the seed of corn that wasteth not away, and bliss that reacheth to all life.

verses.sa:
अतीयाम निदस्तिरः स्वस्तिभिर्हित्वावद्यमरातीः ।
वृष्ट्वी शं योराप उस्रि भेषजं स्याम मरुतः सह ॥
verses.rom:
atiyama nidastirah svastibhirhitvavadyamaratih |
vrishtvi sham yorapa usri bheshajam syama marutah saha ||
verses.en:
May we in safety pass by those who slander us, leaving behind disgrace and hate.
Maruts, may we be there when ye, at dawn, in rest and toil, rain waters down and balm.

verses.sa:
सुदेवः समहासति सुवीरो नरो मरुतः स मर्त्यः ।
यं त्रायध्वे स्याम ते ॥
verses.rom:
sudevah samahasati suviro naro marutah sa martyah |
yam trayadhve syama te ||
verses.en:
Favoured by Gods shall he the man, O Heroes, Maruts! and possessed of noble sons,
Whom ye protect. Such may we be.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि भोजान्स्तुवतो अस्य यामनि रणन्गावो न यवसे ।
यतः पूर्वाँ इव सखीँरनु ह्वय गिरा गृणीहि कामिनः ॥
verses.rom:
stuhi bhojanstuvato asya yamani ranangavo na yavase |
yatah purvan iva sakhinranu hvaya gira grinihi kaminah ||
verses.en:
Praise the Free-givers. At this liberal patron's rite they joy like cattle in the mead.
So call thou unto them who come as ancient Friends: hymn those who love thee with a song.

verses.sa:
प्र शर्धाय मारुताय स्वभानव इमां वाचमनजा पर्वतच्युते ।
घर्मस्तुभे दिव आ पृष्ठयज्वने द्युम्नश्रवसे महि नृम्णमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
pra shardhaya marutaya svabhanava imam vachamanaja parvatachyute |
gharmastubhe diva a prishthayajvane dyumnashravase mahi nrimnamarchata ||
verses.en:
THIS hymn will I make for the Marut host who bright in native splendour cast the mountains down.
Sing the great strength of those illustrious in renown, who stay the heat, who sacrifice on heights of heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र वो मरुतस्तविषा उदन्यवो वयोवृधो अश्वयुजः परिज्रयः ।
सं विद्युता दधति वाशति त्रितः स्वरन्त्यापोऽवना परिज्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo marutastavisha udanyavo vayovridho ashvayujah parijrayah |
sam vidyuta dadhati vashati tritah svarantyapo'vana parijrayah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, rich in water, strengtheners of life are your strong bands with harnessed steeds, that wander far.
Trita roars out at him who aims the lightning-flash. The waters sweeping round are thundering on their way.

verses.sa:
विद्युन्महसो नरो अश्मदिद्यवो वातत्विषो मरुतः पर्वतच्युतः ।
अब्दया चिन्मुहुरा ह्रादुनीवृत स्तनयदमा रभसा उदोजसः ॥
verses.rom:
vidyunmahaso naro ashmadidyavo vatatvisho marutah parvatachyutah |
abdaya chinmuhura hradunivrita stanayadama rabhasa udojasah ||
verses.en:
They gleam with lightning, Heroes, Casters of the Stone, wind-rapid Maruts, overthrowers of the bills,
Oft through desire to rain coming with storm of hail, roaring in onset, violent and exceeding strong.

verses.sa:
व्यक्तून्रुद्रा व्यहानि शिक्वसो व्यन्तरिक्षं वि रजांसि धूतयः ।
वि यदज्राँ अजथ नाव ईं यथा वि दुर्गाणि मरुतो नाह रिष्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
vyaktunrudra vyahani shikvaso vyantariksham vi rajamsi dhutayah |
vi yadajran ajatha nava im yatha vi durgani maruto naha rishyatha ||
verses.en:
When, mighty Rudras, through the nights and through the days, when through the sky and realms of air, shakers of all,
When over the broad fields ye drive along like ships, e'en to strongholds ye come, Maruts, but are not harmed.

verses.sa:
तद्वीर्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दीर्घं ततान सूर्यो न योजनम् ।
एता न यामे अगृभीतशोचिषोऽनश्वदां यन्न्ययातना गिरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tadviryam vo maruto mahitvanam dirgham tatana suryo na yojanam |
eta na yame agribhitashochisho'nashvadam yannyayatana girim ||
verses.en:
Maruts, this hero strength and majesty of yours hath, like the Sun, extended o'er a lengthened way,
When in your course like deer with splendour unsubdued ye bowed the hill that gives imperishable rain.

verses.sa:
अभ्राजि शर्धो मरुतो यदर्णसं मोषथा वृक्षं कपनेव वेधसः ।
अध स्मा नो अरमतिं सजोषसश्चक्षुरिव यन्तमनु नेषथा सुगम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhraji shardho maruto yadarnasam moshatha vriksham kapaneva vedhasah |
adha sma no aramatim sajoshasashchakshuriva yantamanu neshatha sugam ||
verses.en:
Bright shone your host, ye Sages, Maruts, when ye smote the waving tree as when the worm consumeth it.
Accordant, as the eye guides him who walks, have ye led our devotion onward by an easy path.

verses.sa:
न स जीयते मरुतो न हन्यते न स्रेधति न व्यथते न रिष्यति ।
नास्य राय उप दस्यन्ति नोतय ऋषिं वा यं राजानं वा सुषूदथ ॥
verses.rom:
na sa jiyate maruto na hanyate na sredhati na vyathate na rishyati |
nasya raya upa dasyanti notaya rishim va yam rajanam va sushudatha ||
verses.en:
Never is he, O Maruts, slain or overcome, never doth he decay ne'er is distressed or harmed;
His treasures, his resources, never waste away, whom. whether he be prince or Rsi, ye direct.

verses.sa:
नियुत्वन्तो ग्रामजितो यथा नरोऽर्यमणो न मरुतः कवन्धिनः ।
पिन्वन्त्युत्सं यदिनासो अस्वरन्व्युन्दन्ति पृथिवीं मध्वो अन्धसा ॥
verses.rom:
niyutvanto gramajito yatha naro'ryamano na marutah kavandhinah |
pinvantyutsam yadinaso asvaranvyundanti prithivim madhvo andhasa ||
verses.en:
With harnessed team like heroes overcoming troops, the friendly Maruts, laden with their water-casks,
Let the spring flow, and when impetuous' they roar they inundate the earth with floods of pleasant meath.

verses.sa:
प्रवत्वतीयं पृथिवी मरुद्भ्यः प्रवत्वती द्यौर्भवति प्रयद्भ्यः ।
प्रवत्वतीः पथ्या अन्तरिक्ष्याः प्रवत्वन्तः पर्वता जीरदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
pravatvatiyam prithivi marudbhyah pravatvati dyaurbhavati prayadbhyah |
pravatvatih pathya antarikshyah pravatvantah parvata jiradanavah ||
verses.en:
Free for the Maruts is the earth with sloping ways, free for the rushing Ones is heaven with steep descents.
The paths of air's mid-region are precipitous, precipitous the mountains with their running streams.

verses.sa:
यन्मरुतः सभरसः स्वर्णरः सूर्य उदिते मदथा दिवो नरः ।
न वोऽश्वाः श्रथयन्ताह सिस्रतः सद्यो अस्याध्वनः पारमश्नुथ ॥
verses.rom:
yanmarutah sabharasah svarnarah surya udite madatha divo narah |
na vo'shvah shrathayantaha sisratah sadyo asyadhvanah paramashnutha ||
verses.en:
When, as the Sun hath risen up, ye take delight, O bounteous radiant Maruts, Heroes of the sky,
Your coursers weary not when speeding on their way, and rapidly ye reach the end of this your path.

verses.sa:
अंसेषु व ऋष्टयः पत्सु खादयो वक्षस्सु रुक्मा मरुतो रथे शुभः ।
अग्निभ्राजसो विद्युतो गभस्त्योः शिप्राः शीर्षसु वितता हिरण्ययीः ॥
verses.rom:
amseshu va rishtayah patsu khadayo vakshassu rukma maruto rathe shubhah |
agnibhrajaso vidyuto gabhastyoh shiprah shirshasu vitata hiranyayih ||
verses.en:
Lances are on your shoulders, anklets on your feet, gold chains are on your breasts, gems, Maruts, on your car.
Lightnings aglow with flame are flashing in your hands, and visors wrought of gold are laid upon your heads.

verses.sa:
तं नाकमर्यो अगृभीतशोचिषं रुशत्पिप्पलं मरुतो वि धूनुथ ।
समच्यन्त वृजनातित्विषन्त यत्स्वरन्ति घोषं विततमृतायवः ॥
verses.rom:
tam nakamaryo agribhitashochisham rushatpippalam maruto vi dhunutha |
samachyanta vrijanatitvishanta yatsvaranti ghosham vitatamritayavah ||
verses.en:
Maruts, in eager stir ye shake the vault of heaven, splendid beyond conception, for its shining fruit.
They gathered when they let their deeds of might flash forth. The Pious Ones send forth a far-resounding shout.

verses.sa:
युष्मादत्तस्य मरुतो विचेतसो रायः स्याम रथ्यो वयस्वतः ।
न यो युच्छति तिष्यो यथा दिवोऽस्मे रारन्त मरुतः सहस्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
yushmadattasya maruto vichetaso rayah syama rathyo vayasvatah |
na yo yuchchhati tishyo yatha divo'sme raranta marutah sahasrinam ||
verses.en:
Sage Maruts, may we be the drivers of the car of riches full of life that have been given by you.
O Maruts, let that wealth in thousands dwell with us which never vanishes like Tisya from the sky.

verses.sa:
यूयं रयिं मरुत स्पार्हवीरं यूयमृषिमवथ सामविप्रम् ।
यूयमर्वन्तं भरताय वाजं यूयं धत्थ राजानं श्रुष्टिमन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam rayim maruta sparhaviram yuyamrishimavatha samavipram |
yuyamarvantam bharataya vajam yuyam dhattha rajanam shrushtimantam ||
verses.en:
Maruts, ye further wealth with longed for heroes, further the Rsi skilled in chanted verses.
Ye give the Bharata as his strength, a charger, and ye bestow a king who quickly listens.

verses.sa:
तद्वो यामि द्रविणं सद्यऊतयो येना स्वर्ण ततनाम नॄँरभि ।
इदं सु मे मरुतो हर्यता वचो यस्य तरेम तरसा शतं हिमाः ॥
verses.rom:
tadvo yami dravinam sadyautayo yena svarna tatanama nrinrabhi |
idam su me maruto haryata vacho yasya tarema tarasa shatam himah ||
verses.en:
Of you, most swift to succour! I solicit wealth wherewith we may spread forth mid men like as the Sun.
Accept, O Maruts, graciously this hymn of mine that we may live a hundred winters through its power.

verses.sa:
प्रयज्यवो मरुतो भ्राजदृष्टयो बृहद्वयो दधिरे रुक्मवक्षसः ।
ईयन्ते अश्वैः सुयमेभिराशुभिः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
prayajyavo maruto bhrajadrishtayo brihadvayo dadhire rukmavakshasah |
iyante ashvaih suyamebhirashubhih shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
स्वयं दधिध्वे तविषीं यथा विद बृहन्महान्त उर्विया वि राजथ ।
उतान्तरिक्षं ममिरे व्योजसा शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
svayam dadhidhve tavishim yatha vida brihanmahanta urviya vi rajatha |
utantariksham mamire vyojasa shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
साकं जाताः सुभ्वः साकमुक्षिताः श्रिये चिदा प्रतरं वावृधुर्नरः ।
विरोकिणः सूर्यस्येव रश्मयः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
sakam jatah subhvah sakamukshitah shriye chida prataram vavridhurnarah |
virokinah suryasyeva rashmayah shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
आभूषेण्यं वो मरुतो महित्वनं दिदृक्षेण्यं सूर्यस्येव चक्षणम् ।
उतो अस्माँ अमृतत्वे दधातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
abhushenyam vo maruto mahitvanam didrikshenyam suryasyeva chakshanam |
uto asman amritatve dadhatana shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
उदीरयथा मरुतः समुद्रतो यूयं वृष्टिं वर्षयथा पुरीषिणः ।
न वो दस्रा उप दस्यन्ति धेनवः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
udirayatha marutah samudrato yuyam vrishtim varshayatha purishinah |
na vo dasra upa dasyanti dhenavah shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
यदश्वान्धूर्षु पृषतीरयुग्ध्वं हिरण्ययान्प्रत्यत्काँ अमुग्ध्वम् ।
विश्वा इत्स्पृधो मरुतो व्यस्यथ शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
yadashvandhurshu prishatirayugdhvam hiranyayanpratyatkan amugdhvam |
vishva itspridho maruto vyasyatha shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
न पर्वता न नद्यो वरन्त वो यत्राचिध्वं मरुतो गच्छथेदु तत् ।
उत द्यावापृथिवी याथना परि शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
na parvata na nadyo varanta vo yatrachidhvam maruto gachchhathedu tat |
uta dyavaprithivi yathana pari shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
यत्पूर्व्यं मरुतो यच्च नूतनं यदुद्यते वसवो यच्च शस्यते ।
विश्वस्य तस्य भवथा नवेदसः शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
yatpurvyam maruto yachcha nutanam yadudyate vasavo yachcha shasyate |
vishvasya tasya bhavatha navedasah shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
मृळत नो मरुतो मा वधिष्टनास्मभ्यं शर्म बहुलं वि यन्तन ।
अधि स्तोत्रस्य सख्यस्य गातन शुभं यातामनु रथा अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
mrilata no maruto ma vadhishtanasmabhyam sharma bahulam vi yantana |
adhi stotrasya sakhyasya gatana shubham yatamanu ratha avritsata ||

verses.sa:
यूयमस्मान्नयत वस्यो अच्छा निरंहतिभ्यो मरुतो गृणानाः ।
जुषध्वं नो हव्यदातिं यजत्रा वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuyamasmannayata vasyo achchha niramhatibhyo maruto grinanah |
jushadhvam no havyadatim yajatra vayam syama patayo rayinam ||

prose.en:
1. WITH gleaming lances, with their breasts adorned with gold, the Maruts, rushing onward, hold high power of life.
They hasten with swift steeds easy to be controlled. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

2. Ye, as ye wist, have gained of your own selves your power: high, O ye Mighty Ones, and wide ye shine abroad.
They with their strength have even measured out the sky.
Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

3. Strong, born together, they together have waxed great: the Heroes more and more have grown to majesty
Resplendent as the Sun's beams in their light are they. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

4. Maruts, your mightiness deserves to be adored, sight to be longed for like the shining of the Sun.
So lead us with your aid to immortality.
Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

5. O Maruts, from the Ocean ye uplift the rain, and fraught with vaporous moisture pour the torrents down.
Never, ye Wonder-Workers, are your Milch-kine dry. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

6. When to your car-poles ye have yoked your spotted deer to be your steeds, and put your golden mantles on,
O Maruts, ye disperse all enemies abroad. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

7. Neither the mountains nor the rivers keep you back: whither ye have resolved thither ye, Maruts, go.
Ye compass round about even the heaven and earth. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.
Whate'er is ancient, Maruts, what of recent time, whate'er is spoken, Vasus, what is chanted forth,
They who take cognizance of all of this are ye. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

9. Be gracious unto us, ye Maruts, slay us not extend ye unto us shelter of many a sort.
Pay due regard unto our friendship and our praise. Their cars moved onward as they went to victory.

10. O Maruts, lead us on to higher fortune deliver us, when lauded, from afflictions.
Accept, ye Holy Ones, the gifts we bring you. May we be masters of abundant riches.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शर्धन्तमा गणं पिष्टं रुक्मेभिरञ्जिभिः ।
विशो अद्य मरुतामव ह्वये दिवश्चिद्रोचनादधि ॥
verses.rom:
agne shardhantama ganam pishtam rukmebhiranjibhih |
visho adya marutamava hvaye divashchidrochanadadhi ||
verses.en:
AGNI, that valorous company adorned with ornaments of gold,
The people of the Maruts, I call down to-day even from the luminous realm of heaven.

verses.sa:
यथा चिन्मन्यसे हृदा तदिन्मे जग्मुराशसः ।
ये ते नेदिष्ठं हवनान्यागमन्तान्वर्ध भीमसंदृशः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha chinmanyase hrida tadinme jagmurashasah |
ye te nedishtham havananyagamantanvardha bhimasamdrishah ||
verses.en:
Even as thou thinkest in thy heart, thither my wishes also tend.
Those who have come most near to thine invoking calls, strengthen them fearful to behold.

verses.sa:
मीळ्हुष्मतीव पृथिवी पराहता मदन्त्येत्यस्मदा ।
ऋक्षो न वो मरुतः शिमीवाँ अमो दुध्रो गौरिव भीमयुः ॥
verses.rom:
milhushmativa prithivi parahata madantyetyasmada |
riksho na vo marutah shimivan amo dudhro gauriva bhimayuh ||
verses.en:
Earth, like a bounteous lady, liberal of her gifts, struck down and shaken, yet exultant, comes to us.
Impetuous as a bear, O Maruts, is you rush terrible as a dreadful bull..

verses.sa:
नि ये रिणन्त्योजसा वृथा गावो न दुर्धुरः ।
अश्मानं चित्स्वर्यं पर्वतं गिरिं प्र च्यावयन्ति यामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ni ye rinantyojasa vritha gavo na durdhurah |
ashmanam chitsvaryam parvatam girim pra chyavayanti yamabhih ||
verses.en:
They who with mighty strength o'erthrow like oxen difficult to yoke,
Cause e'en the heavenly stone to shake ' yea, shake the rocky mountain as they race along.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठ नूनमेषां स्तोमैः समुक्षितानाम् ।
मरुतां पुरुतममपूर्व्यं गवां सर्गमिव ह्वये ॥
verses.rom:
uttishtha nunamesham stomaih samukshitanam |
marutam purutamamapurvyam gavam sargamiva hvaye ||
verses.en:
Rise up! even now with lauds I call the very numerous company,
Unequalled, of these Maruts, like a herd of kine, grown up together in their strength.

verses.sa:
युङ्ग्ध्वं ह्यरुषी रथे युङ्ग्ध्वं रथेषु रोहितः ।
युङ्ग्ध्वं हरी अजिरा धुरि वोळ्हवे वहिष्ठा धुरि वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.rom:
yungdhvam hyarushi rathe yungdhvam ratheshu rohitah |
yungdhvam hari ajira dhuri volhave vahishtha dhuri volhave ||
verses.en:
Bind to your car the bright red mares, yoke the red coursers to your car.
Bind to the pole, to draw, the fleet-foot tawny steeds, the best at drawing, to the pole.

verses.sa:
उत स्य वाज्यरुषस्तुविष्वणिरिह स्म धायि दर्शतः ।
मा वो यामेषु मरुतश्चिरं करत्प्र तं रथेषु चोदत ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya vajyarushastuvishvaniriha sma dhayi darshatah |
ma vo yameshu marutashchiram karatpra tam ratheshu chodata ||
verses.en:
Yea, and this loudly-neighing bright red vigorous horse who hath been stationed, fair to see,
Let him not cause delay, O Maruts,, in your course, urge ye him onward in your cars.

verses.sa:
रथं नु मारुतं वयं श्रवस्युमा हुवामहे ।
आ यस्मिन्तस्थौ सुरणानि बिभ्रती सचा मरुत्सु रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ratham nu marutam vayam shravasyuma huvamahe |
a yasmintasthau suranani bibhrati sacha marutsu rodasi ||
verses.en:
The Maruts' chariot, ever fain to gather glory, we invoke,
Which Rodasi hath mounted, bringing pleasant gifts, with Maruts in her company.

verses.sa:
तं वः शर्धं रथेशुभं त्वेषं पनस्युमा हुवे ।
यस्मिन्सुजाता सुभगा महीयते सचा मरुत्सु मीळ्हुषी ॥
verses.rom:
tam vah shardham ratheshubham tvesham panasyuma huve |
yasminsujata subhaga mahiyate sacha marutsu milhushi ||
verses.en:
I call that brilliant band of yours, adorable, rapid on the car
Whereon the bounteous Dame, auspicious, nobly born, shows glorious with the Marut host.

verses.sa:
आ रुद्रास इन्द्रवन्तः सजोषसो हिरण्यरथाः सुविताय गन्तन ।
इयं वो अस्मत्प्रति हर्यते मतिस्तृष्णजे न दिव उत्सा उदन्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
a rudrasa indravantah sajoshaso hiranyarathah suvitaya gantana |
iyam vo asmatprati haryate matistrishnaje na diva utsa udanyave ||
verses.en:
OF one accord, with Indra, O ye Rudras, come borne on your golden car for our prosperity.
An offering from us, this hymn is brought to you, as, unto one who thirsts for water, heavenly springs.

verses.sa:
वाशीमन्त ऋष्टिमन्तो मनीषिणः सुधन्वान इषुमन्तो निषङ्गिणः ।
स्वश्वा स्थ सुरथाः पृश्निमातरः स्वायुधा मरुतो याथना शुभम् ॥
verses.rom:
vashimanta rishtimanto manishinah sudhanvana ishumanto nishanginah |
svashva stha surathah prishnimatarah svayudha maruto yathana shubham ||
verses.en:
Armed with your daggers, full of wisdom, armed with spears, armed with your quivers, armed with arrows, with good bows,
Good horses and good cars have ye, O Prsni's Sons: ye, Maruts, with good weapons go to victory.

verses.sa:
धूनुथ द्यां पर्वतान्दाशुषे वसु नि वो वना जिहते यामनो भिया ।
कोपयथ पृथिवीं पृश्निमातरः शुभे यदुग्राः पृषतीरयुग्ध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
dhunutha dyam parvatandashushe vasu ni vo vana jihate yamano bhiya |
kopayatha prithivim prishnimatarah shubhe yadugrah prishatirayugdhvam ||
verses.en:
From hills and heaven ye shake wealth for the worshipper: in terror at your coming low the woods bow down.
Ye make the earth to tremble, Sons of Prsni, when for victory ye have yoked, fierce Ones! your spotted deer.

verses.sa:
वातत्विषो मरुतो वर्षनिर्णिजो यमा इव सुसदृशः सुपेशसः ।
पिशङ्गाश्वा अरुणाश्वा अरेपसः प्रत्वक्षसो महिना द्यौरिवोरवः ॥
verses.rom:
vatatvisho maruto varshanirnijo yama iva susadrishah supeshasah |
pishangashva arunashva arepasah pratvakshaso mahina dyaurivoravah ||
verses.en:
Bright with the blasts of wind, wrapped in their robes of rain, like twins of noble aspect and of lovely form,
The Maruts, spotless, with steeds tawny hued and red, strong in their mightiness and spreading wide like heaven.

verses.sa:
पुरुद्रप्सा अञ्जिमन्तः सुदानवस्त्वेषसंदृशो अनवभ्रराधसः ।
सुजातासो जनुषा रुक्मवक्षसो दिवो अर्का अमृतं नाम भेजिरे ॥
verses.rom:
purudrapsa anjimantah sudanavastveshasamdrisho anavabhraradhasah |
sujataso janusha rukmavakshaso divo arka amritam nama bhejire ||
verses.en:
Rich in adornment, rich in drops, munificent, bright in their aspect, yielding bounties that endure,
Noble by birth, adorned with gold upon their breasts, the Singers of the sky have won immortal fame.

verses.sa:
ऋष्टयो वो मरुतो अंसयोरधि सह ओजो बाह्वोर्वो बलं हितम् ।
नृम्णा शीर्षस्वायुधा रथेषु वो विश्वा वः श्रीरधि तनूषु पिपिशे ॥
verses.rom:
rishtayo vo maruto amsayoradhi saha ojo bahvorvo balam hitam |
nrimna shirshasvayudha ratheshu vo vishva vah shriradhi tanushu pipishe ||
verses.en:
Borne on both shoulders, O ye Maruts, are your spears: within your arms is laid your energy and 3trength.
Bold thoughts are in your heads, your weapons in your cars, all glorious majesty is moulded on your forms.

verses.sa:
गोमदश्वावद्रथवत्सुवीरं चन्द्रवद्राधो मरुतो ददा नः ।
प्रशस्तिं नः कृणुत रुद्रियासो भक्षीय वोऽवसो दैव्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
gomadashvavadrathavatsuviram chandravadradho maruto dada nah |
prashastim nah krinuta rudriyaso bhakshiya vo'vaso daivyasya ||
verses.en:
Vouchsafe to us, O Maruts, splendid bounty in cattle and in steeds, in cars and heroes.
Children of Rudra, give us high distinction: may I enjoy your Godlike help and favour.

verses.sa:
हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
haye naro maruto mrilata nastuvimaghaso amrita ritajnah |
satyashrutah kavayo yuvano brihadgirayo brihadukshamanah ||
verses.en:
Ho! Maruts, Heroes, skilled in Law, immortal, be gracious unto us, ye rich in treasures,
Ye hearers of the truth, ye sage and youthful, grown mighty, dwelling on the lofty mountains.

verses.sa:
तमु नूनं तविषीमन्तमेषां स्तुषे गणं मारुतं नव्यसीनाम् ।
य आश्वश्वा अमवद्वहन्त उतेशिरे अमृतस्य स्वराजः ॥
verses.rom:
tamu nunam tavishimantamesham stushe ganam marutam navyasinam |
ya ashvashva amavadvahanta uteshire amritasya svarajah ||
verses.en:
Now do I glorify their mighty cohort, the company of these the youthful Maruts,
Who ride impetuous on with rapid horses, and radiant in themselves, are Lords of Amrta.

verses.sa:
त्वेषं गणं तवसं खादिहस्तं धुनिव्रतं मायिनं दातिवारम् ।
मयोभुवो ये अमिता महित्वा वन्दस्व विप्र तुविराधसो नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
tvesham ganam tavasam khadihastam dhunivratam mayinam dativaram |
mayobhuvo ye amita mahitva vandasva vipra tuviradhaso nrin ||
verses.en:
The mighty glittering band, arm-bound with bracelets, givers of bliss, unmeasured in their greatness,
With magical powers, bountiful, ever-roaring,-these, liberal Heroes, venerate thou singer.

verses.sa:
आ वो यन्तूदवाहासो अद्य वृष्टिं ये विश्वे मरुतो जुनन्ति ।
अयं यो अग्निर्मरुतः समिद्ध एतं जुषध्वं कवयो युवानः ॥
verses.rom:
a vo yantudavahaso adya vrishtim ye vishve maruto junanti |
ayam yo agnirmarutah samiddha etam jushadhvam kavayo yuvanah ||
verses.en:
This day may all your water-bringers, Maruts, they who impel the falling rain, approach us.
This fire, O Maruts, hath been duly kindled; let it find favour with you, youthful Sages.

verses.sa:
यूयं राजानमिर्यं जनाय विभ्वतष्टं जनयथा यजत्राः ।
युष्मदेति मुष्टिहा बाहुजूतो युष्मत्सदश्वो मरुतः सुवीरः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam rajanamiryam janaya vibhvatashtam janayatha yajatrah |
yushmadeti mushtiha bahujuto yushmatsadashvo marutah suvirah ||
verses.en:
Ye raise up for the folk an active ruler whom, Holy Ones! a Master's hand hath fashioned.
Ye send the fighter hand to hand, armmighty, and the brave hero, Maruts with good horses.

verses.sa:
अरा इवेदचरमा अहेव प्रप्र जायन्ते अकवा महोभिः ।
पृश्नेः पुत्रा उपमासो रभिष्ठाः स्वया मत्या मरुतः सं मिमिक्षुः ॥
verses.rom:
ara ivedacharama aheva prapra jayante akava mahobhih |
prishneh putra upamaso rabhishthah svaya matya marutah sam mimikshuh ||
verses.en:
They spring forth more and more, strong in their glories, like days, like spokes where none are last in order.
Highest and mightiest are the Sons of Prsni. Firm to their own intention cling the Maruts.

verses.sa:
यत्प्रायासिष्ट पृषतीभिरश्वैर्वीळुपविभिर्मरुतो रथेभिः ।
क्षोदन्त आपो रिणते वनान्यवोस्रियो वृषभः क्रन्दतु द्यौः ॥
verses.rom:
yatprayasishta prishatibhirashvairvilupavibhirmaruto rathebhih |
kshodanta apo rinate vananyavosriyo vrishabhah krandatu dyauh ||
verses.en:
When ye have hastened on with spotted coursers, O Maruts, on your cars with strong-wrought fellies,
The waters are disturbed, the woods are shattered. Let Dyaus the Red Steer send his thunder downward.

verses.sa:
प्रथिष्ट यामन्पृथिवी चिदेषां भर्तेव गर्भं स्वमिच्छवो धुः ।
वातान्ह्यश्वान्धुर्यायुयुज्रे वर्षं स्वेदं चक्रिरे रुद्रियासः ॥
verses.rom:
prathishta yamanprithivi chidesham bharteva garbham svamichchhavo dhuh |
vatanhyashvandhuryayuyujre varsham svedam chakrire rudriyasah ||
verses.en:
Even Earth hath spread herself wide at their coming, and they as husbands have with power impregned her.
They to the pole have yoked the winds for coursers: their sweat have they made rain, these Sons of Rudra.

verses.sa:
हये नरो मरुतो मृळता नस्तुवीमघासो अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
सत्यश्रुतः कवयो युवानो बृहद्गिरयो बृहदुक्षमाणाः ॥
verses.rom:
haye naro maruto mrilata nastuvimaghaso amrita ritajnah |
satyashrutah kavayo yuvano brihadgirayo brihadukshamanah ||
verses.en:
Ho! Maruts, Heroes, skilled in Law, immortal, be gracious unto us, ye rich in treasures,
Ye hearers of the truth, ye sage and youthful, grown mighty, dwelling on the lofty mountains.

verses.sa:
प्र व स्पळक्रन्सुविताय दावनेऽर्चा दिवे प्र पृथिव्या ऋतं भरे ।
उक्षन्ते अश्वान्तरुषन्त आ रजोऽनु स्वं भानुं श्रथयन्ते अर्णवैः ॥
verses.rom:
pra va spalakransuvitaya davane'rcha dive pra prithivya ritam bhare |
ukshante ashvantarushanta a rajo'nu svam bhanum shrathayante arnavaih ||
verses.en:
YOUR spy hath called to you to give prosperity. I sing to Heaven and Earth and offer sacrifice.
They bathe their steeds and hasten through the firmament: they spread abroad their radiance through the sea of cloud.

verses.sa:
अमादेषां भियसा भूमिरेजति नौर्न पूर्णा क्षरति व्यथिर्यती ।
दूरेदृशो ये चितयन्त एमभिरन्तर्महे विदथे येतिरे नरः ॥
verses.rom:
amadesham bhiyasa bhumirejati naurna purna ksharati vyathiryati |
duredrisho ye chitayanta emabhirantarmahe vidathe yetire narah ||
verses.en:
Earth shakes and reels in terror at their onward rush, like a full ship which, quivering, lets the water in.
Marked on their ways are they, visible from afar: the Heroes press between in mighty armament.

verses.sa:
गवामिव श्रियसे शृङ्गमुत्तमं सूर्यो न चक्षू रजसो विसर्जने ।
अत्या इव सुभ्वश्चारव स्थन मर्या इव श्रियसे चेतथा नरः ॥
verses.rom:
gavamiva shriyase shringamuttamam suryo na chakshu rajaso visarjane |
atya iva subhvashcharava sthana marya iva shriyase chetatha narah ||
verses.en:
As the exalted horn of bulls for splendid might, as the Sun's eye set in the firmament's expanse,
Like vigorous horses ye are beauteous to behold, and for your glory show like bridegrooms, O ye Men.

verses.sa:
को वो महान्ति महतामुदश्नवत्कस्काव्या मरुतः को ह पौंस्या ।
यूयं ह भूमिं किरणं न रेजथ प्र यद्भरध्वे सुविताय दावने ॥
verses.rom:
ko vo mahanti mahatamudashnavatkaskavya marutah ko ha paumsya |
yuyam ha bhumim kiranam na rejatha pra yadbharadhve suvitaya davane ||
verses.en:
Who, O ye Maruts, may attain the mighty lore of you the mighty, who may reach your manly deeds?
Ye, verily, make earth tremble like a ray of light what time ye bring your boons to give prosperity,

verses.sa:
अश्वा इवेदरुषासः सबन्धवः शूरा इव प्रयुधः प्रोत युयुधुः ।
मर्या इव सुवृधो वावृधुर्नरः सूर्यस्य चक्षुः प्र मिनन्ति वृष्टिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ashva ivedarushasah sabandhavah shura iva prayudhah prota yuyudhuh |
marya iva suvridho vavridhurnarah suryasya chakshuh pra minanti vrishtibhih ||
verses.en:
Like steeds of ruddy colour, scions of one race, as foremost champions they have battled in the van.
The Heroes have waxed strong like we.1grown manly youths; with floods of rain they make the Sun's eye fade away,

verses.sa:
ते अज्येष्ठा अकनिष्ठास उद्भिदोऽमध्यमासो महसा वि वावृधुः ।
सुजातासो जनुषा पृश्निमातरो दिवो मर्या आ नो अच्छा जिगातन ॥
verses.rom:
te ajyeshtha akanishthasa udbhido'madhyamaso mahasa vi vavridhuh |
sujataso janusha prishnimataro divo marya a no achchha jigatana ||
verses.en:
Having no eldest and no youngest in their band, no middlemost, preeminent they have waxed in might,
These Sons of Prsni, sprung of noble ancestry: come hitherward to us, ye bridegrooms of the sky.

verses.sa:
वयो न ये श्रेणीः पप्तुरोजसान्तान्दिवो बृहतः सानुनस्परि ।
अश्वास एषामुभये यथा विदुः प्र पर्वतस्य नभनूँरचुच्यवुः ॥
verses.rom:
vayo na ye shrenih papturojasantandivo brihatah sanunaspari |
ashvasa eshamubhaye yatha viduh pra parvatasya nabhanunrachuchyavuh ||
verses.en:
Like birds of air they flew with might in lengthened lines from heaven's high ridges to the borders of the sky.
The steeds who carry them, as Gods and mortals know, have caused the waters of the mountains to descend.

verses.sa:
मिमातु द्यौरदितिर्वीतये नः सं दानुचित्रा उषसो यतन्ताम् ।
आचुच्यवुर्दिव्यं कोशमेत ऋषे रुद्रस्य मरुतो गृणानाः ॥
verses.rom:
mimatu dyauraditirvitaye nah sam danuchitra ushaso yatantam |
achuchyavurdivyam koshameta rishe rudrasya maruto grinanah ||
verses.en:
May Dyaus, the Infinite, roar for our banquet: may Dawns toil for us, glittering with moisture.
Lauded by thee, these Maruts, Sons o Rudra, O Rsi, have sent down the heavenly treasure.

verses.sa:
ईळे अग्निं स्ववसं नमोभिरिह प्रसत्तो वि चयत्कृतं नः ।
रथैरिव प्र भरे वाजयद्भिः प्रदक्षिणिन्मरुतां स्तोममृध्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
ile agnim svavasam namobhiriha prasatto vi chayatkritam nah |
rathairiva pra bhare vajayadbhih pradakshininmarutam stomamridhyam ||
verses.en:
I LAUD with reverence the gracious Agni: here may he sit and part our meed among us.
As with spoil-seeking cars I bring oblation: turned rightward I will swell the Marut's, praise-song.

verses.sa:
आ ये तस्थुः पृषतीषु श्रुतासु सुखेषु रुद्रा मरुतो रथेषु ।
वना चिदुग्रा जिहते नि वो भिया पृथिवी चिद्रेजते पर्वतश्चित् ॥
verses.rom:
a ye tasthuh prishatishu shrutasu sukheshu rudra maruto ratheshu |
vana chidugra jihate ni vo bhiya prithivi chidrejate parvatashchit ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, yea, the Rudras, who have mounted their famous spotted deer and cars swift-moving,-
Before you, fierce Ones! woods bow down in terror: Earth, even the mountain, trembles at your coming.

verses.sa:
पर्वतश्चिन्महि वृद्धो बिभाय दिवश्चित्सानु रेजत स्वने वः ।
यत्क्रीळथ मरुत ऋष्टिमन्त आप इव सध्र्यञ्चो धवध्वे ॥
verses.rom:
parvatashchinmahi vriddho bibhaya divashchitsanu rejata svane vah |
yatkrilatha maruta rishtimanta apa iva sadhryancho dhavadhve ||
verses.en:
Though vast and tall, the mountain is affrighted, the height of heaven is shaken at your roaring
When, armed with lances, ye are sporting, Maruts, and rush along together like the waters.

verses.sa:
वरा इवेद्रैवतासो हिरण्यैरभि स्वधाभिस्तन्वः पिपिश्रे ।
श्रिये श्रेयांसस्तवसो रथेषु सत्रा महांसि चक्रिरे तनूषु ॥
verses.rom:
vara ivedraivataso hiranyairabhi svadhabhistanvah pipishre |
shriye shreyamsastavaso ratheshu satra mahamsi chakrire tanushu ||
verses.en:
They, like young suitors, sons of wealthy houses, have with their golden natures decked their bodies.
Strong on their cars, the lordly Ones, for glory, have set their splendours on their forms for ever.

verses.sa:
अज्येष्ठासो अकनिष्ठास एते सं भ्रातरो वावृधुः सौभगाय ।
युवा पिता स्वपा रुद्र एषां सुदुघा पृश्निः सुदिना मरुद्भ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ajyeshthaso akanishthasa ete sam bhrataro vavridhuh saubhagaya |
yuva pita svapa rudra esham sudugha prishnih sudina marudbhyah ||
verses.en:
None being eldest, none among them youngest, as brothers they have grown to happy fortune.
May their Sire Rudra, young and deft, and Prsni pouring much milk, bring fair days to the Maruts.

verses.sa:
यदुत्तमे मरुतो मध्यमे वा यद्वावमे सुभगासो दिवि ष्ठ ।
अतो नो रुद्रा उत वा न्वस्याग्ने वित्ताद्धविषो यद्यजाम ॥
verses.rom:
yaduttame maruto madhyame va yadvavame subhagaso divi shtha |
ato no rudra uta va nvasyagne vittaddhavisho yadyajama ||
verses.en:
Whether, O blessed Maruts, ye be dwelling in highest, midmost, or in lowest heaven,
Thence, O ye Rudras, and thou also, Agni, notice the sacrificial food we offer.

verses.sa:
अग्निश्च यन्मरुतो विश्ववेदसो दिवो वहध्व उत्तरादधि ष्णुभिः ।
ते मन्दसाना धुनयो रिशादसो वामं धत्त यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
agnishcha yanmaruto vishvavedaso divo vahadhva uttaradadhi shnubhih |
te mandasana dhunayo rishadaso vamam dhatta yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, Lords of all, when Agni and when ye drive downward from sublimest heaven along the heights,
Shakers of all, rejoicing, slayers of the foe, give riches to the Soma-pressing worshipper.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मरुद्भिः शुभयद्भिरृक्वभिः सोमं पिब मन्दसानो गणश्रिभिः ।
पावकेभिर्विश्वमिन्वेभिरायुभिर्वैश्वानर प्रदिवा केतुना सजूः ॥
verses.rom:
agne marudbhih shubhayadbhirrikvabhih somam piba mandasano ganashribhih |
pavakebhirvishvaminvebhirayubhirvaishvanara pradiva ketuna sajuh ||
verses.en:
O Agni, with the Maruts as they gleam and sing, gathered in troop, rejoicing drink the Soma juice;
With these the living ones who cleanse and further all, joined with thy banner, O Vaisvanara, from of old.

verses.sa:
के ष्ठा नरः श्रेष्ठतमा य एकएक आयय ।
परमस्याः परावतः ॥
verses.rom:
ke shtha narah shreshthatama ya ekaeka ayaya |
paramasyah paravatah ||
verses.en:
O HEROES lordliest of all, who are ye that have singly come
Forth from a region most remote?

verses.sa:
क्व वोऽश्वाः क्वाभीशवः कथं शेक कथा यय ।
पृष्ठे सदो नसोर्यमः ॥
verses.rom:
kva vo'shvah kvabhishavah katham sheka katha yaya |
prishthe sado nasoryamah ||
verses.en:
Where are your horses, where the reins? How came ye? how had ye the power?
Rein was on nose and seat on back.

verses.sa:
जघने चोद एषां वि सक्थानि नरो यमुः ।
पुत्रकृथे न जनयः ॥
verses.rom:
jaghane choda esham vi sakthani naro yamuh |
putrakrithe na janayah ||
verses.en:
The whip is laid upon the flank. The heroes stretch their thighs apart,
Like women when the babe is born.

verses.sa:
परा वीरास एतन मर्यासो भद्रजानयः ।
अग्नितपो यथासथ ॥
verses.rom:
para virasa etana maryaso bhadrajanayah |
agnitapo yathasatha ||
verses.en:
Go ye, O Heroes, far away, ye bridegrooms with a lovely Spouse
That ye may warm you at the fire.

verses.sa:
सनत्साश्व्यं पशुमुत गव्यं शतावयम् ।
श्यावाश्वस्तुताय या दोर्वीरायोपबर्बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
sanatsashvyam pashumuta gavyam shatavayam |
shyavashvastutaya ya dorvirayopabarbrihat ||
verses.en:
May she gain cattle for her meed, hundreds of sheep and steeds and kine,
Who threw embracing arms around the hero whom Gyavaiva praised.

verses.sa:
उत त्वा स्त्री शशीयसी पुंसो भवति वस्यसी ।
अदेवत्रादराधसः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tva stri shashiyasi pumso bhavati vasyasi |
adevatradaradhasah ||
verses.en:
Yea, many a woman is more firm and better than the man who turns
Away from Gods, and offers not.

verses.sa:
वि या जानाति जसुरिं वि तृष्यन्तं वि कामिनम् ।
देवत्रा कृणुते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
vi ya janati jasurim vi trishyantam vi kaminam |
devatra krinute manah ||
verses.en:
She who discerns the weak and worn, the man who thirsts and is in want
She sets her mind upon the Gods.

verses.sa:
उत घा नेमो अस्तुतः पुमाँ इति ब्रुवे पणिः ।
स वैरदेय इत्समः ॥
verses.rom:
uta gha nemo astutah puman iti bruve panih |
sa vairadeya itsamah ||
verses.en:
And yet full many a one, unpraised, mean niggard, is entitled man:
Only in were gild is he such.

verses.sa:
उत मेऽरपद्युवतिर्ममन्दुषी प्रति श्यावाय वर्तनिम् ।
वि रोहिता पुरुमीळ्हाय येमतुर्विप्राय दीर्घयशसे ॥
verses.rom:
uta me'rapadyuvatirmamandushi prati shyavaya vartanim |
vi rohita purumilhaya yematurvipraya dirghayashase ||
verses.en:
And she, the young, the joyous-spirited, divulged the path to Syava, yea, to me.
Two red steeds carried me to Purumilha's side, that sage of far-extended fame,

verses.sa:
यो मे धेनूनां शतं वैददश्विर्यथा ददत् ।
तरन्त इव मंहना ॥
verses.rom:
yo me dhenunam shatam vaidadashviryatha dadat |
taranta iva mamhana ||
verses.en:
Him who, like Vaidadasvi, like Taranta, hath bestowed on me
A hundred cows in liberal gift.

verses.sa:
य ईं वहन्त आशुभिः पिबन्तो मदिरं मधु ।
अत्र श्रवांसि दधिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ya im vahanta ashubhih pibanto madiram madhu |
atra shravamsi dadhire ||
verses.en:
They who are borne by rapid steeds, drinking the meath that gives delight,
They have attained high glories here.

verses.sa:
येषां श्रियाधि रोदसी विभ्राजन्ते रथेष्वा ।
दिवि रुक्म इवोपरि ॥
verses.rom:
yesham shriyadhi rodasi vibhrajante ratheshva |
divi rukma ivopari ||
verses.en:
They by whose splendour both the worlds are over-spread they shine on cars
As the gold gleams above in heaven.

verses.sa:
युवा स मारुतो गणस्त्वेषरथो अनेद्यः ।
शुभंयावाप्रतिष्कुतः ॥
verses.rom:
yuva sa maruto ganastvesharatho anedyah |
shubhamyavapratishkutah ||
verses.en:
That Marut band is ever young, borne on bright cars, unblamable,
Moving to victory, checked by none.

verses.sa:
को वेद नूनमेषां यत्रा मदन्ति धूतयः ।
ऋतजाता अरेपसः ॥
verses.rom:
ko veda nunamesham yatra madanti dhutayah |
ritajata arepasah ||
verses.en:
Who knoweth, verily, of these where the All-shakers take delight,
Born, spotless, after sacred Law?

verses.sa:
यूयं मर्तं विपन्यवः प्रणेतार इत्था धिया ।
श्रोतारो यामहूतिषु ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam martam vipanyavah pranetara ittha dhiya |
shrotaro yamahutishu ||
verses.en:
Guides are ye, lovers of the song to mortal man through holy hymn,
And hearers when he cries for help.

verses.sa:
ते नो वसूनि काम्या पुरुश्चन्द्रा रिशादसः ।
आ यज्ञियासो ववृत्तन ॥
verses.rom:
te no vasuni kamya purushchandra rishadasah |
a yajniyaso vavrittana ||
verses.en:
Do ye, destroyers of the foe, worshipful and exceeding bright,
Send down the treasures that we crave.

verses.sa:
एतं मे स्तोममूर्म्ये दार्भ्याय परा वह ।
गिरो देवि रथीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
etam me stomamurmye darbhyaya para vaha |
giro devi rathiriva ||
verses.en:
OUrmya, bear thou far away to Darbhya this my hymn of praise,
Songs, Goddess, as if chariot-borne.

verses.sa:
उत मे वोचतादिति सुतसोमे रथवीतौ ।
न कामो अप वेति मे ॥
verses.rom:
uta me vochataditi sutasome rathavitau |
na kamo apa veti me ||
verses.en:
From me to Rathaviti say, when he hath pressed the Soma juice,
The wish I had departeth not.

verses.sa:
एष क्षेति रथवीतिर्मघवा गोमतीरनु ।
पर्वतेष्वपश्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
esha ksheti rathavitirmaghava gomatiranu |
parvateshvapashritah ||
verses.en:
This wealthy Rathaviti dwells among the people rich in kine,
Among the mountains, far withdrawn.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन ऋतमपिहितं ध्रुवं वां सूर्यस्य यत्र विमुचन्त्यश्वान् ।
दश शता सह तस्थुस्तदेकं देवानां श्रेष्ठं वपुषामपश्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritena ritamapihitam dhruvam vam suryasya yatra vimuchantyashvan |
dasha shata saha tasthustadekam devanam shreshtham vapushamapashyam ||
verses.en:
BY your high Law firm order is established there where they loose for travel Surya's horses.
Ten hundred stood together: there I looked on this the most marvellous Deities' one chief glory.

verses.sa:
तत्सु वां मित्रावरुणा महित्वमीर्मा तस्थुषीरहभिर्दुदुह्रे ।
विश्वाः पिन्वथः स्वसरस्य धेना अनु वामेकः पविरा ववर्त ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu vam mitravaruna mahitvamirma tasthushirahabhirduduhre |
vishvah pinvathah svasarasya dhena anu vamekah pavira vavarta ||
verses.en:
This, Mitra-Varuna, is your special greatness: floods that stood there they with the days attracted.
Ye cause to flow all voices of the cow pen: your single chariot felly hath rolled hither.

verses.sa:
अधारयतं पृथिवीमुत द्यां मित्रराजाना वरुणा महोभिः ।
वर्धयतमोषधीः पिन्वतं गा अव वृष्टिं सृजतं जीरदानू ॥
verses.rom:
adharayatam prithivimuta dyam mitrarajana varuna mahobhih |
vardhayatamoshadhih pinvatam ga ava vrishtim srijatam jiradanu ||
verses.en:
O Mitra-Varuna, ye by your greatness, both Kings, have firmly stablished earth and heaven,
Ye caused the cows to stream, the plants to flourish, and, scattering swift drops, sent down the rain-flood.

verses.sa:
आ वामश्वासः सुयुजो वहन्तु यतरश्मय उप यन्त्वर्वाक् ।
घृतस्य निर्णिगनु वर्तते वामुप सिन्धवः प्रदिवि क्षरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
a vamashvasah suyujo vahantu yatarashmaya upa yantvarvak |
ghritasya nirniganu vartate vamupa sindhavah pradivi ksharanti ||
verses.en:
Let your well-harnessed horses bear you hither: hitherward let them come with reins drawn tightly.
A covering cloud of sacred oil attends you, and your streams flow to us from days aforetime.

verses.sa:
अनु श्रुताममतिं वर्धदुर्वीं बर्हिरिव यजुषा रक्षमाणा ।
नमस्वन्ता धृतदक्षाधि गर्ते मित्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
anu shrutamamatim vardhadurvim barhiriva yajusha rakshamana |
namasvanta dhritadakshadhi garte mitrasathe varunelasvantah ||
verses.en:
To make the lustre wider and more famous, guarding the sacred grass with veneration,
Ye, Mitra-Varuna, firm, strong, awe-inspiring, are seated on a throne amid oblations.

verses.sa:
अक्रविहस्ता सुकृते परस्पा यं त्रासाथे वरुणेळास्वन्तः ।
राजाना क्षत्रमहृणीयमाना सहस्रस्थूणं बिभृथः सह द्वौ ॥
verses.rom:
akravihasta sukrite paraspa yam trasathe varunelasvantah |
rajana kshatramahriniyamana sahasrasthunam bibhrithah saha dvau ||
verses.en:
With hands that shed no blood, guarding the pious, whom, Varuni3, ye save amid oblations.
Ye Twain, together, Kings of willing spirit, uphold dominion based on thousand pillars.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यनिर्णिगयो अस्य स्थूणा वि भ्राजते दिव्यश्वाजनीव ।
भद्रे क्षेत्रे निमिता तिल्विले वा सनेम मध्वो अधिगर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyanirnigayo asya sthuna vi bhrajate divyashvajaniva |
bhadre kshetre nimita tilvile va sanema madhvo adhigartyasya ||
verses.en:
Adorned with gold, its columns are of iron. in heaven it glitters like a whip for horses;
Or stablished on a field deep-spoiled and fruitful. So may we share the meath that loads your car-seat.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यरूपमुषसो व्युष्टावयस्थूणमुदिता सूर्यस्य ।
आ रोहथो वरुण मित्र गर्तमतश्चक्षाथे अदितिं दितिं च ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyarupamushaso vyushtavayasthunamudita suryasya |
a rohatho varuna mitra gartamatashchakshathe aditim ditim cha ||
verses.en:
Ye mount your car gold-hued at break of morning, and iron-pillared when the Sun is setting,
And from that place, O Varuna and Mitra, behold infinity and limitation.

verses.sa:
यद्बंहिष्ठं नातिविधे सुदानू अच्छिद्रं शर्म भुवनस्य गोपा ।
तेन नो मित्रावरुणावविष्टं सिषासन्तो जिगीवांसः स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
yadbamhishtham natividhe sudanu achchhidram sharma bhuvanasya gopa |
tena no mitravarunavavishtam sishasanto jigivamsah syama ||
verses.en:
Bountiful guardians of the world! the shelter that is impenetrable, strongest, flawless,
Aid us with that, O Varuna and Mitra, and when we long to win may we be victors.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य गोपावधि तिष्ठथो रथं सत्यधर्माणा परमे व्योमनि ।
यमत्र मित्रावरुणावथो युवं तस्मै वृष्टिर्मधुमत्पिन्वते दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya gopavadhi tishthatho ratham satyadharmana parame vyomani |
yamatra mitravarunavatho yuvam tasmai vrishtirmadhumatpinvate divah ||
verses.en:
GUARDIANS of Order, ye whose Laws are ever true, in the sublimest heaven your chariot ye ascend.
O Mitra-Varuna whomsoe'er ye: favour, here, to him the rain with sweetness streameth down from heaven.

verses.sa:
सम्राजावस्य भुवनस्य राजथो मित्रावरुणा विदथे स्वर्दृशा ।
वृष्टिं वां राधो अमृतत्वमीमहे द्यावापृथिवी वि चरन्ति तन्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
samrajavasya bhuvanasya rajatho mitravaruna vidathe svardrisha |
vrishtim vam radho amritatvamimahe dyavaprithivi vi charanti tanyavah ||
verses.en:
This world's imperial Kings, O Mitra-Varuna, ye rule in holy synod, looking on the light.
We pray for rain, your boon, and immortality. Through heaven and over earth the thunderers take their way.

verses.sa:
सम्राजा उग्रा वृषभा दिवस्पती पृथिव्या मित्रावरुणा विचर्षणी ।
चित्रेभिरभ्रैरुप तिष्ठथो रवं द्यां वर्षयथो असुरस्य मायया ॥
verses.rom:
samraja ugra vrishabha divaspati prithivya mitravaruna vicharshani |
chitrebhirabhrairupa tishthatho ravam dyam varshayatho asurasya mayaya ||
verses.en:
Imperial Kings, strong, Heroes, Lords of earth and heaven, Mitra and Varuna, ye ever active Ones,
Ye wait on thunder with the many-tinted clouds, and by the Asura's magic power cause Heaven to rain.

verses.sa:
माया वां मित्रावरुणा दिवि श्रिता सूर्यो ज्योतिश्चरति चित्रमायुधम् ।
तमभ्रेण वृष्ट्या गूहथो दिवि पर्जन्य द्रप्सा मधुमन्त ईरते ॥
verses.rom:
maya vam mitravaruna divi shrita suryo jyotishcharati chitramayudham |
tamabhrena vrishtya guhatho divi parjanya drapsa madhumanta irate ||
verses.en:
Your magic, Mitra-Varuna, resteth in the heaven. The Sun, the wondrous weapon, cometh forth as light.
Ye hide him in the sky with cloud and flood of rain, and water-drops, Parjanya! full of sweetness flow.

verses.sa:
रथं युञ्जते मरुतः शुभे सुखं शूरो न मित्रावरुणा गविष्टिषु ।
रजांसि चित्रा वि चरन्ति तन्यवो दिवः सम्राजा पयसा न उक्षतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ratham yunjate marutah shubhe sukham shuro na mitravaruna gavishtishu |
rajamsi chitra vi charanti tanyavo divah samraja payasa na ukshatam ||
verses.en:
The Maruts yoke their easy car for victory, O Mitra-Varuna, as a hero in the wars.
The thunderers roam through regions varied in their hues. Imperial Kings, bedew us with the milk of heaven.

verses.sa:
वाचं सु मित्रावरुणाविरावतीं पर्जन्यश्चित्रां वदति त्विषीमतीम् ।
अभ्रा वसत मरुतः सु मायया द्यां वर्षयतमरुणामरेपसम् ॥
verses.rom:
vacham su mitravarunaviravatim parjanyashchitram vadati tvishimatim |
abhra vasata marutah su mayaya dyam varshayatamarunamarepasam ||
verses.en:
Refreshing is your voice, O Mitra-Varuna: Parjanya sendeth out a wondrous mighty voice.
With magic power the Maruts clothe them with the clouds. Ye Two cause Heaven to rain, the red, the spotless One.

verses.sa:
धर्मणा मित्रावरुणा विपश्चिता व्रता रक्षेथे असुरस्य मायया ।
ऋतेन विश्वं भुवनं वि राजथः सूर्यमा धत्थो दिवि चित्र्यं रथम् ॥
verses.rom:
dharmana mitravaruna vipashchita vrata rakshethe asurasya mayaya |
ritena vishvam bhuvanam vi rajathah suryama dhattho divi chitryam ratham ||
verses.en:
Wise, with your Law and through the Asura's magic power ye guard the ordinances, Mitra-Varuna.
Ye by eternal Order govern all the world. Ye set the Sun in heaven as a refulgent car.

verses.sa:
वरुणं वो रिशादसमृचा मित्रं हवामहे ।
परि व्रजेव बाह्वोर्जगन्वांसा स्वर्णरम् ॥
verses.rom:
varunam vo rishadasamricha mitram havamahe |
pari vrajeva bahvorjaganvamsa svarnaram ||
verses.en:
You, foeman-slaying Varuna and Mitra, we invoke with song,
Who, as with penfold of your arms, encompass round the realm of light.

verses.sa:
ता बाहवा सुचेतुना प्र यन्तमस्मा अर्चते ।
शेवं हि जार्यं वां विश्वासु क्षासु जोगुवे ॥
verses.rom:
ta bahava suchetuna pra yantamasma archate |
shevam hi jaryam vam vishvasu kshasu joguve ||
verses.en:
Stretch out your arms with favouring love unto this man who singeth hymns,
For in all places is sung forth your ever gracious friendliness.

verses.sa:
यन्नूनमश्यां गतिं मित्रस्य यायां पथा ।
अस्य प्रियस्य शर्मण्यहिंसानस्य सश्चिरे ॥
verses.rom:
yannunamashyam gatim mitrasya yayam patha |
asya priyasya sharmanyahimsanasya sashchire ||
verses.en:
That I may gain a refuge now, may my steps be on Mitra's path.
Men go protected in the charge of this dear Friend who harms us not.

verses.sa:
युवाभ्यां मित्रावरुणोपमं धेयामृचा ।
यद्ध क्षये मघोनां स्तोतॄणां च स्पूर्धसे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvabhyam mitravarunopamam dheyamricha |
yaddha kshaye maghonam stotrinam cha spurdhase ||
verses.en:
Mitra and Varuna, from you may I, by song, win noblest meed.
That shall stir envy in the homes of wealthy chiefs and those who praise.

verses.sa:
आ नो मित्र सुदीतिभिर्वरुणश्च सधस्थ आ ।
स्वे क्षये मघोनां सखीनां च वृधसे ॥
verses.rom:
a no mitra suditibhirvarunashcha sadhastha a |
sve kshaye maghonam sakhinam cha vridhase ||
verses.en:
With your fair splendours, Varuna and Mitra, to our gathering come,
That in their homes the wealthy chiefs and they who are your friends may thrive.

verses.sa:
युवं नो येषु वरुण क्षत्रं बृहच्च बिभृथः ।
उरु णो वाजसातये कृतं राये स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam no yeshu varuna kshatram brihachcha bibhrithah |
uru no vajasataye kritam raye svastaye ||
verses.en:
With those, moreover, among whom ye hold your high supremacy,
Vouchsafe us room that we may win strength for prosperity and wealth.

verses.sa:
उच्छन्त्यां मे यजता देवक्षत्रे रुशद्गवि ।
सुतं सोमं न हस्तिभिरा पड्भिर्धावतं नरा बिभ्रतावर्चनानसम् ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhantyam me yajata devakshatre rushadgavi |
sutam somam na hastibhira padbhirdhavatam nara bibhratavarchananasam ||
verses.en:
When morning flushes, Holy Ones! in the Gods' realm where white Cows shine,
Supporting Arcananas, speed, ye Heroes, with your active feet hither to my pressed Soma juice.

verses.sa:
यश्चिकेत स सुक्रतुर्देवत्रा स ब्रवीतु नः ।
वरुणो यस्य दर्शतो मित्रो वा वनते गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
yashchiketa sa sukraturdevatra sa bravitu nah |
varuno yasya darshato mitro va vanate girah ||
verses.en:
FULL wise is he who hath discerned: let him speak to us of the Gods,—
The man whose praise-songs Varuṇa the beautiful, or Mitra, loves.

verses.sa:
ता हि श्रेष्ठवर्चसा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा ।
ता सत्पती ऋतावृध ऋतावाना जनेजने ॥
verses.rom:
ta hi shreshthavarchasa rajana dirghashruttama |
ta satpati ritavridha ritavana janejane ||
verses.en:
For they are Kings of noblest might, of glorious fame most widely spread;
Lords of the brave, who strengthen Law, the Holy Ones with every race.

verses.sa:
ता वामियानोऽवसे पूर्वा उप ब्रुवे सचा ।
स्वश्वासः सु चेतुना वाजाँ अभि प्र दावने ॥
verses.rom:
ta vamiyano'vase purva upa bruve sacha |
svashvasah su chetuna vajan abhi pra davane ||
verses.en:
Approaching you with prayer for aid, together I address you first
We who have good steeds call on you, Most Sage, to give us strength besides.

verses.sa:
मित्रो अंहोश्चिदादुरु क्षयाय गातुं वनते ।
मित्रस्य हि प्रतूर्वतः सुमतिरस्ति विधतः ॥
verses.rom:
mitro amhoshchidaduru kshayaya gatum vanate |
mitrasya hi praturvatah sumatirasti vidhatah ||
verses.en:
E’en out of misery Mitra gives a way to dwelling at our case,
For he who worships hath the grace of Mitra, fighter in the van. '

verses.sa:
वयं मित्रस्यावसि स्याम सप्रथस्तमे ।
अनेहसस्त्वोतयः सत्रा वरुणशेषसः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam mitrasyavasi syama saprathastame |
anehasastvotayah satra varunasheshasah ||
verses.en:
In Mitra's shelter that extends to utmost distance may we dwell,
Unmenaced, guarded by the care, ever as sons of Varuṇa.

verses.sa:
युवं मित्रेमं जनं यतथः सं च नयथः ।
मा मघोनः परि ख्यतं मो अस्माकमृषीणां गोपीथे न उरुष्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam mitremam janam yatathah sam cha nayathah |
ma maghonah pari khyatam mo asmakamrishinam gopithe na urushyatam ||
verses.en:
Ye, Mitra, urge this people on, and to one end direct their ways.
Neglect not ye the wealthy chiefs, neglect not us the Ṛṣis: be our guardians when ye quaff the milk.

verses.sa:
आ चिकितान सुक्रतू देवौ मर्त रिशादसा ।
वरुणाय ऋतपेशसे दधीत प्रयसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
a chikitana sukratu devau marta rishadasa |
varunaya ritapeshase dadhita prayase mahe ||
verses.en:
O SAPIENT man, call the Two Gods, the very wise, who slay the foe.
For Varuna, whose form is Law, place offerings for his great delight.

verses.sa:
ता हि क्षत्रमविह्रुतं सम्यगसुर्यमाशाते ।
अध व्रतेव मानुषं स्वर्ण धायि दर्शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta hi kshatramavihrutam samyagasuryamashate |
adha vrateva manusham svarna dhayi darshatam ||
verses.en:
For they have won unbroken sway in full perfection, power divine.
And, like high laws, the world of man hath been made beautiful as light.

verses.sa:
ता वामेषे रथानामुर्वीं गव्यूतिमेषाम् ।
रातहव्यस्य सुष्टुतिं दधृक्स्तोमैर्मनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
