ta vameshe rathanamurvim gavyutimesham |
ratahavyasya sushtutim dadhrikstomairmanamahe ||
verses.en:
Therefore we praise you that your cars may travel far in front of ours-
You who accept the eulogy of Ratahavya with his hymns.

verses.sa:
अधा हि काव्या युवं दक्षस्य पूर्भिरद्भुता ।
नि केतुना जनानां चिकेथे पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
adha hi kavya yuvam dakshasya purbhiradbhuta |
ni ketuna jananam chikethe putadakshasa ||
verses.en:
And ye show whom, Wondrous Gods with fulness of intelligence.
By men's discernment are ye marked, O ye whose might is purified.

verses.sa:
तदृतं पृथिवि बृहच्छ्रवएष ऋषीणाम् ।
ज्रयसानावरं पृथ्वति क्षरन्ति यामभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tadritam prithivi brihachchhravaesha rishinam |
jrayasanavaram prithvati ksharanti yamabhih ||
verses.en:
This is the Law sublime, O Earth: to aid the Rsis' toil for fame
The Two, wide-spreading, are prepared. They come with ample overflow.

verses.sa:
आ यद्वामीयचक्षसा मित्र वयं च सूरयः ।
व्यचिष्ठे बहुपाय्ये यतेमहि स्वराज्ये ॥
verses.rom:
a yadvamiyachakshasa mitra vayam cha surayah |
vyachishthe bahupayye yatemahi svarajye ||
verses.en:
Mitra, ye Gods with wandering eyes, would that the worshippers and we
Might strive to reach the realm ye rule, most spacious and protected well,

verses.sa:
बळित्था देव निष्कृतमादित्या यजतं बृहत् ।
वरुण मित्रार्यमन्वर्षिष्ठं क्षत्रमाशाथे ॥
verses.rom:
balittha deva nishkritamaditya yajatam brihat |
varuna mitraryamanvarshishtham kshatramashathe ||
verses.en:
YE Gods, Adityas, Varuna, Aryaman, Mitra, verily
Have here obtained supremest sway, high, holy, set apart for you.

verses.sa:
आ यद्योनिं हिरण्ययं वरुण मित्र सदथः ।
धर्तारा चर्षणीनां यन्तं सुम्नं रिशादसा ॥
verses.rom:
a yadyonim hiranyayam varuna mitra sadathah |
dhartara charshaninam yantam sumnam rishadasa ||
verses.en:
When, Varuna and Mitra, ye sit in your golden dwelling-place,
Ye Twain, supporters of mankind, foe slayers, give felicity.

verses.sa:
विश्वे हि विश्ववेदसो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
व्रता पदेव सश्चिरे पान्ति मर्त्यं रिषः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve hi vishvavedaso varuno mitro aryama |
vrata padeva sashchire panti martyam rishah ||
verses.en:
All these, possessors of all wealth, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
Follow their ways, as if with feet, and guard from injury mortal man.

verses.sa:
ते हि सत्या ऋतस्पृश ऋतावानो जनेजने ।
सुनीथासः सुदानवोऽंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi satya ritasprisha ritavano janejane |
sunithasah sudanavo'mhoshchiduruchakrayah ||
verses.en:
For they are true, they cleave to Law, held holy among every race,
Good leaders, bounteous in their gifts, deliverers even from distress.

verses.sa:
को नु वां मित्रास्तुतो वरुणो वा तनूनाम् ।
तत्सु वामेषते मतिरत्रिभ्य एषते मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
ko nu vam mitrastuto varuno va tanunam |
tatsu vameshate matiratribhya eshate matih ||
verses.en:
Which of your persons, Varuna or Mitra, merits not our praise?
Therefore our thought is turned to you, the Atris' thought is turned to you.

verses.sa:
प्र वो मित्राय गायत वरुणाय विपा गिरा ।
महिक्षत्रावृतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mitraya gayata varunaya vipa gira |
mahikshatravritam brihat ||
verses.en:
SING forth unto your Varuna and Mitra with a song inspired.
They, Mighty Lords, are lofty Law

verses.sa:
सम्राजा या घृतयोनी मित्रश्चोभा वरुणश्च ।
देवा देवेषु प्रशस्ता ॥
verses.rom:
samraja ya ghritayoni mitrashchobha varunashcha |
deva deveshu prashasta ||
verses.en:
Full springs of fatness, Sovran Kings, Mitra. and Varuna, the Twain,
Gods glorified among the Gods.

verses.sa:
ता नः शक्तं पार्थिवस्य महो रायो दिव्यस्य ।
महि वां क्षत्रं देवेषु ॥
verses.rom:
ta nah shaktam parthivasya maho rayo divyasya |
mahi vam kshatram deveshu ||
verses.en:
So help ye us to riches, great terrestrial and celestial wealth:
Vast is your sway among the Gods.

verses.sa:
ऋतमृतेन सपन्तेषिरं दक्षमाशाते ।
अद्रुहा देवौ वर्धेते ॥
verses.rom:
ritamritena sapanteshiram dakshamashate |
adruha devau vardhete ||
verses.en:
Carefully tending Law with Law they have attained their vigorous might.
The two Gods wax devoid of guile.

verses.sa:
वृष्टिद्यावा रीत्यापेषस्पती दानुमत्याः ।
बृहन्तं गर्तमाशाते ॥
verses.rom:
vrishtidyava rityapeshaspati danumatyah |
brihantam gartamashate ||
verses.en:
With rainy skies and streaming floods, Lords of the strength that bringeth gifts,
A lofty seat have they attained.

verses.sa:
त्री रोचना वरुण त्रीँरुत द्यून्त्रीणि मित्र धारयथो रजांसि ।
वावृधानावमतिं क्षत्रियस्यानु व्रतं रक्षमाणावजुर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tri rochana varuna trinruta dyuntrini mitra dharayatho rajamsi |
vavridhanavamatim kshatriyasyanu vratam rakshamanavajuryam ||
verses.en:
THREE spheres of light, O Varuna, three heavens, three firmaments ye comprehend, O Mitra:
Waxed strong, ye keep the splendour of dominion, guarding the Ordinance that lasts for ever.

verses.sa:
इरावतीर्वरुण धेनवो वां मधुमद्वां सिन्धवो मित्र दुह्रे ।
त्रयस्तस्थुर्वृषभासस्तिसॄणां धिषणानां रेतोधा वि द्युमन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
iravatirvaruna dhenavo vam madhumadvam sindhavo mitra duhre |
trayastasthurvrishabhasastisrinam dhishananam retodha vi dyumantah ||
verses.en:
Ye, Varuna, have kine who yield refreshment; Mitra, your floods pour water full of sweetness.
There stand the Three Steers, splendid in their brightness, who fill the three world-bowls with genial moisture.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्देवीमदितिं जोहवीमि मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
राये मित्रावरुणा सर्वतातेळे तोकाय तनयाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
pratardevimaditim johavimi madhyamdina udita suryasya |
raye mitravaruna sarvatatele tokaya tanayaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
I call at dawn on Aditi the Goddess, I call at noon and when the Sun is setting.
I pray, O Mitra-Varuna, for safety, for wealth and progeny, in rest and trouble.

verses.sa:
या धर्तारा रजसो रोचनस्योतादित्या दिव्या पार्थिवस्य ।
न वां देवा अमृता आ मिनन्ति व्रतानि मित्रावरुणा ध्रुवाणि ॥
verses.rom:
ya dhartara rajaso rochanasyotaditya divya parthivasya |
na vam deva amrita a minanti vratani mitravaruna dhruvani ||
verses.en:
Ye who uphold the region, sphere of brightness, ye who support earth's realm Divine Adityas,
The Immortal Gods, O Varuna and Mitra, never impair your everlasting statutes.

verses.sa:
पुरूरुणा चिद्ध्यस्त्यवो नूनं वां वरुण ।
मित्र वंसि वां सुमतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
pururuna chiddhyastyavo nunam vam varuna |
mitra vamsi vam sumatim ||
verses.en:
EVEN far and wide, O Varuna and Mitra, doth your grace extend.
May I obtain your kind good-will.

verses.sa:
ता वां सम्यगद्रुह्वाणेषमश्याम धायसे ।
वयं ते रुद्रा स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam samyagadruhvaneshamashyama dhayase |
vayam te rudra syama ||
verses.en:
From you, benignant Gods, may we gain fully food for sustenance.
Such, O ye Rudras, my we be.

verses.sa:
पातं नो रुद्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथां सुत्रात्रा ।
तुर्याम दस्यून्तनूभिः ॥
verses.rom:
patam no rudra payubhiruta trayetham sutratra |
turyama dasyuntanubhih ||
verses.en:
Guard us, O Rudras. with your guard save us, ye skilled to save, my we
Subdue the Dasyus, we ourselves,

verses.sa:
मा कस्याद्भुतक्रतू यक्षं भुजेमा तनूभिः ।
मा शेषसा मा तनसा ॥
verses.rom:
ma kasyadbhutakratu yaksham bhujema tanubhih |
ma sheshasa ma tanasa ||
verses.en:
Or ne'er may we, O Wondrous Strong, enjoy another's solemn feast,
Ourselves, our sons, or progeny.

verses.sa:
आ नो गन्तं रिशादसा वरुण मित्र बर्हणा ।
उपेमं चारुमध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no gantam rishadasa varuna mitra barhana |
upemam charumadhvaram ||
verses.en:
O Varuna and Mitra, ye who slay the foemen, come with might
To this our goodly sacrifice.

verses.sa:
विश्वस्य हि प्रचेतसा वरुण मित्र राजथः ।
ईशाना पिप्यतं धियः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvasya hi prachetasa varuna mitra rajathah |
ishana pipyatam dhiyah ||
verses.en:
For, Varuna and Mitra, ye Sages are Rulers over all.
Fill full our songs, for this ye can.

verses.sa:
उप नः सुतमा गतं वरुण मित्र दाशुषः ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
upa nah sutama gatam varuna mitra dashushah |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Come to the juice that we have pressed. Varuna, Mitra, come to drink
This Soma of the worshipper.

verses.sa:
आ मित्रे वरुणे वयं गीर्भिर्जुहुमो अत्रिवत् ।
नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a mitre varune vayam girbhirjuhumo atrivat |
ni barhishi sadatam somapitaye ||
verses.en:
To Varuna and Mitra we offer with songs, as Atri did.
Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
व्रतेन स्थो ध्रुवक्षेमा धर्मणा यातयज्जना ।
नि बर्हिषि सदतं सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vratena stho dhruvakshema dharmana yatayajjana |
ni barhishi sadatam somapitaye ||
verses.en:
By Ordinance and Law ye dwell in peace secure, bestirring men.
Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च नो वरुणश्च जुषेतां यज्ञमिष्टये ।
नि बर्हिषि सदतां सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
mitrashcha no varunashcha jushetam yajnamishtaye |
ni barhishi sadatam somapitaye ||
verses.en:
May Varuna and Mitra, for our help, accept the sacrifice.
Sit on the sacred grass to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
यदद्य स्थः परावति यदर्वावत्यश्विना ।
यद्वा पुरू पुरुभुजा यदन्तरिक्ष आ गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya sthah paravati yadarvavatyashvina |
yadva puru purubhuja yadantariksha a gatam ||
verses.en:
WHETHER, O Asvins, ye this day be far remote or near at hand,
In many spots or in mid-air, come hither, Lords of ample wealth.

verses.sa:
इह त्या पुरुभूतमा पुरू दंसांसि बिभ्रता ।
वरस्या याम्यध्रिगू हुवे तुविष्टमा भुजे ॥
verses.rom:
iha tya purubhutama puru damsamsi bibhrata |
varasya yamyadhrigu huve tuvishtama bhuje ||
verses.en:
These here, who show o'er widest space, bringing full many a wondrous act,
Resistless, lovingly I seek, I call the Mightiest to enjoy.

verses.sa:
ईर्मान्यद्वपुषे वपुश्चक्रं रथस्य येमथुः ।
पर्यन्या नाहुषा युगा मह्ना रजांसि दीयथः ॥
verses.rom:
irmanyadvapushe vapushchakram rathasya yemathuh |
paryanya nahusha yuga mahna rajamsi diyathah ||
verses.en:
Another beauteous wheel have ye fixed there to decorate your car.
With others through the realms ye roam in might unto the neighbouring tribes.

verses.sa:
तदू षु वामेना कृतं विश्वा यद्वामनु ष्टवे ।
नाना जातावरेपसा समस्मे बन्धुमेयथुः ॥
verses.rom:
tadu shu vamena kritam vishva yadvamanu shtave |
nana jatavarepasa samasme bandhumeyathuh ||
verses.en:
That deed of yours that is extolled, Visvas! hath all been done with this.
Born otherwise, and spotless, ye have entered kinship's bonds with us.

verses.sa:
आ यद्वां सूर्या रथं तिष्ठद्रघुष्यदं सदा ।
परि वामरुषा वयो घृणा वरन्त आतपः ॥
verses.rom:
a yadvam surya ratham tishthadraghushyadam sada |
pari vamarusha vayo ghrina varanta atapah ||
verses.en:
When Surya mounted on your car that rolls for ever rapidly,
Birds of red hue were round about and burning splendours compassed you.

verses.sa:
युवोरत्रिश्चिकेतति नरा सुम्नेन चेतसा ।
घर्मं यद्वामरेपसं नासत्यास्ना भुरण्यति ॥
verses.rom:
yuvoratrishchiketati nara sumnena chetasa |
gharmam yadvamarepasam nasatyasna bhuranyati ||
verses.en:
Atri bethinks himself of you, O Heroes, with a friendly mind,
What time, Nasatyas, with his mouth he stirs the spotless flame for you.

verses.sa:
उग्रो वां ककुहो ययिः शृण्वे यामेषु संतनिः ।
यद्वां दंसोभिरश्विनात्रिर्नराववर्तति ॥
verses.rom:
ugro vam kakuho yayih shrinve yameshu samtanih |
yadvam damsobhirashvinatrirnaravavartati ||
verses.en:
Strong is your swiftly moving steed, famed his exertion in the course
When by your great deeds, Asvins, Chiefs, Atri is brought to us again.

verses.sa:
मध्व ऊ षु मधूयुवा रुद्रा सिषक्ति पिप्युषी ।
यत्समुद्राति पर्षथः पक्वाः पृक्षो भरन्त वाम् ॥
verses.rom:
madhva u shu madhuyuva rudra sishakti pipyushi |
yatsamudrati parshathah pakvah priksho bharanta vam ||
verses.en:
Lovers of sweetness, Rudras, she who streams with sweetness waits on you.
When ye have travelled through the seas men bring you gifts of well-dressed food.

verses.sa:
सत्यमिद्वा उ अश्विना युवामाहुर्मयोभुवा ।
ता यामन्यामहूतमा यामन्ना मृळयत्तमा ॥
verses.rom:
satyamidva u ashvina yuvamahurmayobhuva |
ta yamanyamahutama yamanna mrilayattama ||
verses.en:
Asvins, with truth they call you Twain bestowers of felicity;
At sacrifice most prompt to hear, most gracious ye at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इमा ब्रह्माणि वर्धनाश्विभ्यां सन्तु शंतमा ।
या तक्षाम रथाँ इवावोचाम बृहन्नमः ॥
verses.rom:
ima brahmani vardhanashvibhyam santu shamtama |
ya takshama rathan ivavochama brihannamah ||
verses.en:
Most pleasing to the Asvins be these prayers which magnify their might,
Which we have fashioned, even as cars high reverence have we spoken forth.

verses.sa:
कूष्ठो देवावश्विनाद्या दिवो मनावसू ।
तच्छ्रवथो वृषण्वसू अत्रिर्वामा विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
kushtho devavashvinadya divo manavasu |
tachchhravatho vrishanvasu atrirvama vivasati ||
verses.en:
WHERE in the heavens are ye to-day, Gods, Asvins, rich in constancy?
Hear this, ye excellent as Steers: Atri inviteth you to come.

verses.sa:
कुह त्या कुह नु श्रुता दिवि देवा नासत्या ।
कस्मिन्ना यतथो जने को वां नदीनां सचा ॥
verses.rom:
kuha tya kuha nu shruta divi deva nasatya |
kasminna yatatho jane ko vam nadinam sacha ||
verses.en:
Where are they now? Where are the Twain, the famed Nasatyas, Gods in heaven?
Who is the man ye strive to reach? Who of your suppliants is with you?

verses.sa:
कं याथः कं ह गच्छथः कमच्छा युञ्जाथे रथम् ।
कस्य ब्रह्माणि रण्यथो वयं वामुश्मसीष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
kam yathah kam ha gachchhathah kamachchha yunjathe ratham |
kasya brahmani ranyatho vayam vamushmasishtaye ||
verses.en:
Whom do ye visit, whom approach? to whom direct your harnessed car?
With whose devotions are ye pleased? We long for you to further us.

verses.sa:
पौरं चिद्ध्युदप्रुतं पौर पौराय जिन्वथः ।
यदीं गृभीततातये सिंहमिव द्रुहस्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
pauram chiddhyudaprutam paura pauraya jinvathah |
yadim gribhitatataye simhamiva druhaspade ||
verses.en:
Ye, Strengtheners, for Paura stir the filler swimming in the flood,
Advancing to be captured like a lion to the ambuscade.

verses.sa:
प्र च्यवानाज्जुजुरुषो वव्रिमत्कं न मुञ्चथः ।
युवा यदी कृथः पुनरा काममृण्वे वध्वः ॥
verses.rom:
pra chyavanajjujurusho vavrimatkam na munchathah |
yuva yadi krithah punara kamamrinve vadhvah ||
verses.en:
Ye from Cyavana worn with age removed his skin as 'twere a robe.
So, when ye made him young again, he stirred the longing of a dame.

verses.sa:
अस्ति हि वामिह स्तोता स्मसि वां संदृशि श्रिये ।
नू श्रुतं म आ गतमवोभिर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
verses.rom:
asti hi vamiha stota smasi vam samdrishi shriye |
nu shrutam ma a gatamavobhirvajinivasu ||
verses.en:
Here is the man who lauds you both: to see your glory are we here.
Now bear me, come with saving help, ye who are rich in store of wealth.

verses.sa:
को वामद्य पुरूणामा वव्ने मर्त्यानाम् ।
को विप्रो विप्रवाहसा को यज्ञैर्वाजिनीवसू ॥
verses.rom:
ko vamadya purunama vavne martyanam |
ko vipro vipravahasa ko yajnairvajinivasu ||
verses.en:
Who among many mortal men this day hath won you to himself?
What bard, accepters of the bard? Who, rich in wealth! with sacrifice?

verses.sa:
आ वां रथो रथानां येष्ठो यात्वश्विना ।
पुरू चिदस्मयुस्तिर आङ्गूषो मर्त्येष्वा ॥
verses.rom:
a vam ratho rathanam yeshtho yatvashvina |
puru chidasmayustira angusho martyeshva ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, may your car approach, most excellent of cars for speed.
Through many regions may our praise pass onward among mortal men.

verses.sa:
शमू षु वां मधूयुवास्माकमस्तु चर्कृतिः ।
अर्वाचीना विचेतसा विभिः श्येनेव दीयतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shamu shu vam madhuyuvasmakamastu charkritih |
arvachina vichetasa vibhih shyeneva diyatam ||
verses.en:
May our laudation of you Twain, lovers of meath! be sweet to you.
Fly hitherward, ye wise of heart, like falcons with your winged steeds.

verses.sa:
अश्विना यद्ध कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् ।
वस्वीरू षु वां भुजः पृञ्चन्ति सु वां पृचः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina yaddha karhi chichchhushruyatamimam havam |
vasviru shu vam bhujah princhanti su vam prichah ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, when at any time ye listen to this call of mine,
For you is dainty food prepared: they mix refreshing food for you.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्रियतमं रथं वृषणं वसुवाहनम् ।
स्तोता वामश्विनावृषि स्तोमेन प्रति भूषति माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
prati priyatamam ratham vrishanam vasuvahanam |
stota vamashvinavrishi stomena prati bhushati madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us,
Asvins, the Rsi is prepared, your raiser, with his song of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अत्यायातमश्विना तिरो विश्वा अहं सना ।
दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी सुषुम्ना सिन्धुवाहसा माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
atyayatamashvina tiro vishva aham sana |
dasra hiranyavartani sushumna sindhuvahasa madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Pass, O ye Asvins, pass away beyond all tribes of selfish men,
Wonderful, with your golden paths, most gracious, bringers of the flood. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
आ नो रत्नानि बिभ्रतावश्विना गच्छतं युवम् ।
रुद्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी जुषाणा वाजिनीवसू माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no ratnani bibhratavashvina gachchhatam yuvam |
rudra hiranyavartani jushana vajinivasu madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Come to us, O ye Asvin Pair, bringing your precious treasures, come
Ye Rudras, on your paths of gold, rejoicing, rich in store of wealth. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
सुष्टुभो वां वृषण्वसू रथे वाणीच्याहिता ।
उत वां ककुहो मृगः पृक्षः कृणोति वापुषो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
sushtubho vam vrishanvasu rathe vanichyahita |
uta vam kakuho mrigah prikshah krinoti vapusho madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
O strong and Good, the voice of him who lauds you well cleaves to your car.
And that great beast, your chariot-steed, fair, wonderful, makes dainty food. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
बोधिन्मनसा रथ्येषिरा हवनश्रुता ।
विभिश्च्यवानमश्विना नि याथो अद्वयाविनं माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
bodhinmanasa rathyeshira havanashruta |
vibhishchyavanamashvina ni yatho advayavinam madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Watchful in spirit, born on cars, impetuous, listing to his cry,
Asvins, with winged steeds ye speed down to Cyavana void of guile. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
आ वां नरा मनोयुजोऽश्वासः प्रुषितप्सवः ।
वयो वहन्तु पीतये सह सुम्नेभिरश्विना माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vam nara manoyujo'shvasah prushitapsavah |
vayo vahantu pitaye saha sumnebhirashvina madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Heroes, let your steeds, of dappled hue, yoked at the thought,
Your flying steeds, O Asvins, bring you hitherward, with bliss, to drink. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् ।
तिरश्चिदर्यया परि वर्तिर्यातमदाभ्या माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvinaveha gachchhatam nasatya ma vi venatam |
tirashchidaryaya pari vartiryatamadabhya madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, hither come to us; Nasatyas, be not disinclined.
Through longing for the pious turn out of the way to reach our home. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call.

verses.sa:
अस्मिन्यज्ञे अदाभ्या जरितारं शुभस्पती ।
अवस्युमश्विना युवं गृणन्तमुप भूषथो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
asminyajne adabhya jaritaram shubhaspati |
avasyumashvina yuvam grinantamupa bhushatho madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Ye Lords of Splendour, free from guile, come, stand at this our sacrifice.
Beside the singer, Asvins, who longs for your grace and lauds you both. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call.

verses.sa:
अभूदुषा रुशत्पशुराग्निरधाय्यृत्वियः ।
अयोजि वां वृषण्वसू रथो दस्रावमर्त्यो माध्वी मम श्रुतं हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhudusha rushatpashuragniradhayyritviyah |
ayoji vam vrishanvasu ratho dasravamartyo madhvi mama shrutam havam ||
verses.en:
Dawn with her white herd hath appeared, and in due time hath fire been placed.
Harnessed is your immortal car, O Wonder Workers, strong and kind. Lovers of sweetness, bear my call.

verses.sa:
आ भात्यग्निरुषसामनीकमुद्विप्राणां देवया वाचो अस्थुः ।
अर्वाञ्चा नूनं रथ्येह यातं पीपिवांसमश्विना घर्ममच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
a bhatyagnirushasamanikamudvipranam devaya vacho asthuh |
arvancha nunam rathyeha yatam pipivamsamashvina gharmamachchha ||
verses.en:
AGNI, the bright face of the Dawns, is shining; the singers' pious voices have ascended.
Borne on your chariot, Asvins, turn you hither and come unto our full and rich libation.

verses.sa:
न संस्कृतं प्र मिमीतो गमिष्ठान्ति नूनमश्विनोपस्तुतेह ।
दिवाभिपित्वेऽवसागमिष्ठा प्रत्यवर्तिं दाशुषे शम्भविष्ठा ॥
verses.rom:
na samskritam pra mimito gamishthanti nunamashvinopastuteha |
divabhipitve'vasagamishtha pratyavartim dashushe shambhavishtha ||
verses.en:
Most frequent guests, they scorn not what is ready: even now the lauded Asvins are beside us.
With promptest aid they come at morn and evening, the worshipper's most blessed guards from trouble.

verses.sa:
उता यातं संगवे प्रातरह्नो मध्यंदिन उदिता सूर्यस्य ।
दिवा नक्तमवसा शंतमेन नेदानीं पीतिरश्विना ततान ॥
verses.rom:
uta yatam samgave pratarahno madhyamdina udita suryasya |
diva naktamavasa shamtamena nedanim pitirashvina tatana ||
verses.en:
Yea, come at milking-time, at early morning, at noon of day and when the Sun is setting,
By day, by night, with favour most auspicious. Not only now the draught hath drawn the Asvins.

verses.sa:
इदं हि वां प्रदिवि स्थानमोक इमे गृहा अश्विनेदं दुरोणम् ।
आ नो दिवो बृहतः पर्वतादाद्भ्यो यातमिषमूर्जं वहन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
idam hi vam pradivi sthanamoka ime griha ashvinedam duronam |
a no divo brihatah parvatadadbhyo yatamishamurjam vahanta ||
verses.en:
For this place, Asvins, was of old your dwelling, these were your houses, this your habitation.
Come to us from high heaven and from the mountain. Come from the waters bringing food and vigour.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
verses.rom:
samashvinoravasa nutanena mayobhuva supraniti gamema |
a no rayim vahatamota virana vishvanyamrita saubhagani ||
verses.en:
May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance.
Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यावाणा प्रथमा यजध्वं पुरा गृध्रादररुषः पिबातः ।
प्रातर्हि यज्ञमश्विना दधाते प्र शंसन्ति कवयः पूर्वभाजः ॥
verses.rom:
prataryavana prathama yajadhvam pura gridhradararushah pibatah |
pratarhi yajnamashvina dadhate pra shamsanti kavayah purvabhajah ||
verses.en:
FIRST worship those who come at early morning: let the Twain drink before the giftless niggard.
The Asvins claim the sacrifice at daybreak: the sages yielding the first share extol them.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यजध्वमश्विना हिनोत न सायमस्ति देवया अजुष्टम् ।
उतान्यो अस्मद्यजते वि चावः पूर्वःपूर्वो यजमानो वनीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
prataryajadhvamashvina hinota na sayamasti devaya ajushtam |
utanyo asmadyajate vi chavah purvahpurvo yajamano vaniyan ||
verses.en:
Worship at dawn and instigate the Asvins: nor is the worshipper at eve rejected.
Besides ourselves another craves and worships: each first in worship is most highly favoured.

verses.sa:
हिरण्यत्वङ्मधुवर्णो घृतस्नुः पृक्षो वहन्ना रथो वर्तते वाम् ।
मनोजवा अश्विना वातरंहा येनातियाथो दुरितानि विश्वा ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyatvanmadhuvarno ghritasnuh priksho vahanna ratho vartate vam |
manojava ashvina vataramha yenatiyatho duritani vishva ||
verses.en:
Covered with gold, meath-tinted, dropping fatness, your chariot with its freight of food comes hither,
Swift as thought, Asvins, rapid as the tempest, wherewith ye travel over all obstructions.

verses.sa:
यो भूयिष्ठं नासत्याभ्यां विवेष चनिष्ठं पित्वो ररते विभागे ।
स तोकमस्य पीपरच्छमीभिरनूर्ध्वभासः सदमित्तुतुर्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yo bhuyishtham nasatyabhyam vivesha chanishtham pitvo rarate vibhage |
sa tokamasya piparachchhamibhiranurdhvabhasah sadamittuturyat ||
verses.en:
He who hath served most often the Nasatyas, and gives the sweetest food at distribution,
Furthers with his own holy works his offspring, and ever passes those whose flames ascend not.

verses.sa:
समश्विनोरवसा नूतनेन मयोभुवा सुप्रणीती गमेम ।
आ नो रयिं वहतमोत वीराना विश्वान्यमृता सौभगानि ॥
verses.rom:
samashvinoravasa nutanena mayobhuva supraniti gamema |
a no rayim vahatamota virana vishvanyamrita saubhagani ||
verses.en:
May we obtain the Asvins' newest favour, and gain their health-bestowing happy guidance.
Bring riches hither unto us, and heroes, and all felicity and joy, Immortals!

verses.sa:
अश्विनावेह गच्छतं नासत्या मा वि वेनतम् ।
हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
verses.rom:
ashvinaveha gachchhatam nasatya ma vi venatam |
hamsaviva patatama sutan upa ||
verses.en:
YE Asvins, hither come to us: Nasatyas, be not disinclined.
Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa:
अश्विना हरिणाविव गौराविवानु यवसम् ।
हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina harinaviva gauravivanu yavasam |
hamsaviva patatama sutan upa ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, like a pair of deer, like two wild cattle to the mead:
Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa:
अश्विना वाजिनीवसू जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये ।
हंसाविव पततमा सुताँ उप ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina vajinivasu jushetham yajnamishtaye |
hamsaviva patatama sutan upa ||
verses.en:
O Asvins rich in gifts, accept our sacrifice to prosper it:
Fly hither like two swans unto the juice we shed.

verses.sa:
अत्रिर्यद्वामवरोहन्नृबीसमजोहवीन्नाधमानेव योषा ।
श्येनस्य चिज्जवसा नूतनेनागच्छतमश्विना शंतमेन ॥
verses.rom:
atriryadvamavarohannribisamajohavinnadhamaneva yosha |
shyenasya chijjavasa nutanenagachchhatamashvina shamtamena ||
verses.en:
As Atri when descending to the cave called on you loudly like a wailing woman.
Ye came to him, O Asvins, with the freshest and most auspicious fleetness of a falcon.

verses.sa:
वि जिहीष्व वनस्पते योनिः सूष्यन्त्या इव ।
श्रुतं मे अश्विना हवं सप्तवध्रिं च मुञ्चतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi jihishva vanaspate yonih sushyantya iva |
shrutam me ashvina havam saptavadhrim cha munchatam ||
verses.en:
Tree, part asunder like the side of her who bringeth forth a child.
Ye Asvins, listen to my call: loose Saptavadhri from his bonds.

verses.sa:
भीताय नाधमानाय ऋषये सप्तवध्रये ।
मायाभिरश्विना युवं वृक्षं सं च वि चाचथः ॥
verses.rom:
bhitaya nadhamanaya rishaye saptavadhraye |
mayabhirashvina yuvam vriksham sam cha vi chachathah ||
verses.en:
For Saptavadhri, for the seer affrighted when he wept and waffled,
Ye, Asvins, with your magic powers rent up the tree and shattered it.

verses.sa:
यथा वातः पुष्करिणीं समिङ्गयति सर्वतः ।
एवा ते गर्भ एजतु निरैतु दशमास्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vatah pushkarinim samingayati sarvatah |
eva te garbha ejatu niraitu dashamasyah ||
verses.en:
Like as the wind on every side ruffles a pool of lotuses,
So stir in thee the babe unborn, so may the ten-month babe descend.

verses.sa:
यथा वातो यथा वनं यथा समुद्र एजति ।
एवा त्वं दशमास्य सहावेहि जरायुणा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vato yatha vanam yatha samudra ejati |
eva tvam dashamasya sahavehi jarayuna ||
verses.en:
Like as the wind, like as the wood, like as the sea is set astir,
So also, ten-month babe, descend together with the after-birth.

verses.sa:
दश मासाञ्छशयानः कुमारो अधि मातरि ।
निरैतु जीवो अक्षतो जीवो जीवन्त्या अधि ॥
verses.rom:
dasha masanchhashayanah kumaro adhi matari |
niraitu jivo akshato jivo jivantya adhi ||
verses.en:
The child who hath for ten months' time been lying in his mother's side,-
May he come forth alive, unharmed, yea, living from the living dame.

verses.sa:
महे नो अद्य बोधयोषो राये दिवित्मती ।
यथा चिन्नो अबोधयः सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
mahe no adya bodhayosho raye divitmati |
yatha chinno abodhayah satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
O HEAVENLY Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence to-day
Even as thou hast wakened us with Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
या सुनीथे शौचद्रथे व्यौच्छो दुहितर्दिवः ।
सा व्युच्छ सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
ya sunithe shauchadrathe vyauchchho duhitardivah |
sa vyuchchha sahiyasi satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Daughter of Heaven, thou dawnedst on Sunitha Sucadratha's son,
So dawn thou on one mightier still, on Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
सा नो अद्याभरद्वसुर्व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवः ।
यो व्यौच्छः सहीयसि सत्यश्रवसि वाय्ये सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
sa no adyabharadvasurvyuchchha duhitardivah |
yo vyauchchhah sahiyasi satyashravasi vayye sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
So, bringing treasure, dawn to-day on us thou Daughter of the Sky,
As thou, O mightier yet. didst shine for Satyatravas, Vayya's son, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
अभि ये त्वा विभावरि स्तोमैर्गृणन्ति वह्नयः ।
मघैर्मघोनि सुश्रियो दामन्वन्तः सुरातयः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
abhi ye tva vibhavari stomairgrinanti vahnayah |
maghairmaghoni sushriyo damanvantah suratayah sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Here round about thee are the priests who laud thee, Bright One, with their hymns,
And men with gifts, O Bounteous Dame, splendid with wealth and offering much, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते गणा इमे छदयन्ति मघत्तये ।
परि चिद्वष्टयो दधुर्ददतो राधो अह्रयं सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi te gana ime chhadayanti maghattaye |
pari chidvashtayo dadhurdadato radho ahrayam sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Whatever these thy bands perform to please thee or to win them wealth,
E'en fain they gird us round and give rich gifts which ne'er are left away, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
ऐषु धा वीरवद्यश उषो मघोनि सूरिषु ।
ये नो राधांस्यह्रया मघवानो अरासत सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
aishu dha viravadyasha usho maghoni surishu |
ye no radhamsyahraya maghavano arasata sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Give to these wealthy patrons fame, O affluent Dawn, with hero sons,
To these our princes who have brought rich gifts ne'er to be left away, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
तेभ्यो द्युम्नं बृहद्यश उषो मघोन्या वह ।
ये नो राधांस्यश्व्या गव्या भजन्त सूरयः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
tebhyo dyumnam brihadyasha usho maghonya vaha |
ye no radhamsyashvya gavya bhajanta surayah sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Bring lofty and resplendent fame, O thou munificent Dawn, to these
Our wealthy patrons who bestow rich gifts on us of steeds and kine, high-born! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतीरिष आ वहा दुहितर्दिवः ।
साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः शुक्रैः शोचद्भिरर्चिभिः सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
uta no gomatirisha a vaha duhitardivah |
sakam suryasya rashmibhih shukraih shochadbhirarchibhih sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
Bring us, O Daughter of the Sky, subsistence in our herds of kine,
Together with the sunbeams, with the shine of pure refulgent flames, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
व्युच्छा दुहितर्दिवो मा चिरं तनुथा अपः ।
नेत्त्वा स्तेनं यथा रिपुं तपाति सूरो अर्चिषा सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
vyuchchha duhitardivo ma chiram tanutha apah |
nettva stenam yatha ripum tapati suro archisha sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
O Daughter of the Sky, shine forth; delay not to perform thy task.
Let not the Sun with fervent heat consume thee like a robber foe, high-born! delightful with the steeds!

verses.sa:
एतावद्वेदुषस्त्वं भूयो वा दातुमर्हसि ।
या स्तोतृभ्यो विभावर्युच्छन्ती न प्रमीयसे सुजाते अश्वसूनृते ॥
verses.rom:
etavadvedushastvam bhuyo va datumarhasi |
ya stotribhyo vibhavaryuchchhanti na pramiyase sujate ashvasunrite ||
verses.en:
So much, and more exceedingly, O Dawn, it suits thee to bestow,
Thou Radiant One who ceasest not to shine for those who sing thy praise, highborn! delightful with thy steeds!

verses.sa:
द्युतद्यामानं बृहतीमृतेन ऋतावरीमरुणप्सुं विभातीम् ।
देवीमुषसं स्वरावहन्तीं प्रति विप्रासो मतिभिर्जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
dyutadyamanam brihatimritena ritavarimarunapsum vibhatim |
devimushasam svaravahantim prati vipraso matibhirjarante ||
verses.en:
THE singers welcome with their hymns and praises the Goddess Dawn who bringeth in the sunlight,
Sublime, by Law true to eternal Order, bright on her path, red-tinted, far-refulgent.

verses.sa:
एषा जनं दर्शता बोधयन्ती सुगान्पथः कृण्वती यात्यग्रे ।
बृहद्रथा बृहती विश्वमिन्वोषा ज्योतिर्यच्छत्यग्रे अह्नाम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha janam darshata bodhayanti suganpathah krinvati yatyagre |
brihadratha brihati vishvaminvosha jyotiryachchhatyagre ahnam ||
verses.en:
She comes in front, fair, rousing up the people, making the pathways easy to be travelled.
High, on her lofty chariot, all-impelling, Dawn gives her splendour at the days' beginning.

verses.sa:
एषा गोभिररुणेभिर्युजानास्रेधन्ती रयिमप्रायु चक्रे ।
पथो रदन्ती सुविताय देवी पुरुष्टुता विश्ववारा वि भाति ॥
verses.rom:
esha gobhirarunebhiryujanasredhanti rayimaprayu chakre |
patho radanti suvitaya devi purushtuta vishvavara vi bhati ||
verses.en:
She, harnessing her car with purple oxen. injuring none, hath brought perpetual riches.
Opening paths to happiness, the Goddess shines, praised by all, giver of every blessing.

verses.sa:
एषा व्येनी भवति द्विबर्हा आविष्कृण्वाना तन्वं पुरस्तात् ।
ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेति साधु प्रजानतीव न दिशो मिनाति ॥
verses.rom:
esha vyeni bhavati dvibarha avishkrinvana tanvam purastat |
ritasya panthamanveti sadhu prajanativa na disho minati ||
verses.en:
With changing tints she gleams in double splendour while from the eastward she displays her body.
She travels perfectly the path of Order, nor fails to reach, as one who knows, the quarters.

verses.sa:
एषा शुभ्रा न तन्वो विदानोर्ध्वेव स्नाती दृशये नो अस्थात् ।
अप द्वेषो बाधमाना तमांस्युषा दिवो दुहिता ज्योतिषागात् ॥
verses.rom:
esha shubhra na tanvo vidanordhveva snati drishaye no asthat |
apa dvesho badhamana tamamsyusha divo duhita jyotishagat ||
verses.en:
As conscious that her limbs are bright with bathing, she stands, as 'twere, erect that we may see her.
Driving away malignity and darkness, Dawn, Child of Heaven, hath come to us with lustre.

verses.sa:
एषा प्रतीची दुहिता दिवो नॄन्योषेव भद्रा नि रिणीते अप्सः ।
व्यूर्ण्वती दाशुषे वार्याणि पुनर्ज्योतिर्युवतिः पूर्वथाकः ॥
verses.rom:
esha pratichi duhita divo nrinyosheva bhadra ni rinite apsah |
vyurnvati dashushe varyani punarjyotiryuvatih purvathakah ||
verses.en:
The Daughter of the Sky, like some chaste woman, bends, opposite to men, her forehead downward.
The Maid, disclosing boons to him who worships, hath brought again the daylight as aforetime.

verses.sa:
युञ्जते मन उत युञ्जते धियो विप्रा विप्रस्य बृहतो विपश्चितः ।
वि होत्रा दधे वयुनाविदेक इन्मही देवस्य सवितुः परिष्टुतिः ॥
verses.rom:
yunjate mana uta yunjate dhiyo vipra viprasya brihato vipashchitah |
vi hotra dadhe vayunavideka inmahi devasya savituh parishtutih ||
verses.en:
THE priests of him the lofty Priest well-skilled in hymns harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts.
He only knowing works assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.

verses.sa:
विश्वा रूपाणि प्रति मुञ्चते कविः प्रासावीद्भद्रं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे ।
वि नाकमख्यत्सविता वरेण्योऽनु प्रयाणमुषसो वि राजति ॥
verses.rom:
vishva rupani prati munchate kavih prasavidbhadram dvipade chatushpade |
vi nakamakhyatsavita varenyo'nu prayanamushaso vi rajati ||
verses.en:
The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good.
Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault, and shineth after the outgoing of the Dawn.

verses.sa:
यस्य प्रयाणमन्वन्य इद्ययुर्देवा देवस्य महिमानमोजसा ।
यः पार्थिवानि विममे स एतशो रजांसि देवः सविता महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
yasya prayanamanvanya idyayurdeva devasya mahimanamojasa |
yah parthivani vimame sa etasho rajamsi devah savita mahitvana ||
verses.en:
Even he, the God whose going-forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might,
He who hath measured the terrestrial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.

verses.sa:
उत यासि सवितस्त्रीणि रोचनोत सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः समुच्यसि ।
उत रात्रीमुभयतः परीयस उत मित्रो भवसि देव धर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta yasi savitastrini rochanota suryasya rashmibhih samuchyasi |
uta ratrimubhayatah pariyasa uta mitro bhavasi deva dharmabhih ||
verses.en:
To the three spheres of light thou goest, Savitar, and with the rays of Sidrya thou combinest thee.
Around, on both sides thou encompassest the night: yea, thou, O God, art Mitra through thy righteous laws.

verses.sa:
उतेशिषे प्रसवस्य त्वमेक इदुत पूषा भवसि देव यामभिः ।
उतेदं विश्वं भुवनं वि राजसि श्यावाश्वस्ते सवित स्तोममानशे ॥
verses.rom:
uteshishe prasavasya tvameka iduta pusha bhavasi deva yamabhih |
utedam vishvam bhuvanam vi rajasi shyavashvaste savita stomamanashe ||
verses.en:
Over all generation thou art Lord alone: Pusan art thou, O God, in all thy goings-forth.
Yea, thou hast domination over all this world. Syavasva hath brought praise to thee, O Savitar,

verses.sa:
तत्सवितुर्वृणीमहे वयं देवस्य भोजनम् ।
श्रेष्ठं सर्वधातमं तुरं भगस्य धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
tatsaviturvrinimahe vayam devasya bhojanam |
shreshtham sarvadhatamam turam bhagasya dhimahi ||
verses.en:
WE crave of Savitar the God this treasure much to be enjoyed.
The best, all-yielding, conquering gift of Bhaga we would gladly win.

verses.sa:
अस्य हि स्वयशस्तरं सवितुः कच्चन प्रियम् ।
न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
asya hi svayashastaram savituh kachchana priyam |
na minanti svarajyam ||
verses.en:
Savitar's own supremacy, most glorious and beloved of all,
No one diminisheth in aught.

verses.sa:
स हि रत्नानि दाशुषे सुवाति सविता भगः ।
तं भागं चित्रमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
sa hi ratnani dashushe suvati savita bhagah |
tam bhagam chitramimahe ||
verses.en:
For Savitar who is Bhaga shall send riches to his worshipper.
That wondrous portion we implore.

verses.sa:
अद्या नो देव सवितः प्रजावत्सावीः सौभगम् ।
परा दुष्वप्न्यं सुव ॥
verses.rom:
adya no deva savitah prajavatsavih saubhagam |
para dushvapnyam suva ||
verses.en:
Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny.
Drive thou the evil dream away.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि देव सवितर्दुरितानि परा सुव ।
यद्भद्रं तन्न आ सुव ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani deva savitarduritani para suva |
yadbhadram tanna a suva ||
verses.en:
Savitar, God, send far away all sorrows and calamities,
And send us only what is good.

verses.sa:
अनागसो अदितये देवस्य सवितुः सवे ।
विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
anagaso aditaye devasya savituh save |
vishva vamani dhimahi ||
verses.en:
Sinless in sight of Aditi through the God Savitar's influence,
May we obtain all lovely things.

verses.sa:
आ विश्वदेवं सत्पतिं सूक्तैरद्या वृणीमहे ।
सत्यसवं सवितारम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vishvadevam satpatim suktairadya vrinimahe |
satyasavam savitaram ||
verses.en:
We with our hymns this day elect the general God, Lord of the good,
Savitar whose decrees are true.

verses.sa:
य इमे उभे अहनी पुर एत्यप्रयुच्छन् ।
स्वाधीर्देवः सविता ॥
verses.rom:
ya ime ubhe ahani pura etyaprayuchchhan |
svadhirdevah savita ||
verses.en:
He who for ever vigilant precedes these Twain, the Day and Night,
Is Savitar the thoughtful God.

verses.sa:
य इमा विश्वा जातान्याश्रावयति श्लोकेन ।
प्र च सुवाति सविता ॥
verses.rom:
ya ima vishva jatanyashravayati shlokena |
pra cha suvati savita ||
verses.en:
He who gives glory unto all these living creatures with the song,
And brings them forth, is Savitar.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वद तवसं गीर्भिराभि स्तुहि पर्जन्यं नमसा विवास ।
कनिक्रदद्वृषभो जीरदानू रेतो दधात्योषधीषु गर्भम् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha vada tavasam girbhirabhi stuhi parjanyam namasa vivasa |
kanikradadvrishabho jiradanu reto dadhatyoshadhishu garbham ||
verses.en:
SING with these songs thy welcome to the Mighty, with adoration praise and call Parjanya.
The Bull, loud roaring, swift to send his bounty, lays in the plants the seed. for germination.

verses.sa:
वि वृक्षान्हन्त्युत हन्ति रक्षसो विश्वं बिभाय भुवनं महावधात् ।
उतानागा ईषते वृष्ण्यावतो यत्पर्जन्य स्तनयन्हन्ति दुष्कृतः ॥
verses.rom:
vi vrikshanhantyuta hanti rakshaso vishvam bibhaya bhuvanam mahavadhat |
utanaga ishate vrishnyavato yatparjanya stanayanhanti dushkritah ||
verses.en:
He smites the trees apart, he slays the demons: all life fears him who wields the mighty weapon.
From him exceeding strong faces e'en the guiltless, when thundering Parjanya smites the wicked.

verses.sa:
रथीव कशयाश्वाँ अभिक्षिपन्नाविर्दूतान्कृणुते वर्ष्याँ अह ।
दूरात्सिंहस्य स्तनथा उदीरते यत्पर्जन्यः कृणुते वर्ष्यं नभः ॥
verses.rom:
rathiva kashayashvan abhikshipannavirdutankrinute varshyan aha |
duratsimhasya stanatha udirate yatparjanyah krinute varshyam nabhah ||
verses.en:
Like a car-driver whipping on his horses, he makes the messengers of rain spring forward.
Far off resounds the roaring of the lion, what time Parjanya fills the sky with rain-cloud.

verses.sa:
प्र वाता वान्ति पतयन्ति विद्युत उदोषधीर्जिहते पिन्वते स्वः ।
इरा विश्वस्मै भुवनाय जायते यत्पर्जन्यः पृथिवीं रेतसावति ॥
verses.rom:
pra vata vanti patayanti vidyuta udoshadhirjihate pinvate svah |
ira vishvasmai bhuvanaya jayate yatparjanyah prithivim retasavati ||
verses.en:
Forth burst the winds, down come the lightning-flashes: the plants shoot up, the realm of light is streaming.
Food springs abundant for all living creatures, what time Parjanya quickens earth with moisture.

verses.sa:
यस्य व्रते पृथिवी नन्नमीति यस्य व्रते शफवज्जर्भुरीति ।
यस्य व्रत ओषधीर्विश्वरूपाः स नः पर्जन्य महि शर्म यच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
yasya vrate prithivi nannamiti yasya vrate shaphavajjarbhuriti |
yasya vrata oshadhirvishvarupah sa nah parjanya mahi sharma yachchha ||
verses.en:
Thou at whose bidding earth bows low before thee, at whose command hoofed cattle fly in terror,
At whose behest the plants assume all colours, even thou Parjanya, yield us great protection.

verses.sa:
दिवो नो वृष्टिं मरुतो ररीध्वं प्र पिन्वत वृष्णो अश्वस्य धाराः ।
अर्वाङेतेन स्तनयित्नुनेह्यपो निषिञ्चन्नसुरः पिता नः ॥
verses.rom:
divo no vrishtim maruto raridhvam pra pinvata vrishno ashvasya dharah |
arvanetena stanayitnunehyapo nishinchannasurah pita nah ||
verses.en:
Send down for us the rain of heaven, ye Maruts, and let the Stallion's flood descend in torrents.
Come hither with this thunder while thou pourest the waters down, our heavenly Lord and Father.

verses.sa:
अभि क्रन्द स्तनय गर्भमा धा उदन्वता परि दीया रथेन ।
दृतिं सु कर्ष विषितं न्यञ्चं समा भवन्तूद्वतो निपादाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi kranda stanaya garbhama dha udanvata pari diya rathena |
dritim su karsha vishitam nyancham sama bhavantudvato nipadah ||
verses.en:
Thunder and roar: the germ of life deposit. Fly round us on thy chariot waterladen.
Thine opened water-skin draw with thee downward, and let the hollows and the heights be level.

verses.sa:
महान्तं कोशमुदचा नि षिञ्च स्यन्दन्तां कुल्या विषिताः पुरस्तात् ।
घृतेन द्यावापृथिवी व्युन्धि सुप्रपाणं भवत्वघ्न्याभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam koshamudacha ni shincha syandantam kulya vishitah purastat |
ghritena dyavaprithivi vyundhi suprapanam bhavatvaghnyabhyah ||
verses.en:
Lift up the mighty vessel, pour down water, and let the liberated streams rush forward.
Saturate both the earth and heaven with fatness, and for the cows let there be drink abundant.

verses.sa:
यत्पर्जन्य कनिक्रदत्स्तनयन्हंसि दुष्कृतः ।
प्रतीदं विश्वं मोदते यत्किं च पृथिव्यामधि ॥
verses.rom:
yatparjanya kanikradatstanayanhamsi dushkritah |
pratidam vishvam modate yatkim cha prithivyamadhi ||
verses.en:
When thou, with thunder and with roar, Parjanya, smitest sinners down,
This universe exults thereat, yea, all that is upon the earth.

verses.sa:
अवर्षीर्वर्षमुदु षू गृभायाकर्धन्वान्यत्येतवा उ ।
अजीजन ओषधीर्भोजनाय कमुत प्रजाभ्योऽविदो मनीषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
avarshirvarshamudu shu gribhayakardhanvanyatyetava u |
ajijana oshadhirbhojanaya kamuta prajabhyo'vido manisham ||
verses.en:
Thou hast poured down the rain-flood now withhold it. Thou hast made desert places fit for travel.
Thou hast made herbs to grow for our enjoyment: yea, thou hast won thee praise from living creatures.

verses.sa:
बळित्था पर्वतानां खिद्रं बिभर्षि पृथिवि ।
प्र या भूमिं प्रवत्वति मह्ना जिनोषि महिनि ॥
verses.rom:
balittha parvatanam khidram bibharshi prithivi |
pra ya bhumim pravatvati mahna jinoshi mahini ||
verses.en:
THOU, of a truth, O Prthivi, bearest the tool that rends the hills:
Thou rich in torrents, who with might quickenest earth, O Mighty One.

verses.sa:
स्तोमासस्त्वा विचारिणि प्रति ष्टोभन्त्यक्तुभिः ।
प्र या वाजं न हेषन्तं पेरुमस्यस्यर्जुनि ॥
verses.rom:
stomasastva vicharini prati shtobhantyaktubhih |
pra ya vajam na heshantam perumasyasyarjuni ||
verses.en:
To thee, O wanderer at will, ring out the lauds with beams of day,
Who drivest, like a neighing steed, the swelling cloud, O bright of hue.

verses.sa:
दृळ्हा चिद्या वनस्पतीन्क्ष्मया दर्धर्ष्योजसा ।
यत्ते अभ्रस्य विद्युतो दिवो वर्षन्ति वृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
drilha chidya vanaspatinkshmaya dardharshyojasa |
yatte abhrasya vidyuto divo varshanti vrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Who graspest with thy might on earth. e'en the strong sovrans of the wood,
When from the lightning of thy cloud the rain-floods of the heaven descend.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजे बृहदर्चा गभीरं ब्रह्म प्रियं वरुणाय श्रुताय ।
वि यो जघान शमितेव चर्मोपस्तिरे पृथिवीं सूर्याय ॥
verses.rom:
pra samraje brihadarcha gabhiram brahma priyam varunaya shrutaya |
vi yo jaghana shamiteva charmopastire prithivim suryaya ||
verses.en:
SING forth a hymn sublime and solemn, grateful to glorious. Varuna, imperial Ruler,
Who hath struck out, like one who slays the victim, earth as a skin to spread in front of Surya.

verses.sa:
वनेषु व्यन्तरिक्षं ततान वाजमर्वत्सु पय उस्रियासु ।
हृत्सु क्रतुं वरुणो अप्स्वग्निं दिवि सूर्यमदधात्सोममद्रौ ॥
verses.rom:
vaneshu vyantariksham tatana vajamarvatsu paya usriyasu |
hritsu kratum varuno apsvagnim divi suryamadadhatsomamadrau ||
verses.en:
In the tree-tops the air he hath extended, put milk in kine and vigorous speed in horses,
Set intellect in hearts, fire in the waters, Surya in heaven and Soma on the mountain.

verses.sa:
नीचीनबारं वरुणः कवन्धं प्र ससर्ज रोदसी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
तेन विश्वस्य भुवनस्य राजा यवं न वृष्टिर्व्युनत्ति भूम ॥
verses.rom:
nichinabaram varunah kavandham pra sasarja rodasi antariksham |
tena vishvasya bhuvanasya raja yavam na vrishtirvyunatti bhuma ||
verses.en:
Varuna lets the big cask, opening downward, flow through the heaven and earth and air's mid-region.
Therewith the universe's Sovran waters earth as the shower of rain bedews the barley.

verses.sa:
उनत्ति भूमिं पृथिवीमुत द्यां यदा दुग्धं वरुणो वष्ट्यादित् ।
समभ्रेण वसत पर्वतासस्तविषीयन्तः श्रथयन्त वीराः ॥
verses.rom:
unatti bhumim prithivimuta dyam yada dugdham varuno vashtyadit |
samabhrena vasata parvatasastavishiyantah shrathayanta virah ||
verses.en:
When Varuna is fain for milk he moistens the sky, the land, and earth to her foundation.
Then straight the mountains clothe them in the rain-cloud: the Heroes, putting forth their vigour, loose them.

verses.sa:
इमामू ष्वासुरस्य श्रुतस्य महीं मायां वरुणस्य प्र वोचम् ।
मानेनेव तस्थिवाँ अन्तरिक्षे वि यो ममे पृथिवीं सूर्येण ॥
verses.rom:
imamu shvasurasya shrutasya mahim mayam varunasya pra vocham |
maneneva tasthivan antarikshe vi yo mame prithivim suryena ||
verses.en:
I will declare this mighty deed of magic, of glorious Varuna the Lord Immortal,
Who standing in the firmament hath meted the earth out with the Sun as with a measure.

verses.sa:
इमामू नु कवितमस्य मायां महीं देवस्य नकिरा दधर्ष ।
एकं यदुद्ना न पृणन्त्येनीरासिञ्चन्तीरवनयः समुद्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
imamu nu kavitamasya mayam mahim devasya nakira dadharsha |
ekam yadudna na prinantyenirasinchantiravanayah samudram ||
verses.en:
None, verily, hath ever let or hindered this the most wise God's mighty deed of magic,
Whereby with all their flood, the lucid rivers fill not one sea wherein they pour their waters.

verses.sa:
अर्यम्यं वरुण मित्र्यं वा सखायं वा सदमिद्भ्रातरं वा ।
वेशं वा नित्यं वरुणारणं वा यत्सीमागश्चकृमा शिश्रथस्तत् ॥
verses.rom:
aryamyam varuna mitryam va sakhayam va sadamidbhrataram va |
vesham va nityam varunaranam va yatsimagashchakrima shishrathastat ||
verses.en:
If we have sinned against the man who loves us, have ever wronged a brother, friend, or comrade,
The neighbour ever with us, or a stranger, O Varuna, remove from us the trespass.

verses.sa:
कितवासो यद्रिरिपुर्न दीवि यद्वा घा सत्यमुत यन्न विद्म ।
सर्वा ता वि ष्य शिथिरेव देवाधा ते स्याम वरुण प्रियासः ॥
verses.rom:
kitavaso yadriripurna divi yadva gha satyamuta yanna vidma |
sarva ta vi shya shithireva devadha te syama varuna priyasah ||
verses.en:
If we, as gamesters cheat at play, have cheated, done wrong unwittingly or sinned of purpose,
Cast all these sins away like loosened fetters, and, Varuna let us be thine own beloved.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी यमवथ उभा वाजेषु मर्त्यम् ।
दृळ्हा चित्स प्र भेदति द्युम्ना वाणीरिव त्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
indragni yamavatha ubha vajeshu martyam |
drilha chitsa pra bhedati dyumna vaniriva tritah ||
verses.en:
THE mortal man whom ye, the Twain, Indra and Agni, help in fight,
Breaks through e'en strongly-guarded wealth as Trta burst his way through reeds.

verses.sa:
या पृतनासु दुष्टरा या वाजेषु श्रवाय्या ।
या पञ्च चर्षणीरभीन्द्राग्नी ता हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya pritanasu dushtara ya vajeshu shravayya |
ya pancha charshanirabhindragni ta havamahe ||
verses.en:
The Twain invincible in war, worthy to be renowned in frays,
Lords of the Fivefold. People, these, Indra and Agni, we invoke.

verses.sa:
तयोरिदमवच्छवस्तिग्मा दिद्युन्मघोनोः ।
प्रति द्रुणा गभस्त्योर्गवां वृत्रघ्न एषते ॥
verses.rom:
tayoridamavachchhavastigma didyunmaghonoh |
prati druna gabhastyorgavam vritraghna eshate ||
verses.en:
Impetuous is their strength, and keen the lightning of the mighty Pair,
Which from their arms speeds with the car to Vrtra's slayer for the kine.

verses.sa:
ता वामेषे रथानामिन्द्राग्नी हवामहे ।
पती तुरस्य राधसो विद्वांसा गिर्वणस्तमा ॥
verses.rom:
ta vameshe rathanamindragni havamahe |
pati turasya radhaso vidvamsa girvanastama ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, we invoke you both, as such, to send your cars:
Lords of quick-coming bounty, ye who know, chief lovers of the song.

verses.sa:
ता वृधन्तावनु द्यून्मर्ताय देवावदभा ।
अर्हन्ता चित्पुरो दधेऽंशेव देवावर्वते ॥
verses.rom:
ta vridhantavanu dyunmartaya devavadabha |
arhanta chitpuro dadhe'msheva devavarvate ||
verses.en:
These who give increase day by day, Gods without guile for mortal man,
Worthy themselves, I honour most, Two Gods as partners, for my horse.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यामहावि हव्यं शूष्यं घृतं न पूतमद्रिभिः ।
ता सूरिषु श्रवो बृहद्रयिं गृणत्सु दिधृतमिषं गृणत्सु दिधृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
evendragnibhyamahavi havyam shushyam ghritam na putamadribhih |
ta surishu shravo brihadrayim grinatsu didhritamisham grinatsu didhritam ||
verses.en:
The strength-bestowing offering thus to Indra-Agni hath been paid, as butter, purified by stones.
Deal to our princes high renown, deal wealth to those who sing your praise, deal food to those who sing your praise.

verses.sa:
प्र वो महे मतयो यन्तु विष्णवे मरुत्वते गिरिजा एवयामरुत् ।
प्र शर्धाय प्रयज्यवे सुखादये तवसे भन्ददिष्टये धुनिव्रताय शवसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo mahe matayo yantu vishnave marutvate girija evayamarut |
pra shardhaya prayajyave sukhadaye tavase bhandadishtaye dhunivrataya shavase ||
verses.en:
To Visnu, to the Mighty whom the Maruts follow let your hymns born in song go forth, Evayamarut;
To the impetuous, strong band, adorned with bracelets, that rushes on in joy and ever roars for vigour.

verses.sa:
प्र ये जाता महिना ये च नु स्वयं प्र विद्मना ब्रुवत एवयामरुत् ।
क्रत्वा तद्वो मरुतो नाधृषे शवो दाना मह्ना तदेषामधृष्टासो नाद्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye jata mahina ye cha nu svayam pra vidmana bruvata evayamarut |
kratva tadvo maruto nadhrishe shavo dana mahna tadeshamadhrishtaso nadrayah ||
verses.en:
They who with might were manifest, and who willingly by their own knowledge told it forth, Evayamarut.
Maruts, this strength of yours no wisdom comprehendeth: through their gifts' greatness they are moveless as the mountains.

verses.sa:
प्र ये दिवो बृहतः शृण्विरे गिरा सुशुक्वानः सुभ्व एवयामरुत् ।
न येषामिरी सधस्थ ईष्ट आँ अग्नयो न स्वविद्युतः प्र स्यन्द्रासो धुनीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra ye divo brihatah shrinvire gira sushukvanah subhva evayamarut |
na yeshamiri sadhastha ishta an agnayo na svavidyutah pra syandraso dhuninam ||
verses.en:
Who by the psalm they sing are heard, from lofty heaven, the strong, the brightly shining Ones, Evayamarut;
In whose abode there is no mightier one to move them, whose lightnings are as fires, who urge the roaring rivers.

verses.sa:
स चक्रमे महतो निरुरुक्रमः समानस्मात्सदस एवयामरुत् ।
यदायुक्त त्मना स्वादधि ष्णुभिर्विष्पर्धसो विमहसो जिगाति शेवृधो नृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa chakrame mahato nirurukramah samanasmatsadasa evayamarut |
yadayukta tmana svadadhi shnubhirvishpardhaso vimahaso jigati shevridho nribhih ||
verses.en:
He of the Mighty Stride forth strode, Evayamarut, out of the spacious dwelling-place, their home in common.
When he, himself, hath yoked his emulous strong horses on heights, he cometh forth, joy-giving, with the Heroes.

verses.sa:
स्वनो न वोऽमवान्रेजयद्वृषा त्वेषो ययिस्तविष एवयामरुत् ।
येना सहन्त ऋञ्जत स्वरोचिष स्थारश्मानो हिरण्ययाः स्वायुधास इष्मिणः ॥
verses.rom:
svano na vo'mavanrejayadvrisha tvesho yayistavisha evayamarut |
yena sahanta rinjata svarochisha stharashmano hiranyayah svayudhasa ishminah ||
verses.en:
Like your tremendous roar, the rainer with light flashing, strong, speeding, hath made all tremble, Evayamarut,
Wherewith victorious ye, self-luminous, press onward, with strong reins, decked with gold, impetuous and well-weaponed.

verses.sa:
अपारो वो महिमा वृद्धशवसस्त्वेषं शवोऽवत्वेवयामरुत् ।
स्थातारो हि प्रसितौ संदृशि स्थन ते न उरुष्यता निदः शुशुक्वांसो नाग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
aparo vo mahima vriddhashavasastvesham shavo'vatvevayamarut |
sthataro hi prasitau samdrishi sthana te na urushyata nidah shushukvamso nagnayah ||
verses.en:
Unbounded is your greatness, ye of mighty power: may your bright vigour be our aid, Evayamarut;
For ye are visible helpers in the time of trouble: like fires, aglow with light, save us from shame and insult.

verses.sa:
ते रुद्रासः सुमखा अग्नयो यथा तुविद्युम्ना अवन्त्वेवयामरुत् ।
दीर्घं पृथु पप्रथे सद्म पार्थिवं येषामज्मेष्वा महः शर्धांस्यद्भुतैनसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
te rudrasah sumakha agnayo yatha tuvidyumna avantvevayamarut |
dirgham prithu paprathe sadma parthivam yeshamajmeshva mahah shardhamsyadbhutainasam ||
verses.en:
So may the Rudras, mighty warriors, Evayamarut, with splendid brilliancy, like fires, be our protectors;
They whose terrestrial dwelling-place is wide-extended, whom none suspect of sin, whose bands have lofty courage.

verses.sa:
अद्वेषो नो मरुतो गातुमेतन श्रोता हवं जरितुरेवयामरुत् ।
विष्णोर्महः समन्यवो युयोतन स्मद्रथ्यो न दंसनाप द्वेषांसि सनुतः ॥
verses.rom:
advesho no maruto gatumetana shrota havam jariturevayamarut |
vishnormahah samanyavo yuyotana smadrathyo na damsanapa dveshamsi sanutah ||
verses.en:
Come in a friendly spirit, come to us, O Maruts, and hear his call who praises you, Evayamarut.
Like car-borne men, one-minded with the mighty Visnu, keep enmity far from us with your deeds of wonder.

verses.sa:
गन्ता नो यज्ञं यज्ञियाः सुशमि श्रोता हवमरक्ष एवयामरुत् ।
ज्येष्ठासो न पर्वतासो व्योमनि यूयं तस्य प्रचेतसः स्यात दुर्धर्तवो निदः ॥
verses.rom:
ganta no yajnam yajniyah sushami shrota havamaraksha evayamarut |
jyeshthaso na parvataso vyomani yuyam tasya prachetasah syata durdhartavo nidah ||
verses.en: Come to our sacrifice, ye Hnly Ones, to bless it, and, free from demons, hear our call, Evayamarut.
